🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate terrorism from country

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 11:01:50 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Pakistan overall witnessed a significant decline in terrorism-related violence during October, with attacks falling by 37%, deaths resulting from these attacks declining by 57%, and injuries decreasing by 71% compared to September, said Dawn newspaper report

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Pakistan’s Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir on Friday (November 20, 2026) expressed the “unwavering resolve” of the security forces to eliminate terrorism from the country during a visit to the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. Mr. Munir, who is also the Chief of Defence Forces (CDF), said this during a visit to Miranshah in North Waziristan district, the military's media wing said in a statement. “He reaffirmed the unwavering resolve of the security forces, in close coordination with law enforcement agencies, to decisively eliminate the menace of terrorism and preserve the hard-earned peace and stability of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,” the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said in a statement. Mr. Munir also appreciated the KP police and expressed pride in its resilience and sacrifices against terrorism and Fitna-al-Khawarij. The term Fitna-al-Khawarij is used by the federal government for the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan. During the visit, the CDF was given a comprehensive briefing on “the prevailing security situation, ongoing intelligence-based operations [IBO] and measures being undertaken to consolidate the gains achieved through sustained counter-terrorism efforts, “ the ISPR statement said. It added that CDF Munir also interacted with officers and troops and appreciated their “high level of preparedness, professionalism and unwavering commitment". Security forces continue to carry out counterterrorism action in KP and Balochistan, the two provinces that have been particularly affected by terrorism in Pakistan. On Saturday (November 14, 2026), ISPR said four troops, including a major, were killed while 24 terrorists were killed in IBOs in Balochistan and KP’s North Waziristan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Furthermore, last week, 74 terrorists were killed in IBOs in KP and Balochistan.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Comprehensive (Adjective)
विस्तृत — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Comprehensive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate terrorism from country", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Pakistan overall witnessed a significant decline in terrorism-related violence during October, with attacks falling by 37%, deaths resulting from...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate terr' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate t' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate t' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Pakistan overall witnessed a significant decline in terrorism-related violence during October, with attacks falling by 37%, deaths resulting from..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate terrorism from country"?

articles.title: U.S. sanctions Myanmar armed group leader over scam links
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The U.S. Treasury Department said on November 19 it had imposed an asset freeze on General Saw Shwe Wah, commander-in-chief of the Democratic Karen Benevolent Army (DKBA), and one of his top officers, and had banned Americans from dealing with them

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The United States has frozen the assets of the leader of an ethnic armed group in Myanmar and one of his lieutenants, accusing them of facilitating cyberscammers who target Americans. Organised criminal gangs have, for years, carried out fake romance and cryptocurrency investment schemes from compounds in Southeast Asian nations, defrauding victims around the world of tens of billions of dollars annually. The industry is adapting its operations in the wake of much-publicised crackdowns in Myanmar and Cambodia following Chinese pressure, often dissipating into smaller facilities in new locations. The U.S. Treasury Department said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) it had imposed an asset freeze on General Saw Shwe Wah, commander-in-chief of the Democratic Karen Benevolent Army (DKBA), and one of his top officers, and had banned Americans from dealing with them. The DKBA is one of the myriad armed groups operating in Myanmar's borderlands, some of which have been fighting the government for decades. It has signed a ceasefire with Yangon and is accused by the United States, which earlier sanctioned the organisation, of supporting scam centres. "DKBA actors not only provide security for scam compounds and permit their continued operation, but also actively participate in violence against victims of human trafficking trapped inside the compounds," the U.S. Treasury said. The DKBA's Colonel Saw A One, responsible for security in the Three Pagodas Pass area in Karen State near the Thai border, was also designated by the U.S. on Thursday (November 19, 2026). Jason Tower, senior expert at the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime, told that last week the Three Pagodas Pass region has been a "major expansion area" for scam compounds.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The latest U.S. Treasury measures also sanctioned Zhao Hui, a China-born, naturalised Cambodian accused of running cyberscam compounds in Cambodia, and two of his companies.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 U.S. sanctions Myanmar armed group leader over scam links

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 10:48:33 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The U.S. Treasury Department said on November 19 it had imposed an asset freeze on General Saw Shwe Wah, commander-in-chief of the Democratic Karen Benevolent Army (DKBA), and one of his top officers, and had banned Americans from dealing with them

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The United States has frozen the assets of the leader of an ethnic armed group in Myanmar and one of his lieutenants, accusing them of facilitating cyberscammers who target Americans. Organised criminal gangs have, for years, carried out fake romance and cryptocurrency investment schemes from compounds in Southeast Asian nations, defrauding victims around the world of tens of billions of dollars annually. The industry is adapting its operations in the wake of much-publicised crackdowns in Myanmar and Cambodia following Chinese pressure, often dissipating into smaller facilities in new locations. The U.S. Treasury Department said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) it had imposed an asset freeze on General Saw Shwe Wah, commander-in-chief of the Democratic Karen Benevolent Army (DKBA), and one of his top officers, and had banned Americans from dealing with them. The DKBA is one of the myriad armed groups operating in Myanmar's borderlands, some of which have been fighting the government for decades. It has signed a ceasefire with Yangon and is accused by the United States, which earlier sanctioned the organisation, of supporting scam centres. "DKBA actors not only provide security for scam compounds and permit their continued operation, but also actively participate in violence against victims of human trafficking trapped inside the compounds," the U.S. Treasury said. The DKBA's Colonel Saw A One, responsible for security in the Three Pagodas Pass area in Karen State near the Thai border, was also designated by the U.S. on Thursday (November 19, 2026). Jason Tower, senior expert at the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime, told that last week the Three Pagodas Pass region has been a "major expansion area" for scam compounds.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The latest U.S. Treasury measures also sanctioned Zhao Hui, a China-born, naturalised Cambodian accused of running cyberscam compounds in Cambodia, and two of his companies.

articles.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah to visit India on November 22-23
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In his first India visit, Nepal Prime Minister is expected to sign several MoUs and inaugurate projects

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will visit India on November 22-23, the Ministry of External Affairs announced on Friday (November 20, 2026). Briefing the media in Kathmandu, Nepal’s Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai said Mr. Shah will be accompanied by a 34-member delegation. #WATCH | Kathmandu | "On the invitation of the Prime Minister of India, Nepali PM Balendra Shah will embark on a State visit to India from 22nd to 23rd November," says Nepal's Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai. He adds, "It will be a 34-member government team that will depart from Kathmandu to New Delhi, India. During the visit, the Nepali PM will hold a delegation-level meeting on Monday with his Indian counterpart. Various projects relating to energy will be inaugurated by the two Prime Ministers. Various aspects of cooperation will be signed and exchanged. After the delegation-level talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference. Nepali PM will also call on the President of India, Droupadi Murmu. Nepali PM will also lay a wreath at Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat. Nepali PM will also attend the Nepal-India Business Forum." “Bilateral cooperation has witnessed progress across diverse sectors, including trade and commerce, development partnership, energy and water resources, and physical and digital connectivity, with growing engagement in newer areas such as start-ups, technology and innovation, and sports,” the Ministry said. This will be the Nepal Prime Minister’s first visit to India since he took charge last March. Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle and Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal, who both visited India earlier this year, will join the delegation. Official spokesperson for the Ministry of External Affairs Randhir Jaiswal said Mr. Shah’s trip will be a “state visit, during which he will be accorded state honours”. “He will meet with our President and hold discussions with our Prime Minister. Given that this is a highly multifaceted relationship, the talks will cover a wide range of topics, including our development partnership, economic cooperation, and various other matters,” said Mr. Jaiswal during the biweekly media briefing on Friday (November 20, 2026). Mr. Rai said the two countries are expected to sign several memorandums of understanding covering different areas of cooperation, and a few completed projects are expected to be inaugurated following PM Balendra Shah’s meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Sources said the Dharchula Bridge, the land port of Banbasa at the Uttarakhand-Nepal border, and a train route between Janakpur and Gorakhpur are slated to be opened.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier this month, India’s Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri visited Kathmandu. India’s External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will be the first government representative to call on Prime Minister Shah upon his arrival on Sunday (November 22, 2026). Formal engagements will begin Monday morning with a ceremonial reception at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, followed by a visit to Rajghat, where Mr. Shah will lay a wreath at Mahatma Gandhi’s memorial. He will then meet Prime Minister Modi at Hyderabad House, where the MoUs will be signed. He will leave for Kathmandu later that afternoon.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Nepal PM Balendra Shah to visit India on November 22-23

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 10:39:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In his first India visit, Nepal Prime Minister is expected to sign several MoUs and inaugurate projects

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will visit India on November 22-23, the Ministry of External Affairs announced on Friday (November 20, 2026). Briefing the media in Kathmandu, Nepal’s Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai said Mr. Shah will be accompanied by a 34-member delegation. #WATCH | Kathmandu | "On the invitation of the Prime Minister of India, Nepali PM Balendra Shah will embark on a State visit to India from 22nd to 23rd November," says Nepal's Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai. He adds, "It will be a 34-member government team that will depart from Kathmandu to New Delhi, India. During the visit, the Nepali PM will hold a delegation-level meeting on Monday with his Indian counterpart. Various projects relating to energy will be inaugurated by the two Prime Ministers. Various aspects of cooperation will be signed and exchanged. After the delegation-level talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference. Nepali PM will also call on the President of India, Droupadi Murmu. Nepali PM will also lay a wreath at Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat. Nepali PM will also attend the Nepal-India Business Forum." “Bilateral cooperation has witnessed progress across diverse sectors, including trade and commerce, development partnership, energy and water resources, and physical and digital connectivity, with growing engagement in newer areas such as start-ups, technology and innovation, and sports,” the Ministry said. This will be the Nepal Prime Minister’s first visit to India since he took charge last March. Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle and Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal, who both visited India earlier this year, will join the delegation. Official spokesperson for the Ministry of External Affairs Randhir Jaiswal said Mr. Shah’s trip will be a “state visit, during which he will be accorded state honours”. “He will meet with our President and hold discussions with our Prime Minister. Given that this is a highly multifaceted relationship, the talks will cover a wide range of topics, including our development partnership, economic cooperation, and various other matters,” said Mr. Jaiswal during the biweekly media briefing on Friday (November 20, 2026). Mr. Rai said the two countries are expected to sign several memorandums of understanding covering different areas of cooperation, and a few completed projects are expected to be inaugurated following PM Balendra Shah’s meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Sources said the Dharchula Bridge, the land port of Banbasa at the Uttarakhand-Nepal border, and a train route between Janakpur and Gorakhpur are slated to be opened.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier this month, India’s Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri visited Kathmandu. India’s External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will be the first government representative to call on Prime Minister Shah upon his arrival on Sunday (November 22, 2026). Formal engagements will begin Monday morning with a ceremonial reception at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, followed by a visit to Rajghat, where Mr. Shah will lay a wreath at Mahatma Gandhi’s memorial. He will then meet Prime Minister Modi at Hyderabad House, where the MoUs will be signed. He will leave for Kathmandu later that afternoon.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will visit India on November 22-23, the Ministry of External Affairs announced on Friday (November 20, 2026). Briefing the media in Kathmandu, Nepal’s Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai said Mr. Shah will be accompanied by a 34-member delegation. #WATCH | Kathmandu | "On the invitation of the Prime Minister of India, Nepali PM Balendra Shah will embark on a State visit to India from 22nd to 23rd November," says Nepal's Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai. He adds, "It will be a 34-member government team that will depart from Kathmandu to New Delhi, India. During the visit, the Nepali PM will hold a delegation-level meeting on Monday with his Indian counterpart. Various projects relating to energy will be inaugurated by the two Prime Ministers. Various aspects of cooperation will be signed and exchanged. After the delegation-level talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference. Nepali PM will also call on the President of India, Droupadi Murmu. Nepali PM will also lay a wreath at Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat. Nepali PM will also attend the Nepal-India Business Forum." “Bilateral cooperation has witnessed progress across diverse sectors, including trade and commerce, development partnership, energy and water resources, and physical and digital connectivity, with growing engagement in newer areas such as start-ups, technology and innovation, and sports,” the Ministry said. This will be the Nepal Prime Minister’s first visit to India since he took charge last March. Jaishankar will be the first government representative to call on Prime Minister Shah upon his arrival on Sunday (November 22, 2026). fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The FDA said the council is intended to improve accountability and transparency as biologic products grow increasingly complex, particularly in cell and gene therapy, a sector that has seen rapid regulatory expansion in recent years

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The US Food and Drug Administration said on Thursday it had established a new internal safety body within its biologics center, formalizing independent oversight of approved products such as vaccines, gene therapies and blood products once they reach the market. The CBER Safety Council will report directly to the director of the FDA’s Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research, structurally separating post-market safety reviews from the offices responsible for approving those products, the agency said. The council supersedes CBER’s existing Safety Working Group, bringing together senior scientific and regulatory officials to review safety signals, conduct benefit-risk assessments and recommend regulatory actions as warranted. The new structure formalizes an independent post-market review process at a time when regulators face mounting pressure to closely monitor newer biologic products, including gene and cell therapies, after approval, when they are used across far broader patient populations. Its mandate will cover emerging safety concerns, potential labeling changes, risk-management measures and safety-related post-market studies, as well as advising on potential market withdrawals. The FDA said the council is intended to improve accountability and transparency as biologic products grow increasingly complex, particularly in cell and gene therapy, a sector that has seen rapid regulatory expansion in recent years. The council will coordinate with external bodies including the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the National Institutes of Health, drawing on surveillance systems such as the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) and the FDA Sentinel program.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The council takes effect on November 19; the agency said additional details on its structure and membership will be released later.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The FDA said the council is intended to improve accountability and transparency as biologic products grow increasingly complex, particularly in cell and gene therapy, a sector that has seen rapid regulatory expansion in recent years
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The US Food and Drug Administration said on Thursday it had established a new internal safety body within its biologics center, formalizing independent oversight of approved products such as vaccines, gene therapies and blood products once they reach the market. The CBER Safety Council will report directly to the director of the FDA’s Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research, structurally separating post-market safety reviews from the offices responsible for approving those products, the agency said. The council supersedes CBER’s existing Safety Working Group, bringing together senior scientific and regulatory officials to review safety signals, conduct benefit-risk assessments and recommend regulatory actions as warranted. The new structure formalizes an independent post-market review process at a time when regulators face mounting pressure to closely monitor newer biologic products, including gene and cell therapies, after approval, when they are used across far broader patient populations. Its mandate will cover emerging safety concerns, potential labeling changes, risk-management measures and safety-related post-market studies, as well as advising on potential market withdrawals. The FDA said the council is intended to improve accountability and transparency as biologic products grow increasingly complex, particularly in cell and gene therapy, a sector that has seen rapid regulatory expansion in recent years. The council will coordinate with external bodies including the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the National Institutes of Health, drawing on surveillance systems such as the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) and the FDA Sentinel program.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The council takes effect on November 19; the agency said additional details on its structure and membership will be released later.

articles.title: Tiger ‘Explorer’ reaches Mylavaram forest near Vijayawada; four villages on alert
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: GPS-enabled collar helps forest officials track the movement; no attacks on cattle or human habitations reported so far

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The tiger ‘Explorer’, which has been roaming across the Eastern Ghats after travelling through several States, has entered the Mylavaram forest range in the Vijayawada forest division and was seen in the A. Konduru forest block on Friday (November 20, 2026), triggering a fresh alert among forest officials. The tiger is staying in a hilly stretch with thick forest cover and dense bush growth. Forest officials are tracking its movements with the help of a GPS-enabled satellite radio collar fitted to it following its capture and subsequent release into the Papikondalu National Park earlier this year. Officials said the tiger had not entered any human habitation so far and no cattle deaths or attacks on livestock had been reported in the Mylavaram range. The villages of A. Konduru, Cheemalapadu, Vinagadapa and Narkulapadu, located in the vicinity of the forest block, have been alerted as a precautionary measure. Forest personnel are monitoring the animal's movements and keeping a safe distance to avoid disturbing it. Officials said its movement was being tracked continuously, though its next direction of travel could not be predicted. The tiger was first noticed in the Nuzvidu range a couple of days ago and moved towards the Mylavaram range overnight. It has been staying in the A. Konduru forest block since the following morning. Officials said it could move back towards Nuzvidu or proceed towards other forest stretches, depending on its movement. A five-member specialised tiger conservation team from Pune, which had assisted the Forest Department during earlier operations, is involved in monitoring the animal. The team is equipped to tranquilise and capture the tiger if the situation warrants it. Forest Department personnel are also using GPS equipment, drones and camera traps to keep track of its movements. The tiger, estimated to be about four to five years old, had earlier travelled through Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh and Telangana before entering Andhra Pradesh. Believed to have originated in the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra , it was named ‘Explorer’ after its extensive journey across different forest landscapes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: After it strayed into human-inhabited areas in the Godavari region, the Forest Department launched an extensive operation to capture it. The ‘Explorer’ was tranquilised near Kurmapuram in Konaseema district on February 6 and subsequently released into the Papikonda National Park on February 14, after being fitted with a GPS-enabled satellite radio collar to monitor its movements.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Tiger ‘Explorer’ reaches Mylavaram forest near Vijayawada; four villages on alert

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 07:37:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: GPS-enabled collar helps forest officials track the movement; no attacks on cattle or human habitations reported so far

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The tiger ‘Explorer’, which has been roaming across the Eastern Ghats after travelling through several States, has entered the Mylavaram forest range in the Vijayawada forest division and was seen in the A. Konduru forest block on Friday (November 20, 2026), triggering a fresh alert among forest officials. The tiger is staying in a hilly stretch with thick forest cover and dense bush growth. Forest officials are tracking its movements with the help of a GPS-enabled satellite radio collar fitted to it following its capture and subsequent release into the Papikondalu National Park earlier this year. Officials said the tiger had not entered any human habitation so far and no cattle deaths or attacks on livestock had been reported in the Mylavaram range. The villages of A. Konduru, Cheemalapadu, Vinagadapa and Narkulapadu, located in the vicinity of the forest block, have been alerted as a precautionary measure. Forest personnel are monitoring the animal's movements and keeping a safe distance to avoid disturbing it. Officials said its movement was being tracked continuously, though its next direction of travel could not be predicted. The tiger was first noticed in the Nuzvidu range a couple of days ago and moved towards the Mylavaram range overnight. It has been staying in the A. Konduru forest block since the following morning. Officials said it could move back towards Nuzvidu or proceed towards other forest stretches, depending on its movement. A five-member specialised tiger conservation team from Pune, which had assisted the Forest Department during earlier operations, is involved in monitoring the animal. The team is equipped to tranquilise and capture the tiger if the situation warrants it. Forest Department personnel are also using GPS equipment, drones and camera traps to keep track of its movements. The tiger, estimated to be about four to five years old, had earlier travelled through Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh and Telangana before entering Andhra Pradesh. Believed to have originated in the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra , it was named ‘Explorer’ after its extensive journey across different forest landscapes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: After it strayed into human-inhabited areas in the Godavari region, the Forest Department launched an extensive operation to capture it. The ‘Explorer’ was tranquilised near Kurmapuram in Konaseema district on February 6 and subsequently released into the Papikonda National Park on February 14, after being fitted with a GPS-enabled satellite radio collar to monitor its movements.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: Millions of students take NEET, yet hundreds of medical seats go vacant
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Under the 2026 Float and Freeze option, candidates can carry forward their allotments without completing admission formalities, and even if their seats remain unchanged in Round 3, they can choose not to join; this flexibility has had significant implications in seat utilisation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Even as millions of candidates competed for admission, several undergraduate MBBS seats remained vacant during the NEET-UG 2026 counselling. Over 3,000-3,400 vacancies were reported after the initial All India Quota (AIQ) and State rounds, with approximately 410 seats still unfilled in deemed universities even after the Special Stray Vacancy Round. (Sign up for THEdge , The Hindu’s weekly education newsletter.) While government medical college seats were all filled, most remaining vacancies were in deemed universities. States such as Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karnataka accounted for a significant share of these vacancies, raising concerns about high fees, seat utilisation and equitable access to medical education. As per the data published by the National Medical Commission (NMC), the total number of MBBS seats available in the country for the academic session 2026–27 stands at 1,40,664. Of these, 64,121 seats are available in government medical colleges, while the remaining 76,543 seats are in the private medical sector. The latter comprises 14,299 seats in deemed university medical colleges and 62,244 seats in self-financing private medical colleges. Thus, more than 54% of the total MBBS seats in the country are concentrated in the private medical sector, where the cost of medical education is generally substantially higher than in government institutions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The National Testing Agency (NTA) reported that 11,21,185 candidates qualified NEET-UG 2026 by securing marks above the prescribed category-wise qualifying cut-off. This included 9,96,935 candidates belonging to the General/EWS qualifying category, and 1,24,250 candidates belonging to the OBC, SC and ST categories who qualified with scores ranging from 177 to 212 marks.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Millions of students take NEET, yet hundreds of medical seats go vacant

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 07:16:08 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Under the 2026 Float and Freeze option, candidates can carry forward their allotments without completing admission formalities, and even if their seats remain unchanged in Round 3, they can choose not to join; this flexibility has had significant implications in seat utilisation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Even as millions of candidates competed for admission, several undergraduate MBBS seats remained vacant during the NEET-UG 2026 counselling. Over 3,000-3,400 vacancies were reported after the initial All India Quota (AIQ) and State rounds, with approximately 410 seats still unfilled in deemed universities even after the Special Stray Vacancy Round. (Sign up for THEdge , The Hindu’s weekly education newsletter.) While government medical college seats were all filled, most remaining vacancies were in deemed universities. States such as Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karnataka accounted for a significant share of these vacancies, raising concerns about high fees, seat utilisation and equitable access to medical education. As per the data published by the National Medical Commission (NMC), the total number of MBBS seats available in the country for the academic session 2026–27 stands at 1,40,664. Of these, 64,121 seats are available in government medical colleges, while the remaining 76,543 seats are in the private medical sector. The latter comprises 14,299 seats in deemed university medical colleges and 62,244 seats in self-financing private medical colleges. Thus, more than 54% of the total MBBS seats in the country are concentrated in the private medical sector, where the cost of medical education is generally substantially higher than in government institutions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The National Testing Agency (NTA) reported that 11,21,185 candidates qualified NEET-UG 2026 by securing marks above the prescribed category-wise qualifying cut-off. This included 9,96,935 candidates belonging to the General/EWS qualifying category, and 1,24,250 candidates belonging to the OBC, SC and ST categories who qualified with scores ranging from 177 to 212 marks.

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Flexibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Flexibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Utilisation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Utilisation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Cheetah brought from Botswana gives birth to four cubs at Kuno
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: With these four new arrivals, India’s cheetah population has risen to 62, including 43 Indian-born individuals

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A two-and-a-half-year-old cheetah, KOMG 3, brought from Botswana, gave birth to four healthy cubs in the wild at Madhya Pradesh’s Kuno National Park on Friday (November 20, 2026), Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav said. Calling the development a matter of pride for Madhya Pradesh and the entire country, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav said it was a historic achievement for Project Cheetah. In a post on X, Bhupender Yadav said KOMG 3 is the first cheetah from Botswana to give birth in India. “This is a landmark moment for Project Cheetah and a proud milestone in India’s journey towards restoring a viable cheetah population,” he added. This is the second recorded birth in the wild since the reintroduction programme began in 2022. With these four new arrivals, India’s cheetah population has risen to 62, including 43 Indian-born individuals. “Every such birth strengthens our hope, deepens our commitment, and reminds us that conservation is a journey of patience, perseverance and collective effort,” Mr. Yadav said. He also acknowledged the dedication, commitment and hard work of project managers, veterinarians, frontline forest staff and everyone working tirelessly for the success of Project Cheetah. In a statement, CM Mohan Yadav said, “This is a matter of pride for Madhya Pradesh and the entire country. The birth of cubs in India for the first time by a female cheetah from Botswana is a historic achievement of Project Cheetah.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “This is an important and encouraging step towards restoring a viable cheetah population in India. KOMG 3, a female cheetah, gave birth to four healthy cubs in natural conditions after spending more than four months in the wild.”

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (20 NOV)

📰 Cheetah brought from Botswana gives birth to four cubs at Kuno

📌 Published: 20 Nov 2026, 06:05:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: With these four new arrivals, India’s cheetah population has risen to 62, including 43 Indian-born individuals

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A two-and-a-half-year-old cheetah, KOMG 3, brought from Botswana, gave birth to four healthy cubs in the wild at Madhya Pradesh’s Kuno National Park on Friday (November 20, 2026), Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav said. Calling the development a matter of pride for Madhya Pradesh and the entire country, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav said it was a historic achievement for Project Cheetah. In a post on X, Bhupender Yadav said KOMG 3 is the first cheetah from Botswana to give birth in India. “This is a landmark moment for Project Cheetah and a proud milestone in India’s journey towards restoring a viable cheetah population,” he added. This is the second recorded birth in the wild since the reintroduction programme began in 2022. With these four new arrivals, India’s cheetah population has risen to 62, including 43 Indian-born individuals. “Every such birth strengthens our hope, deepens our commitment, and reminds us that conservation is a journey of patience, perseverance and collective effort,” Mr. Yadav said. He also acknowledged the dedication, commitment and hard work of project managers, veterinarians, frontline forest staff and everyone working tirelessly for the success of Project Cheetah. In a statement, CM Mohan Yadav said, “This is a matter of pride for Madhya Pradesh and the entire country. The birth of cubs in India for the first time by a female cheetah from Botswana is a historic achievement of Project Cheetah.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “This is an important and encouraging step towards restoring a viable cheetah population in India. KOMG 3, a female cheetah, gave birth to four healthy cubs in natural conditions after spending more than four months in the wild.”

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A video explainer on 'Project Cheetah', the first intercontinental transfer of wild cats into the country.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In September 2022, Prime Minister Narendra Modi released a coalition of cheetahs into the Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh. Eight cheetahs, five of which are female, were flown from Windhoek, Namibia, to Gwalior. It was the first intercontinental transfer of wild cats into India since independence. The proposal for the project, known as ‘Project Cheetah’, was prepared in 2008-09 under the then PM Manmohan Singh. The cheetahs were flown into India following several weeks of medical supervision in Namibia. They will be released into the wild gradually so that they have enough time to adapt to Indian conditions. It also ensures reduced risk of contracting and spreading infection and hone the skills to hunt Indian prey. The eight cheetahs were housed in six enclosures, referred to as ‘bomas’ and were initially provided with buffalo meat.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: All are expected to be moved inside larger enclosures in weeks. The cheetahs are radio-collared and their movements will be tracked. Each animal also has a dedicated tracking team. A team of wildlife scientists, biologists and zoologists are monitoring the initiative.

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A video explainer on 'Project Cheetah', the first intercontinental transfer of wild cats into the country.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In September 2022, Prime Minister Narendra Modi released a coalition of cheetahs into the Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh. Eight cheetahs, five of which are female, were flown from Windhoek, Namibia, to Gwalior. It was the first intercontinental transfer of wild cats into India since independence. The proposal for the project, known as ‘Project Cheetah’, was prepared in 2008-09 under the then PM Manmohan Singh. The cheetahs were flown into India following several weeks of medical supervision in Namibia. They will be released into the wild gradually so that they have enough time to adapt to Indian conditions. It also ensures reduced risk of contracting and spreading infection and hone the skills to hunt Indian prey. The eight cheetahs were housed in six enclosures, referred to as ‘bomas’ and were initially provided with buffalo meat.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: All are expected to be moved inside larger enclosures in weeks. The cheetahs are radio-collared and their movements will be tracked. Each animal also has a dedicated tracking team. A team of wildlife scientists, biologists and zoologists are monitoring the initiative.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India’s cheetah population has risen to 52, including 32 cubs born in the country, as Project Cheetah completes four years on September 17, 2026, with officials highlighting the survival of cubs, breeding success and the expansion of the animals into open forest areas as key milestones.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Cheetah brought from Botswana gives birth to four cubs at Kuno On September 17, 2022, Prime Minister Narendra Modi released eight wild cheetahs from Namibia into special enclosures at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh. The next phase of the cheetah restoration programme involves expanding suitable habitat for cheetahs and establishing a comprehensive, long term cheetah meta population in India. While 49 cheetahs are in Kuno National Park, three others are in Gandhi Sagar Sanctuary, both in Madhya Pradesh. Over the last four years, many important milestones have been achieved, ranging from the reintroduction of cheetahs to breeding, survival of cubs and expansion into open forest, an official said in a statement. The journey that began in Namibia on the distant African continent has now reached Gandhi Sagar Sanctuary. A total of 32 cheetahs were born in India, officials said. The success in cheetah breeding and expansion was achieved by learning from difficulties. “The team faced many challenges in the first year of cheetah reintroduction. During this time, they gained experience in cheetah behaviour, health, and management adapted to Indian conditions,” an official said. In the next year, the focus shifted to the survival and development of cubs born in India. According to the document, 13 cubs survived for more than a year after birth. In the third year, 2025, cheetahs were released into open forest areas. They were monitored 24 hours a day across an interstate landscape spanning 12 districts, officials said, adding that the cheetahs gradually adapted to new areas.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The establishment of breeding females and the successful survival of the second generation of cubs in the fourth year are considered significant achievements of the programme, they said.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre. The premature babies, who weighed between 1.4 kg and 1.5 kg at birth, spent over a month in the hospital’s Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). They were discharged along with their 32-year-old mother after responding well to treatment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Avanthi enrolled at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre in January this year. Doctors opted for ovulation induction, a non-assisted reproductive treatment, and she conceived in the second cycle. After scans revealed a triplet pregnancy and a short cervix, doctors performed a McDonald’s cervical cerclage at 14 weeks. However, her water broke prematurely at 32 weeks, prompting doctors to deliver the babies on October 7. The newborns were admitted to the NICU, where they received treatment and close monitoring for over a month before being discharged with their mother. Director of Medical Education Vanii appreciated the efforts of the team, including head of the Department of Gynaecology Shobha, IVF specialists Krishnaveni and Fathima Rafi, embryologist Shiva Krishna, lab technician Ashok and counsellor Kavitha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: IVF specialist Dr Krishnaveni said that they opted ovulation induction as a first line of treatment, which is not a In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) method. “We conduct evaluations to know if non-IVF methods can be used as first line of treatment to avoid burden on couples who are already in distress,” she said. Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment at Telangana govt. hospital; premature babies discharged after NICU care

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:20:03 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre. The premature babies, who weighed between 1.4 kg and 1.5 kg at birth, spent over a month in the hospital’s Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). They were discharged along with their 32-year-old mother after responding well to treatment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Avanthi enrolled at Gandhi Hospital’s IVF Centre in January this year. Doctors opted for ovulation induction, a non-assisted reproductive treatment, and she conceived in the second cycle. After scans revealed a triplet pregnancy and a short cervix, doctors performed a McDonald’s cervical cerclage at 14 weeks. However, her water broke prematurely at 32 weeks, prompting doctors to deliver the babies on October 7. The newborns were admitted to the NICU, where they received treatment and close monitoring for over a month before being discharged with their mother. Director of Medical Education Vanii appreciated the efforts of the team, including head of the Department of Gynaecology Shobha, IVF specialists Krishnaveni and Fathima Rafi, embryologist Shiva Krishna, lab technician Ashok and counsellor Kavitha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: IVF specialist Dr Krishnaveni said that they opted ovulation induction as a first line of treatment, which is not a In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) method. “We conduct evaluations to know if non-IVF methods can be used as first line of treatment to avoid burden on couples who are already in distress,” she said. Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre.

Department (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Treatment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Treatment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

A. After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatme' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatme' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "After a nine-year wait and unsuccessful fertility treatment at private hospitals, a couple welcomed triplet boys following treatment at Gandhi..." (Hinglish Arth: नौ साल के इंतजार और निजी अस्पतालों में असफल प्रजनन उपचार के बाद, एक जोड़े ने गांधी अस्पताल के आईवीएफ केंद्र में इलाज के बाद तीन बेटों का स्वागत किया।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Woman delivers triplets after non-ART treatment at Telangana govt. hospital; premature babies discharged after NICU care"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Currently, over 500 couples have rolled for treatments at the government hospitals IVF centre." (Hinglish Arth: वर्तमान में, 500 से अधिक जोड़े सरकारी अस्पतालों के आईवीएफ केंद्र में इलाज के लिए आए हैं।)

articles.title: IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan from Nov. 30
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IJCCI) organised a business networking meeting with a 16-member business delegation from Osaka, Japan, to strengthen bilateral business ties and explore opportunities for trade, investment, and industrial collaboration between India and Japan.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The delegation was led by Hiromitsu Morishima, Chairperson, International Business Committee, Osaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and Yasushi Ninomiya, Director-General, JETRO Osaka. The companies spoke about their products and business opportunities. To strengthen bilateral economic relations, IJCCI is leading a 16-member delegation to Japan from November 30 to December 4. The delegation will visit Tokyo, Yokohama, Kochi, Fukuoka, Hiroshima, and Osaka. “We particularly look forward to strengthening our engagement with Osaka, which is one of Japan’s leading commercial and industrial centres,” said IJCCI president S. Padmanabhan. “India, with its large domestic market, growing manufacturing capabilities, and developing digital economy, offers significant opportunities for Japanese businesses,” Mr. Padmanabhan added.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further said that Indian companies can benefit from Japanese technology, management practices, and innovation.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 IJCCI to lead business delegation to Japan from Nov. 30

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:19:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Indo-Japan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IJCCI) organised a business networking meeting with a 16-member business delegation from Osaka, Japan, to strengthen bilateral business ties and explore opportunities for trade, investment, and industrial collaboration between India and Japan.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The delegation was led by Hiromitsu Morishima, Chairperson, International Business Committee, Osaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and Yasushi Ninomiya, Director-General, JETRO Osaka. The companies spoke about their products and business opportunities. To strengthen bilateral economic relations, IJCCI is leading a 16-member delegation to Japan from November 30 to December 4. The delegation will visit Tokyo, Yokohama, Kochi, Fukuoka, Hiroshima, and Osaka. “We particularly look forward to strengthening our engagement with Osaka, which is one of Japan’s leading commercial and industrial centres,” said IJCCI president S. Padmanabhan. “India, with its large domestic market, growing manufacturing capabilities, and developing digital economy, offers significant opportunities for Japanese businesses,” Mr. Padmanabhan added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He further said that Indian companies can benefit from Japanese technology, management practices, and innovation.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Delegation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:18:11 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core secto' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core se' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Infra push and low base effect pushes core se' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output." (Hinglish Arth: जबकि कोयला और बिजली क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि देखी गई, इसका एक बड़ा हिस्सा वास्तविक उत्पादन में वृद्धि के बजाय सांख्यिकीय प्रभाव के कारण था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months." (Hinglish Arth: इस मजबूत वृद्धि को चलाने वाले कारकों में से एक यह था कि अक्टूबर में इस्पात उत्पादन 7.3% की दर से बढ़ा, जो सात महीनों में सबसे तेज़ दर थी।)

articles.title: Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather likely to last till the first week of December

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following Cyclone Akvan’s passage on Friday morning, most parts of Tamil Nadu are likely to experience a brief break in monsoon activity, accompanied by a dip in night-time temperatures. Wet weather is expected to return on Sunday and intensify over the subsequent days. The break in rainfall is expected to raise day temperatures by two or three degrees Celsius in a few pockets of the State. The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) has also forecast ground frost at isolated places in the Nilgiris and Kodaikanal till Sunday. The absence of widespread rainfall has pushed various districts, including Tiruvarur, Thanjavur, Madurai, Salem, and Chengalpattu, into the rainfall deficit category. The State has so far received nearly 26 cm of monsoon rainfall, which is 14% lower than its seasonal share since October 1. RMC officials said Cyclone Akvan was expected to weaken into a depression on Friday, and gradually fade away. V.R. Durai, Head, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, RMC, said dry and cold northwesterly winds and the absence of cloud cover and rainfall led to a rise in day temperatures and drop in minimum temperatures over most parts of the State. A trough in the easterly wave is likely to revive rainfall activity from Sunday and bring intense rainfall from Monday as it moves across the State. While coastal districts are expected to benefit more, interior Tamil Nadu is also likely to receive moderate rainfall till November 26. “We are expecting wet weather in the State till December first week, with a low pressure area likely to form then. The sustained rainfall activity may narrow rainfall deficit,” he said. The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall over coastal districts, including Chennai, Cuddalore, and Nagapattinam, on Sunday and mild rainfall over areas adjoining coastal districts.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari.

On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 01:16:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall in coastal districts, including Chennai and Cuddalore, and mild rainfall over adjoining areas; wet weather likely to last till the first week of December

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following Cyclone Akvan’s passage on Friday morning, most parts of Tamil Nadu are likely to experience a brief break in monsoon activity, accompanied by a dip in night-time temperatures. Wet weather is expected to return on Sunday and intensify over the subsequent days. The break in rainfall is expected to raise day temperatures by two or three degrees Celsius in a few pockets of the State. The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) has also forecast ground frost at isolated places in the Nilgiris and Kodaikanal till Sunday. The absence of widespread rainfall has pushed various districts, including Tiruvarur, Thanjavur, Madurai, Salem, and Chengalpattu, into the rainfall deficit category. The State has so far received nearly 26 cm of monsoon rainfall, which is 14% lower than its seasonal share since October 1. RMC officials said Cyclone Akvan was expected to weaken into a depression on Friday, and gradually fade away. V.R. Durai, Head, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, RMC, said dry and cold northwesterly winds and the absence of cloud cover and rainfall led to a rise in day temperatures and drop in minimum temperatures over most parts of the State. A trough in the easterly wave is likely to revive rainfall activity from Sunday and bring intense rainfall from Monday as it moves across the State. While coastal districts are expected to benefit more, interior Tamil Nadu is also likely to receive moderate rainfall till November 26. “We are expecting wet weather in the State till December first week, with a low pressure area likely to form then. The sustained rainfall activity may narrow rainfall deficit,” he said. The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall over coastal districts, including Chennai, Cuddalore, and Nagapattinam, on Sunday and mild rainfall over areas adjoining coastal districts.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Experience (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Experience' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Kodaikanal (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Kodaikanal' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resume over T.N. from tomorrow", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

D. The author contends that 'Following Cyclone Akvan, monsoon rain to resu' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "On Monday, rainfall is expected to intensify over 10 coastal districts, including Cuddalore, Thoothukudi, and Kanniyakumari." articles.title: Lawyer seeks to probate will left behind by former DGP’s wife: Madras High Court orders CB-CID probe after suspecting its genuineness
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar direct incumbent DGP Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that an investigation gets conducted after registering a FIR

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Madras High Court has ordered a Crime Branch-Criminal Investigation Department (CB-CID) probe into a claim made by a lawyer that former Director General of Police K. Ravindran’s wife Rani Ravindran alias Rani Pushpalatha Ravindran had appointed him as the executor of a will left behind by her bequeathing all her valuable properties in Chennai and New Delhi to her personal assistant. A Division Bench of Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar directed the incumbent Director General of Police/Head of Police Force (DGP/HoPF) Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that the CB-CID registers a First Information Report (FIR) regarding the claim made by advocate E. Paramasivan, conducts an investigation and files a status report before the court by December 14, 2026. The judges asked Additional Public Prosecutor M. Mohamed Riyaz to convey their order to the DGP/HoPF forthwith so that the investigation could commence as early as possible. “Prima facie, we are satisfied that this is nothing but a clear case of land grabbing by the lawyers, particularly against elderly persons whose legal heirs are not residing in the city,” the judges wrote. Advocate C.K. Chandrasekar, representing the Administrator General and Official Trustee (AG&OT) of Tamil Nadu told the court that the deceased woman’s grandson was living in Australia but that fact had been suppressed in a petition filed before a single judge of the High Court last year seeking probate of a supposed will. The Bench directed the AG&OT to take possession of all properties and communicate it to the legal heirs. The directions were issued on an appeal preferred by Mr. Paramasivan against the refusal of Justice A.D. Maria Clete to grant probate after suspecting the genuineness of the supposed will. The judge had taken note that the former DGP had died in 2021 and his wife had passed away in Chennai on May 2, 2025. Mr. Paramasivan had approached the court claiming that the couple were issueless. He also claimed that the deceased woman had executed a will bequeathing all her properties in the name of her caretaker S. Dilip Kumar and had appointed the petitioner as the executor of the will. However, Justice Clete found that the undated will did not contain the testatrix’s signature but only a thumb impression on each page and no other document was produced in court to compare the thumb impressions. Though the petitioner had claimed to be the deceased woman’s lawyer for about 10 years, he had failed to produce any material to prove the claimed professional relationship. “On the contrary, he admitted that the testatrix had no litigation pending before any court in Chennai and that he had never represented her in any legal proceedings,” the judge highlighted. “In the absence of any evidence regarding the nature of the legal services rendered by the petitioner, it remains unexplained how he came to be appointed as the sole executor under the will. Ordinarily, the appointment of an executor reflects a relationship of confidence, trust, or close association between the testator and the executor,” the judge said. She was also not convinced with the explanation given by Mr. Paramasivan for the existence of the words ‘Drafted by Self’ on the last page of the will though he claimed to have drafted the document. The lawyer said, those words were included because the Registration department always insists such a mention in a will before accepting it for registration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The above explanation is unconvincing. There is no legal provision or established practice that prohibits an advocate or a licensed document writer from mentioning their name in a will they have drafted. On the contrary, it is common for the scribe of a will, whether an advocate or a document writer, to disclose their identity and sign the document,” the judge said.

Ravindran’s wife Rani Ravindran alias Rani Pushpalatha Ravindran had appointed him as the executor of a will left behind by her bequeathing all her valuable properties in Chennai and New Delhi to her personal assistant. A Division Bench of Justices N. Sathish Kumar and G.K. Muthukumaar directed the incumbent Director General of Police/Head of Police Force (DGP/HoPF) Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal to ensure that the CB-CID registers a First Information Report (FIR) regarding the claim made by advocate E. Paramasivan, conducts an investigation and files a status report before the court by December 14, 2026. The judges asked Additional Public Prosecutor M. Mohamed Riyaz to convey their order to the DGP/HoPF forthwith so that the investigation could commence as early as possible. “Prima facie, we are satisfied that this is nothing but a clear case of land grabbing by the lawyers, particularly against elderly persons whose legal heirs are not residing in the city,” the judges wrote. Advocate C.K. Chandrasekar, representing the Administrator General and Official Trustee (AG&OT) of Tamil Nadu told the court that the deceased woman’s grandson was living in Australia but that fact had been suppressed in a petition filed before a single judge of the High Court last year seeking probate of a supposed will. The Bench directed the AG&OT to take possession of all properties and communicate it to the legal heirs. The directions were issued on an appeal preferred by Mr. Paramasivan against the refusal of Justice A.D. Maria Clete to grant probate after suspecting the genuineness of the supposed will. The judge had taken note that the former DGP had died in 2021 and his wife had passed away in Chennai on May 2, 2025. Mr. Paramasivan had approached the court claiming that the couple were issueless. He also claimed that the deceased woman had executed a will bequeathing all her properties in the name of her caretaker S. Dilip Kumar and had appointed the petitioner as the executor of the will. However, Justice Clete found that the undated will did not contain the testatrix’s signature but only a thumb impression on each page and no other document was produced in court to compare the thumb impressions. Though the petitioner had claimed to be the deceased woman’s lawyer for about 10 years, he had failed to produce any material to prove the claimed professional relationship. “On the contrary, he admitted that the testatrix had no litigation pending before any court in Chennai and that he had never represented her in any legal proceedings,” the judge highlighted. “In the absence of any evidence regarding the nature of the legal services rendered by the petitioner, it remains unexplained how he came to be appointed as the sole executor under the will. Ordinarily, the appointment of an executor reflects a relationship of confidence, trust, or close association between the testator and the executor,” the judge said. She was also not convinced with the explanation given by Mr. Paramasivan for the existence of the words ‘Drafted by Self’ on the last page of the will though he claimed to have drafted the document. The lawyer said, those words were included because the Registration department always insists such a mention in a will before accepting it for registration.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The above explanation is unconvincing. There is no legal provision or established practice that prohibits an advocate or a licensed document writer from mentioning their name in a will they have drafted. On the contrary, it is common for the scribe of a will, whether an advocate or a document writer, to disclose their identity and sign the document,” the judge said.
