🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Food and Drug Administration seizes 20,085 litres of oil in Pune over violations of standards

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 07:08:03 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Officers conducted the operation at a facility of Avenue Supermarts Limited located in Ambi village and took possession of the stock at the warehouse over a breach of the rules that govern the food sector

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Food and Drug Administration carried out an operation in Pune district and seized 20,085 litres of oil with a value of ₹50.27 lakh because of violations of standards regarding quality and misbranding under the Food Safety and Standards Act. Officers conducted the operation on November 17, 2026, at a facility of Avenue Supermarts Limited, which operates the D-Mart chain of stores, located in Ambi village within Maval taluka, and they took possession of the stock at the warehouse over a breach of the rules that govern the food sector. During the inspection at the facility, authorities collected nine samples of oil that included oil derived from sunflower with the Aadhar name, oil derived from rice bran with the Fortune name, oil derived from mustard with the Patanjali name, and oils derived from mustard and groundnut with the Safola name, as stated in the release issued by the regulator. The department has dispatched the samples to a laboratory to undergo analysis, and officers will initiate proceedings under the law after they receive the results, according to a statement from Shrikant Karkale, who serves as commissioner at the Food and Drug Administration division that oversees food. The Food Safety and Standards Act governs the manufacturing, storage, distribution, and sale of food to ensure that the items that reach the public meet standards of quality, and the department secured the stock at the premises in Maval taluka while gathering the items for testing, which represents a step in the process the regulator follows when it encounters a breach of the rules that govern the food sector.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The nine samples represent a selection of the products that were present at the site, and the process of testing will determine whether the items matched the specifications required by the law, after which the department will decide on the course of action regarding the stock and the facility. The department will review the findings from the laboratory to establish whether the items complied with the requirements mandated by the legislation, and the outcome will dictate the steps the regulator will take regarding the facility and the stock held at the premises.

articles.title: Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Islam is projected to be the world's largest religion by 2035, surpassing Christianity, according to a new study released by the Pew Research Centre on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). Pew said if current trends continue, there will be more than 3.6 billion Muslims and just under three billion Christians worldwide by 2070. The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070. But the rest of the world's population -- all non-Hindus -- will grow at an even faster rate. As a result, Hindus will shrink slightly as a share of the global population, falling from 15% in 2020 to 14% in 2070. The world's total population is projected to increase by 29% between 2020 and 2070, with Christians growing by 30% and Muslims by 80%. "The largest source of new members of major religions is not adults who convert to the faith, but babies who are born into the group," the Pew projections found. During 2020-2025, the fertility rate for Muslims was 3.1 children per woman, followed by the rate for Christians at 2.5, Pew said. The average fertility rate for all other women was 1.6, below the 2.1 level considered necessary for each generation to replace itself. If current demographic trends continue, the number of Hindus in India will increase by 176 million between 2020 and 2070. While India's overall fertility rate has fallen rapidly in recent decades, Muslims in India still have more children per woman than Hindus do, the Pew Research found. As per the Pew projections, Hindus comprise 79.4% of India's religious composition in 2020 and the number is set to slide to 75.8% by 2070. Muslims comprise 15.2% of India's religious composition in 2020, and that share is set to rise to 19.6% by 2070. Outside India, much of the projected growth among Hindus will come from Pakistan (over five million) and the United States (over four million).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the Pew projections, the U.S. will have the world's fifth-largest Hindu population. Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:54:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Islam is projected to be the world's largest religion by 2035, surpassing Christianity, according to a new study released by the Pew Research Centre on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). Pew said if current trends continue, there will be more than 3.6 billion Muslims and just under three billion Christians worldwide by 2070. The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070. But the rest of the world's population -- all non-Hindus -- will grow at an even faster rate. As a result, Hindus will shrink slightly as a share of the global population, falling from 15% in 2020 to 14% in 2070. The world's total population is projected to increase by 29% between 2020 and 2070, with Christians growing by 30% and Muslims by 80%. "The largest source of new members of major religions is not adults who convert to the faith, but babies who are born into the group," the Pew projections found. During 2020-2025, the fertility rate for Muslims was 3.1 children per woman, followed by the rate for Christians at 2.5, Pew said. The average fertility rate for all other women was 1.6, below the 2.1 level considered necessary for each generation to replace itself. If current demographic trends continue, the number of Hindus in India will increase by 176 million between 2020 and 2070. While India's overall fertility rate has fallen rapidly in recent decades, Muslims in India still have more children per woman than Hindus do, the Pew Research found. As per the Pew projections, Hindus comprise 79.4% of India's religious composition in 2020 and the number is set to slide to 75.8% by 2070. Muslims comprise 15.2% of India's religious composition in 2020, and that share is set to rise to 19.6% by 2070. Outside India, much of the projected growth among Hindus will come from Pakistan (over five million) and the United States (over four million).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the Pew projections, the U.S. will have the world's fifth-largest Hindu population. Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority.

संघटन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Composition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070.

D. The author contends that 'Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 world' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research"?

As a result, Hindus will shrink slightly as a share of the global population, falling from 15% in 2020 to 14% in 2070. The world's total population is projected to increase by 29% between 2020 and 2070, with Christians growing by 30% and Muslims by 80%. "The largest source of new members of major religions is not adults who convert to the faith, but babies who are born into the group," the Pew projections found. During 2020-2025, the fertility rate for Muslims was 3.1 children per woman, followed by the rate for Christians at 2.5, Pew said. The average fertility rate for all other women was 1.6, below the 2.1 level considered necessary for each generation to replace itself. If current demographic trends continue, the number of Hindus in India will increase by 176 million between 2020 and 2070. While India's overall fertility rate has fallen rapidly in recent decades, Muslims in India still have more children per woman than Hindus do, the Pew Research found. As per the Pew projections, Hindus comprise 79.4% of India's religious composition in 2020 and the number is set to slide to 75.8% by 2070. Muslims comprise 15.2% of India's religious composition in 2020, and that share is set to rise to 19.6% by 2070. Outside India, much of the projected growth among Hindus will come from Pakistan (over five million) and the United States (over four million).
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the Pew projections, the U.S. will have the world's fifth-largest Hindu population. Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority.

articles.title: Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year on nearly 2,000 defunct public taps
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nearly 2,000 of the 5,358 public taps identified in the city remain dysfunctional, for which the Kochi Corporation continues to pay the Kerala Water Authority (KWA) over ₹4 crore annually, resulting in a drain on the resources of the cash-strapped civic body. A recent survey conducted by the Corporation through its overseers, in consultation with division councillors, found that 3,303 public taps were functional, while 1,995 were non-functional across the city. Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore. According to a letter issued by the KWA on November 6, 2025, there were 5,444 public taps within the city limits. The latest survey shows a marginal decline of 86 taps. Until the previous government completely wrote off the water charge arrears, around ₹5 crore used to be deducted annually from the Corporation’s Plan fund towards the dues. Mayor V.K. Minimol said that despite free water connections provided under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation, several divisions still had more than 50 and even 100 public taps. The 18 divisions in West Kochi alone accounted for 2,216 taps, of which 1,623 were non-functional, translating into an annual expenditure of over ₹3.54 crore. Earavely division has the highest number of taps (263), followed by Mattancherry (215), Kalvathy (189), and Karippalam (174). “Councillors should take a serious look at this list and scrutinise it further so that only those taps that are absolutely necessary are retained and the rest surrendered to the KWA. To check misuse of public taps, they will be remodelled with concrete structures, as was done in the past, and fitted with meters,” Ms. Minimol said. LDF parliamentary party leader V.A. Sreejith said that while taps that are no longer in use could be surrendered, councillors should not be made responsible for issuing letters to the KWA seeking their removal. This, he said, would spare councillors from having to bear the brunt of public resentment over such a move.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: BJP councillor Priya Prasanth said it was imperative to ensure the availability of drinking water in an area before scrapping an existing public tap. Despite having water connections, there could still be households without a reliable water supply and, therefore, dependent on public taps. Such taps should be retained, she added.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year on nearly 2,000 defunct public taps

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 06:41:59 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nearly 2,000 of the 5,358 public taps identified in the city remain dysfunctional, for which the Kochi Corporation continues to pay the Kerala Water Authority (KWA) over ₹4 crore annually, resulting in a drain on the resources of the cash-strapped civic body. A recent survey conducted by the Corporation through its overseers, in consultation with division councillors, found that 3,303 public taps were functional, while 1,995 were non-functional across the city. Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore. According to a letter issued by the KWA on November 6, 2025, there were 5,444 public taps within the city limits. The latest survey shows a marginal decline of 86 taps. Until the previous government completely wrote off the water charge arrears, around ₹5 crore used to be deducted annually from the Corporation’s Plan fund towards the dues. Mayor V.K. Minimol said that despite free water connections provided under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation, several divisions still had more than 50 and even 100 public taps. The 18 divisions in West Kochi alone accounted for 2,216 taps, of which 1,623 were non-functional, translating into an annual expenditure of over ₹3.54 crore. Earavely division has the highest number of taps (263), followed by Mattancherry (215), Kalvathy (189), and Karippalam (174). “Councillors should take a serious look at this list and scrutinise it further so that only those taps that are absolutely necessary are retained and the rest surrendered to the KWA. To check misuse of public taps, they will be remodelled with concrete structures, as was done in the past, and fitted with meters,” Ms. Minimol said. LDF parliamentary party leader V.A. Sreejith said that while taps that are no longer in use could be surrendered, councillors should not be made responsible for issuing letters to the KWA seeking their removal. This, he said, would spare councillors from having to bear the brunt of public resentment over such a move.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: BJP councillor Priya Prasanth said it was imperative to ensure the availability of drinking water in an area before scrapping an existing public tap. Despite having water connections, there could still be households without a reliable water supply and, therefore, dependent on public taps. Such taps should be retained, she added.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Transformation (Noun)
परिवर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transformation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Dysfunctional (Adjective)
बेकार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Dysfunctional' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Irrespective (Adjective)
निरपेक्ष — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Irrespective' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year on nearly 2,000 defunct public taps", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year on' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore." (Hinglish Arth: प्रत्येक सार्वजनिक नल पर निगम को प्रति वर्ष ₹21,838 का खर्च आता है, भले ही वह कार्यात्मक हो या नहीं, जिससे कुल वार्षिक व्यय ₹11.70 करोड़ हो जाता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year on nearly 2,000 defunct public taps"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Such taps should be retained, she added.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Such taps should be retained, she added." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा कि ऐसे नलों को बरकरार रखा जाना चाहिए।)

articles.title: Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid transit network
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The proposal is under active consideration, with the first phase envisaged between Kukatpally and Knowledge City via Raidurgam and Biodiversity Park

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With traffic congestion worsening as the city expands, Hyderabad is exploring a 35-km Personal Rapid Transit System (PRTS) to improve connectivity along key corridors. The proposal is under active consideration, with the first phase envisaged between Kukatpally and Knowledge City via Raidurgam and Biodiversity Park. The proposed stretch would have 64 stations. Officials made a presentation on the plan to Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju at a meeting here on Wednesday. The presentation followed directions from the Chief Secretary to prepare an action plan after Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy suggested exploring PRTS as an alternative mode of transport to ease congestion along important corridors. Mr. Jaju called for a comprehensive strategy to address the growing traffic challenges arising from the city’s rapid expansion. Hyderabad Metro Rail officials, who studied the feasibility of PRTS and other transport systems, projected daily commuter demand at 3.94 lakh by 2030, 7.96 lakh by 2040 and 10 lakh by 2050. Mr. Jaju asked officials to identify potential PRTS corridors based on traffic density and ensure optimum use of existing transport systems. He also stressed that the proposed network should be developed at minimum cost. Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited officials were directed to expedite consultations with technical experts and potential project partners.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also called for effective coordination among departments, including Municipal Administration, Energy, South Central Railway and HYDRAA, to ensure integrated traffic planning that takes the city’s future needs into account.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid transit network

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 06:38:08 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The proposal is under active consideration, with the first phase envisaged between Kukatpally and Knowledge City via Raidurgam and Biodiversity Park

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: With traffic congestion worsening as the city expands, Hyderabad is exploring a 35-km Personal Rapid Transit System (PRTS) to improve connectivity along key corridors. The proposal is under active consideration, with the first phase envisaged between Kukatpally and Knowledge City via Raidurgam and Biodiversity Park. The proposed stretch would have 64 stations. Officials made a presentation on the plan to Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju at a meeting here on Wednesday. The presentation followed directions from the Chief Secretary to prepare an action plan after Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy suggested exploring PRTS as an alternative mode of transport to ease congestion along important corridors. Mr. Jaju called for a comprehensive strategy to address the growing traffic challenges arising from the city’s rapid expansion. Hyderabad Metro Rail officials, who studied the feasibility of PRTS and other transport systems, projected daily commuter demand at 3.94 lakh by 2030, 7.96 lakh by 2040 and 10 lakh by 2050. Mr. Jaju asked officials to identify potential PRTS corridors based on traffic density and ensure optimum use of existing transport systems. He also stressed that the proposed network should be developed at minimum cost. Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited officials were directed to expedite consultations with technical experts and potential project partners.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also called for effective coordination among departments, including Municipal Administration, Energy, South Central Railway and HYDRAA, to ensure integrated traffic planning that takes the city’s future needs into account.

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Administration (Noun)
प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Consideration (Noun)
सोच-विचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consideration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Comprehensive (Adjective)
विस्तृत — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Comprehensive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid transit network", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The proposal is under active consideration, with the first phase envisaged between Kukatpally and Knowledge City via Raidurgam and Biodiversity Park.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid transit ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid trans' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid trans' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Hyderabad explores 35-km personal rapid transit network"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He also called for effective coordination among departments, including Municipal Administration, Energy, South Central Railway and HYDRAA, to ensure...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He also called for effective coordination among departments, including Municipal Administration, Energy, South Central Railway and HYDRAA, to ensure..." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने एकीकृत यातायात योजना सुनिश्चित करने के लिए नगर प्रशासन, ऊर्जा, दक्षिण मध्य रेलवे और हाइड्रा सहित विभागों के बीच प्रभावी समन्वय का भी आह्वान किया, जो शहर की भविष्य की जरूरतों को ध्यान में रखता है।)

articles.title: Census 2027: ‘Other’ religions list made predictive text, over 200 entries from earlier list dropped
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: This comes days after The Hindu reported that at least 287 entries such as ISKCON, Gorak Nath, Sanatan, Vedic Dharm, Ramdev etc. had been listed in a drop-down menu for “Other” religions on the portal and then removed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The 2027 Census self-enumeration portal is now showing a total of 76 entries under the “Other” religions that now appear as predictive text suggestions and not as a drop-down menu. This comes days after The Hindu reported that at least 287 entries such as ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Gorak Nath , Sanatan, Vedic Dharm, Ramdev etc., had been listed in a drop-down menu for “Other” religions on the portal and then removed. An examination of the new list of available “Other” religions showed that the Union government removed over 200 entries that were previously listed under the same category on Monday (November 16, 2026), the day the portal went live for four poll-bound States — Uttar Pradesh, Goa, Punjab and Uttarakhand. The deletions include entries such as Satguru, Ramdev, ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Gorak Nath, Sanatan, Bishnoi, Vaishnaw, Shia, Sunni, and many others that were either classified in earlier Censuses as sects within the six major religions (Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist) or seemed to be new entries not recorded in previous Censuses at all. Out of the 76 predictive text suggestions that now remain on the portal, nearly all appear to have already been recorded and tabulated based on the 2011 Census data on what people chose to write their faith as under the “Other” column. A majority of these entries include the religions and faiths of Scheduled Tribe communities across the country — such as Sarna, Doni Polo, Tana Bhagat, Birsa, Garo, Munda, Oraon, Santal, etc. Apart from these, five entries in this new list of suggestive “other” religions do not feature in the 2011 or 2001 Census tables for “Other religions and persuasions”. These include “Adibasi dharma”, “Bura Deo”, “Karupa”, “Tingkao Rangong”, and “Tingwang Hingde”. Soon after The Hindu reported the presence of a drop-down for “other” religions and its quick removal, Opposition leaders and OBC associations alike questioned the integrity of the way the 2027 Census was being conducted, with many of them questioning how the government was comfortable introducing a drop-down for religions but not for caste. Experts had also questioned the introduction of previously unrecorded entries in this drop-down, saying there would be nothing to compare these with. Interestingly, a section of general category communities in north India reacted to the presence of 287 “other” religions by saying this was an alleged attempt to “divide Hindus”. On Monday (November 16, 2026), when the self-enumeration portal went live, the initial list of 287 entries for “Other” religions appeared as a drop-down menu from which respondents could select one in addition to writing in whatever they wanted. Within hours of The Hindu sending a query to the Union Home Ministry, this drop-down menu was removed, and a representative of the Office of the RGI and the Census Commissioner said it would be “incorrect” to say these entries were shown as “other” religions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: However, a government official had told The Hindu at the time that this list was part of “predictive text entries” to help reduce variations and mistakes in spellings. But officials did not clarify how previously unrecorded entries such as ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Ramdev, Gorak Nath, etc. had appeared on this list either.

Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "But officials did not clarify how previously unrecorded entries such as ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Ramdev, Gorak Nath, etc." (Hinglish Arth: लेकिन अधिकारियों ने यह स्पष्ट नहीं किया कि इस्कॉन, रामकृष्ण परमहंस, रामदेव, गोरक नाथ आदि जैसी पहले दर्ज न की गई प्रविष्टियाँ कैसे जारी की गईं।)

hinglishTracks.en: This comes days after The Hindu reported that at least 287 entries such as ISKCON, Gorak Nath, Sanatan, Vedic Dharm, Ramdev etc.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह द हिंदू की रिपोर्ट के कुछ दिनों बाद आया है कि कम से कम 287 प्रविष्टियाँ जैसे कि इस्कॉन, गोरक नाथ, सनातन, वैदिक धर्म, रामदेव आदि।।

hinglishTracks.en: had been listed in a drop-down menu for “Other” religions on the portal and then removed
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — पोर्टल पर "अन्य" धर्मों के लिए ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू में सूचीबद्ध किया गया था और फिर हटा दिया गया था।

hinglishTracks.en: The 2027 Census self-enumeration portal is now showing a total of 76 entries under the “Other” religions that now appear as predictive text suggestions and not as a drop-down menu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2027 की जनगणना स्व-गणना पोर्टल अब "अन्य" धर्मों के तहत कुल 76 प्रविष्टियाँ दिखा रहा है जो अब पूर्वानुमानित पाठ सुझावों के रूप में दिखाई देते हैं न कि ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू के रूप में।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: This comes days after The Hindu reported that at least 287 entries such as ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Gorak Nath , Sanatan, Vedic Dharm, Ramdev etc., had been listed in a drop-down menu for “Other” religions on the portal and then removed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह द हिंदू की रिपोर्ट के कुछ दिनों बाद आया है कि इस्कॉन, रामकृष्ण परमहंस, गोरक नाथ, सनातन, वैदिक धर्म, रामदेव आदि जैसी कम से कम 287 प्रविष्टियों को पोर्टल पर "अन्य" धर्मों के लिए ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू में सूचीबद्ध किया गया था और फिर हटा दिया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: An examination of the new list of available “Other” religions showed that the Union government removed over 200 entries that were previously listed under the same category on Monday (November 16, 2026), the day the portal went live for four poll-bound States — Uttar Pradesh, Goa, Punjab and Uttarakhand.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उपलब्ध "अन्य" धर्मों की नई सूची की जांच से पता चला कि केंद्र सरकार ने 200 से अधिक प्रविष्टियाँ हटा दीं जो पहले सोमवार (16 नवंबर, 2026) को उसी श्रेणी के तहत सूचीबद्ध थीं, जिस दिन पोर्टल चार चुनावी राज्यों - उत्तर प्रदेश, गोवा, पंजाब और उत्तराखंड के लिए लाइव हुआ था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The deletions include entries such as Satguru, Ramdev, ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Gorak Nath, Sanatan, Bishnoi, Vaishnaw, Shia, Sunni, and many others that were either classified in earlier Censuses as sects within the six major religions (Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist) or seemed to be new entries not recorded in previous Censuses at all.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हटाई गई प्रविष्टियों में सतगुरु, रामदेव, इस्कॉन, रामकृष्ण परमहंस, गोरख नाथ, सनातन, बिश्नोई, वैष्णव, शिया, सुन्नी और कई अन्य प्रविष्टियाँ शामिल हैं जिन्हें या तो पहले की जनगणनाओं में छह प्रमुख धर्मों (हिंदू, मुस्लिम, ईसाई, सिख, जैन, बौद्ध) के भीतर संप्रदायों के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया था या ऐसी नई प्रविष्टियाँ प्रतीत होती थीं जो पिछली जनगणनाओं में बिल्कुल भी दर्ज नहीं की गई थीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Out of the 76 predictive text suggestions that now remain on the portal, nearly all appear to have already been recorded and tabulated based on the 2011 Census data on what people chose to write their faith as under the “Other” column.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अब पोर्टल पर मौजूद 76 पूर्वानुमानित पाठ सुझावों में से लगभग सभी को 2011 की जनगणना के आंकड़ों के आधार पर पहले ही रिकॉर्ड और सारणीबद्ध किया जा चुका है कि लोगों ने "अन्य" कॉलम के तहत अपने विश्वास को लिखने के लिए क्या चुना है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: A majority of these entries include the religions and faiths of Scheduled Tribe communities across the country — such as Sarna, Doni Polo, Tana Bhagat, Birsa, Garo, Munda, Oraon, Santal, etc.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इनमें से अधिकांश प्रविष्टियों में देश भर के अनुसूचित जनजाति समुदायों के धर्म और आस्थाएं शामिल हैं - जैसे सरना, डोनी पोलो, टाना भगत, बिरसा, गारो, मुंडा, ओरांव, संथाल, आदि।।

hinglishTracks.en: Apart from these, five entries in this new list of suggestive “other” religions do not feature in the 2011 or 2001 Census tables for “Other religions and persuasions”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इनके अलावा, विचारोत्तेजक "अन्य" धर्मों की इस नई सूची में पांच प्रविष्टियाँ 2011 या 2001 की जनगणना तालिकाओं में "अन्य धर्म और अनुनय" के लिए शामिल नहीं हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: These include “Adibasi dharma”, “Bura Deo”, “Karupa”, “Tingkao Rangong”, and “Tingwang Hingde”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इनमें "आदिबासी धर्म", "बुरा देव", "करुपा", "तिंगकाओ रंगोंग" और "तिंगवांग हिंगड़े" शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Soon after The Hindu reported the presence of a drop-down for “other” religions and its quick removal, Opposition leaders and OBC associations alike questioned the integrity of the way the 2027 Census was being conducted, with many of them questioning how the government was comfortable introducing a drop-down for religions but not for caste.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — द हिंदू द्वारा "अन्य" धर्मों के लिए ड्रॉप-डाउन की उपस्थिति और इसके त्वरित निष्कासन की रिपोर्ट के तुरंत बाद, विपक्षी नेताओं और ओबीसी संघों ने समान रूप से 2027 की जनगणना के संचालन के तरीके की अखंडता पर सवाल उठाया, उनमें से कई ने सवाल उठाया कि सरकार कैसे धर्मों के लिए ड्रॉप-डाउन शुरू करने में सहज थी, लेकिन जाति के लिए नहीं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Introduction' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Introduction' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Experts had also questioned the introduction of previously unrecorded entries in this drop-down, saying there would be nothing to compare these with.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विशेषज्ञों ने इस ड्रॉप-डाउन में पहले से दर्ज न की गई प्रविष्टियों को शामिल करने पर भी सवाल उठाया था और कहा था कि इनकी तुलना करने के लिए कुछ भी नहीं होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Introduction' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Introduction' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: Interestingly, a section of general category communities in north India reacted to the presence of 287 “other” religions by saying this was an alleged attempt to “divide Hindus”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — दिलचस्प बात यह है कि उत्तर भारत में सामान्य श्रेणी के समुदायों के एक वर्ग ने 287 "अन्य" धर्मों की उपस्थिति पर प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त करते हुए कहा कि यह "हिंदुओं को विभाजित करने" का एक कथित प्रयास था।।

hinglishTracks.en: On Monday (November 16, 2026), when the self-enumeration portal went live, the initial list of 287 entries for “Other” religions appeared as a drop-down menu from which respondents could select one in addition to writing in whatever they wanted.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सोमवार (नवंबर 16, 2026) को, जब स्व-गणना पोर्टल लाइव हुआ, तो "अन्य" धर्मों के लिए 287 प्रविष्टियों की प्रारंभिक सूची एक ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू के रूप में दिखाई दी, जिसमें से उत्तरदाता जो चाहें लिखने के अलावा एक का चयन कर सकते थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enumeration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Enumeration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Within hours of The Hindu sending a query to the Union Home Ministry, this drop-down menu was removed, and a representative of the Office of the RGI and the Census Commissioner said it would be “incorrect” to say these entries were shown as “other” religions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — द हिंदू द्वारा केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय को प्रश्न भेजने के कुछ ही घंटों के भीतर, इस ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू को हटा दिया गया, और आरजीआई कार्यालय और जनगणना आयुक्त के एक प्रतिनिधि ने कहा कि यह कहना "गलत" होगा कि इन प्रविष्टियों को "अन्य" धर्मों के रूप में दिखाया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Representative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: However, a government official had told The Hindu at the time that this list was part of “predictive text entries” to help reduce variations and mistakes in spellings.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि, एक सरकारी अधिकारी ने उस समय द हिंदू को बताया था कि यह सूची वर्तनी में भिन्नता और गलतियों को कम करने में मदद करने के लिए "भविष्यवाणी पाठ प्रविष्टियों" का हिस्सा थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: But officials did not clarify how previously unrecorded entries such as ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Ramdev, Gorak Nath, etc.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन अधिकारियों ने यह स्पष्ट नहीं किया कि इस्कॉन, रामकृष्ण परमहंस, रामदेव, गोरक नाथ आदि जैसी पहले दर्ज न की गई प्रविष्टियाँ कैसे जारी की गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: had appeared on this list either.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — या तो इस सूची में दिखाई दिया था.।

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Census 2027: ‘Other’ religions list made predictive text, over 200 entries from earlier list dropped

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 11:14:58 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: This comes days after The Hindu reported that at least 287 entries such as ISKCON, Gorak Nath, Sanatan, Vedic Dharm, Ramdev etc. had been listed in a drop-down menu for “Other” religions on the portal and then removed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The 2027 Census self-enumeration portal is now showing a total of 76 entries under the “Other” religions that now appear as predictive text suggestions and not as a drop-down menu. This comes days after The Hindu reported that at least 287 entries such as ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Gorak Nath , Sanatan, Vedic Dharm, Ramdev etc., had been listed in a drop-down menu for “Other” religions on the portal and then removed. An examination of the new list of available “Other” religions showed that the Union government removed over 200 entries that were previously listed under the same category on Monday (November 16, 2026), the day the portal went live for four poll-bound States — Uttar Pradesh, Goa, Punjab and Uttarakhand. The deletions include entries such as Satguru, Ramdev, ISKCON, Ramkrishna Paramhans, Gorak Nath, Sanatan, Bishnoi, Vaishnaw, Shia, Sunni, and many others that were either classified in earlier Censuses as sects within the six major religions (Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist) or seemed to be new entries not recorded in previous Censuses at all. Out of the 76 predictive text suggestions that now remain on the portal, nearly all appear to have already been recorded and tabulated based on the 2011 Census data on what people chose to write their faith as under the “Other” column. A majority of these entries include the religions and faiths of Scheduled Tribe communities across the country — such as Sarna, Doni Polo, Tana Bhagat, Birsa, Garo, Munda, Oraon, Santal, etc. Apart from these, five entries in this new list of suggestive “other” religions do not feature in the 2011 or 2001 Census tables for “Other religions and persuasions”. These include “Adibasi dharma”, “Bura Deo”, “Karupa”, “Tingkao Rangong”, and “Tingwang Hingde”. Soon after The Hindu reported the presence of a drop-down for “other” religions and its quick removal, Opposition leaders and OBC associations alike questioned the integrity of the way the 2027 Census was being conducted, with many of them questioning how the government was comfortable introducing a drop-down for religions but not for caste. Experts had also questioned the introduction of previously unrecorded entries in this drop-down, saying there would be nothing to compare these with. Interestingly, a section of general category communities in north India reacted to the presence of 287 “other” religions by saying this was an alleged attempt to “divide Hindus”. On Monday (November 16, 2026), when the self-enumeration portal went live, the initial list of 287 entries for “Other” religions appeared as a drop-down menu from which respondents could select one in addition to writing in whatever they wanted. articles.title: Congress targets Modi government over inflation, seeks white paper on rising prices
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Kharge says common person’s plate is getting smaller, pockets getting emptier, and making ends meet is getting harder

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Accusing the Narendra Modi government of failing to control inflation, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) said the country's progress should be measured by the food on people’s plates and the money in their pockets, not the length of the Prime Minister's speeches. His colleague and the party's communication chief, Jairam Ramesh, asked the Prime Minister to come out with a white paper on inflation. “Modi ji promised to bring down inflation, but today the situation is such that the common person’s plate is getting smaller, their pockets are getting emptier, and making ends meet is becoming increasingly difficult,” Mr. Kharge said in a post on X. Pointing to the rise in prices of essential commodities over the past 12 years, he said the cost of wheat flour had risen from ₹21 to ₹69 per kg, pigeon peas from ₹75 to ₹180, mustard oil from ₹102 to ₹263, and milk from ₹36 to ₹85. “The measure of the country’s progress is not the length of your speeches, but the food on the common person’s plate and the money left in their pocket. How much longer will people keep paying the price for your economic mismanagement?” the Congress president asked. Mr. Ramesh flagged the impact of rising prices on household budgets, citing reports of impending price increases in consumer goods ranging from smartphones and televisions to biscuits and salt. He said companies were either raising prices or reducing the quantity in packets, leaving consumers with less for their money. Retail inflation had reached 6.09% in October, with food inflation at 8.94%, while wholesale inflation stood at 12.29%, Mr. Ramesh said, adding that the latter was the highest under the current Wholesale Price Index series. He said that inflationary pressures were now affecting both household spending and production costs. Citing a survey, he said 61% of households had seen their monthly expenditure on essential items rise by more than 20% over the past year, while 74% had been forced to cut down on non-essential spending.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also flagged the possibility of higher equated monthly instalments following the Reserve Bank of India’s October increase in the repo rate.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Congress targets Modi government over inflation, seeks white paper on rising prices

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 06:31:26 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Kharge says common person’s plate is getting smaller, pockets getting emptier, and making ends meet is getting harder

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Accusing the Narendra Modi government of failing to control inflation, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) said the country's progress should be measured by the food on people’s plates and the money in their pockets, not the length of the Prime Minister's speeches. His colleague and the party's communication chief, Jairam Ramesh, asked the Prime Minister to come out with a white paper on inflation. “Modi ji promised to bring down inflation, but today the situation is such that the common person’s plate is getting smaller, their pockets are getting emptier, and making ends meet is becoming increasingly difficult,” Mr. Kharge said in a post on X. Pointing to the rise in prices of essential commodities over the past 12 years, he said the cost of wheat flour had risen from ₹21 to ₹69 per kg, pigeon peas from ₹75 to ₹180, mustard oil from ₹102 to ₹263, and milk from ₹36 to ₹85. “The measure of the country’s progress is not the length of your speeches, but the food on the common person’s plate and the money left in their pocket. How much longer will people keep paying the price for your economic mismanagement?” the Congress president asked. Mr. Ramesh flagged the impact of rising prices on household budgets, citing reports of impending price increases in consumer goods ranging from smartphones and televisions to biscuits and salt. He said companies were either raising prices or reducing the quantity in packets, leaving consumers with less for their money. Retail inflation had reached 6.09% in October, with food inflation at 8.94%, while wholesale inflation stood at 12.29%, Mr. Ramesh said, adding that the latter was the highest under the current Wholesale Price Index series. He said that inflationary pressures were now affecting both household spending and production costs. Citing a survey, he said 61% of households had seen their monthly expenditure on essential items rise by more than 20% over the past year, while 74% had been forced to cut down on non-essential spending.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also flagged the possibility of higher equated monthly instalments following the Reserve Bank of India’s October increase in the repo rate.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Quantitative (Adjective)
आंकड़ों और संख्या पर आधारित — जिसे ठोस नंबरों और डेटा में मापा जा सके।
✓ Syn: Measurable, Numerical, Empirical  |  ✖ Ant: Qualitative, Subjective, Unmeasurable
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
Communication (Noun)
संचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Communication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Mismanagement (Adjective)
कुप्रबंध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Mismanagement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Congress targets Modi government over inflation, seeks white paper on rising prices", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Kharge says common person’s plate is getting smaller, pockets getting emptier, and making ends meet is getting harder.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Congress targets Modi government over inflation,' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Congress targets Modi government over inflati' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Congress targets Modi government over inflati' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Kharge says common person’s plate is getting smaller, pockets getting emptier, and making ends meet is getting harder." (Hinglish Arth: खड़गे का कहना है कि आम आदमी की थाली छोटी होती जा रही है, जेब खाली होती जा रही है और गुजारा करना मुश्किल होता जा रहा है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Congress targets Modi government over inflation, seeks white paper on rising prices"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He also flagged the possibility of higher equated monthly instalments following the Reserve Bank of India’s October increase in the repo rate.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He also flagged the possibility of higher equated monthly instalments following the Reserve Bank of India’s October increase in the repo rate." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक द्वारा अक्टूबर में रेपो दर में वृद्धि के बाद उच्च समान मासिक किस्तों की संभावना को भी हरी झंडी दिखाई।)

articles.title: Xi, Trump, Putin exchange greetings before historic China summit
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The agenda for the November 19 meeting between Presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin -- which has raised fears of a carve-up into new "spheres of influence" -- was unclear

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The leaders of China, the United States and Russia exchanged greetings as they met in Shenzhen on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), a day before their history-making first formal trilateral summit in the Chinese city. The agenda for Thursday's (November 19, 2026) meeting between Presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin -- which has raised fears of a carve-up into new "spheres of influence" -- was unclear, however. And the three-way meeting was set to last "no more than an hour", Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Russian state media Wednesday (November 18, 2026). When Mr. Trump touched down in Shenzhen, Mr. Xi became the first Chinese paramount leader in decades to welcome a foreign leader as he arrived, mirroring the U.S. President's gesture at Joint Base Andrews in September. Mr. Trump descended the stairs from his plane to be met by Mr. Xi, as well as renditions of both countries' national anthems and fighter jets that flew overhead and left colourful vapour trails. The pair strolled down a red carpet lined with people waving pom-poms, brandishing Chinese and U.S. national flags, and shouting: "A warm welcome to you!" A motorcade of dark limousines later carried Mr. Trump into the city, where the streets had been cleared of traffic, an AFP reporter observed. Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump, Mr. Putin and other leaders attending the broader Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit then gathered for a welcome dinner, and the three briefly exchanged greetings before a group photo. "I look forward to an in-depth exchange of views with you on major issues concerning China-U.S. relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the global landscape, with the aim of advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship between our two nations," Mr. Xi told Trump, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Washington had signalled that the Ukraine war -- something Mr. Xi vehemently sees as not China's problem -- was not expected to be addressed in the trilateral meeting, before Mr. Trump said that it would.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Xi, Trump, Putin exchange greetings before historic China summit

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:49:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The agenda for the November 19 meeting between Presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin -- which has raised fears of a carve-up into new "spheres of influence" -- was unclear

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The leaders of China, the United States and Russia exchanged greetings as they met in Shenzhen on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), a day before their history-making first formal trilateral summit in the Chinese city. The agenda for Thursday's (November 19, 2026) meeting between Presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin -- which has raised fears of a carve-up into new "spheres of influence" -- was unclear, however. And the three-way meeting was set to last "no more than an hour", Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Russian state media Wednesday (November 18, 2026). When Mr. Trump touched down in Shenzhen, Mr. Xi became the first Chinese paramount leader in decades to welcome a foreign leader as he arrived, mirroring the U.S. President's gesture at Joint Base Andrews in September. Mr. Trump descended the stairs from his plane to be met by Mr. Xi, as well as renditions of both countries' national anthems and fighter jets that flew overhead and left colourful vapour trails. The pair strolled down a red carpet lined with people waving pom-poms, brandishing Chinese and U.S. national flags, and shouting: "A warm welcome to you!" A motorcade of dark limousines later carried Mr. Trump into the city, where the streets had been cleared of traffic, an AFP reporter observed. Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump, Mr. Putin and other leaders attending the broader Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit then gathered for a welcome dinner, and the three briefly exchanged greetings before a group photo. "I look forward to an in-depth exchange of views with you on major issues concerning China-U.S. relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the global landscape, with the aim of advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship between our two nations," Mr. Xi told Trump, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua .

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Washington had signalled that the Ukraine war -- something Mr. Xi vehemently sees as not China's problem -- was not expected to be addressed in the trilateral meeting, before Mr. Trump said that it would.

Trilateral (Adjective)
त्रिपक्षीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Trilateral' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Influence (Adjective / Verb)
प्रभाव — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Influence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Mr. Trump descended the stairs from his plane to be met by Mr. Xi, as well as renditions of both countries' national anthems and fighter jets that flew overhead and left colourful vapour trails. The pair strolled down a red carpet lined with people waving pom-poms, brandishing Chinese and U.S. national flags, and shouting: "A warm welcome to you!" A motorcade of dark limousines later carried Mr. Trump into the city, where the streets had been cleared of traffic, an AFP reporter observed. Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump, Mr. Putin and other leaders attending the broader Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit then gathered for a welcome dinner, and the three briefly exchanged greetings before a group photo. "I look forward to an in-depth exchange of views with you on major issues concerning China-U.S. relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the global landscape, with the aim of advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship between our two nations," Mr. Xi told Trump, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua .

articles.title: SFI, ABVP clash over rival bookstalls on Kolkata's College Street
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The face-off erupted after members of the ABVP sought to set up a bookstall selling nationalist literature in front of a stall organised by the SFI, which had planned a three-day mini book fair showcasing leftist and progressive writings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Members of Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) clashed with the activists of Students’ Federation of India (SFI) over setting up a book stall at in Kolkata’s College Street area. . The clashes which erupted in the afternoon continued till late in the evening, with confrontations involving the throwing of eggs, stones and firecrackers. Both the groups clashed over space for holding book stalls in the city’s College Street area, which is also known as the book hub of the city, with hundreds of bookstores selling books. The development comes a day after police had detained SFI supporters were detained by police for holding a book stall. At around 11 a.m. on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), a group of SFI activists started preparing a stall a few metres away from their scheduled spot after getting permission from the police. However, a group of ABVP members reached the spot and asked them to show the letter of permission. When the SFI members told ABVP supporters about the police’s approval, they raised objections over some books on the history and ideology of communism. A few moments later, they started vandalising the shop and books escalating the tension in the area once again. The police intervened and tried to prevent supporters of both the groups from coming togather. Meanwhile, the ABVP members also demanded the police to let them set up another stall, next to the one set up by SFI. They also brought some of the books on several Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh leaders, along with ones by Rabindranath Tagore, and Jagadish Chandra Bose while raising slogans against the SFI. “Yes, we have objections over many of their [SFI] history books. Those books are potent to create an anarchy in the society. We will not let it happen. We have also sought permission from the police to let us set up another stall next to theirs. We want to sell books on nationalism and the true history of our country,” an ABVP activist told mediapersons By the afternoon, the ABVP activists were also seen arranging a table next to the SFI stall and sell books. Later in the day, when Left Front chairperson Biman Bose was met with “Go back’ slogan by SFI activists when he visited the site. The dispute over the book stalls run by the Left parties started during Durga Puja. Police and civic bodies demolished several stalls set up by the parties across Kolkata. In Jadavpur, a bulldozer was also brought to dismantle a shop sparking a huge political controversy. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari called the supporters of Left parties ‘atheist’ and declared that they would not be allowed to set up their bookstalls near puja pandals, where such stalls have been a fixture for decades. On Tuesday (November 17, 2026), the SFI activists said that they sought permission from the Kolkata Police to let them set up a bookstall at a makeshift stall on the footpath of College Street. But the police refused to give permission on Monday (November 16, 2026) evening, stating that it may disrupt the traffic. The bookstall was part of a three-day campaign, ‘Sangrami Boipotro’, by the party.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A ruckus erupted between the SFI activists and the police when they blocked the College Street, and started selling their books by laying out a sheet on the tram line.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 SFI, ABVP clash over rival bookstalls on Kolkata's College Street

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 08:15:08 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The face-off erupted after members of the ABVP sought to set up a bookstall selling nationalist literature in front of a stall organised by the SFI, which had planned a three-day mini book fair showcasing leftist and progressive writings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Members of Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) clashed with the activists of Students’ Federation of India (SFI) over setting up a book stall at in Kolkata’s College Street area. . The clashes which erupted in the afternoon continued till late in the evening, with confrontations involving the throwing of eggs, stones and firecrackers. Both the groups clashed over space for holding book stalls in the city’s College Street area, which is also known as the book hub of the city, with hundreds of bookstores selling books. The development comes a day after police had detained SFI supporters were detained by police for holding a book stall. At around 11 a.m. on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), a group of SFI activists started preparing a stall a few metres away from their scheduled spot after getting permission from the police. However, a group of ABVP members reached the spot and asked them to show the letter of permission. When the SFI members told ABVP supporters about the police’s approval, they raised objections over some books on the history and ideology of communism. A few moments later, they started vandalising the shop and books escalating the tension in the area once again. The police intervened and tried to prevent supporters of both the groups from coming togather. Meanwhile, the ABVP members also demanded the police to let them set up another stall, next to the one set up by SFI. They also brought some of the books on several Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh leaders, along with ones by Rabindranath Tagore, and Jagadish Chandra Bose while raising slogans against the SFI. “Yes, we have objections over many of their [SFI] history books. Those books are potent to create an anarchy in the society. We will not let it happen. We have also sought permission from the police to let us set up another stall next to theirs. We want to sell books on nationalism and the true history of our country,” an ABVP activist told mediapersons By the afternoon, the ABVP activists were also seen arranging a table next to the SFI stall and sell books. Later in the day, when Left Front chairperson Biman Bose was met with “Go back’ slogan by SFI activists when he visited the site. The dispute over the book stalls run by the Left parties started during Durga Puja. Police and civic bodies demolished several stalls set up by the parties across Kolkata. In Jadavpur, a bulldozer was also brought to dismantle a shop sparking a huge political controversy. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari called the supporters of Left parties ‘atheist’ and declared that they would not be allowed to set up their bookstalls near puja pandals, where such stalls have been a fixture for decades. On Tuesday (November 17, 2026), the SFI activists said that they sought permission from the Kolkata Police to let them set up a bookstall at a makeshift stall on the footpath of College Street. But the police refused to give permission on Monday (November 16, 2026) evening, stating that it may disrupt the traffic. The bookstall was part of a three-day campaign, ‘Sangrami Boipotro’, by the party.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A ruckus erupted between the SFI activists and the police when they blocked the College Street, and started selling their books by laying out a sheet on the tram line.

Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।
✓ Syn: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance  |  ✖ Ant: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality
Progressive (Adjective)
प्रगतिशील — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Progressive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Federation (Noun)
फेडरेशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Federation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Both the groups clashed over space for holding book stalls in the city’s College Street area, which is also known as the book hub of the city, with hundreds of bookstores selling books. The development comes a day after police had detained SFI supporters were detained by police for holding a book stall. At around 11 a.m. on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), a group of SFI activists started preparing a stall a few metres away from their scheduled spot after getting permission from the police. However, a group of ABVP members reached the spot and asked them to show the letter of permission. When the SFI members told ABVP supporters about the police’s approval, they raised objections over some books on the history and ideology of communism. A few moments later, they started vandalising the shop and books escalating the tension in the area once again. The police intervened and tried to prevent supporters of both the groups from coming togather. Meanwhile, the ABVP members also demanded the police to let them set up another stall, next to the one set up by SFI. They also brought some of the books on several Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh leaders, along with ones by Rabindranath Tagore, and Jagadish Chandra Bose while raising slogans against the SFI. “Yes, we have objections over many of their [SFI] history books. Those books are potent to create an anarchy in the society. We will not let it happen. We have also sought permission from the police to let us set up another stall next to theirs. We want to sell books on nationalism and the true history of our country,” an ABVP activist told mediapersons By the afternoon, the ABVP activists were also seen arranging a table next to the SFI stall and sell books. Later in the day, when Left Front chairperson Biman Bose was met with “Go back’ slogan by SFI activists when he visited the site. The dispute over the book stalls run by the Left parties started during Durga Puja. Police and civic bodies demolished several stalls set up by the parties across Kolkata. In Jadavpur, a bulldozer was also brought to dismantle a shop sparking a huge political controversy. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari called the supporters of Left parties ‘atheist’ and declared that they would not be allowed to set up their bookstalls near puja pandals, where such stalls have been a fixture for decades. On Tuesday (November 17, 2026), the SFI activists said that they sought permission from the Kolkata Police to let them set up a bookstall at a makeshift stall on the footpath of College Street. But the police refused to give permission on Monday (November 16, 2026) evening, stating that it may disrupt the traffic. The bookstall was part of a three-day campaign, ‘Sangrami Boipotro’, by the party.

articles.title: Anant Singh’s daughter’s wedding: horse race with Thar SUV as top prize, 150 horses to compete
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Anant Singh was recently expelled from the ruling ally coalition party in Bihar, JD-U, for his “anti-party activities” as he declined to support the official party candidate Neeraj Kumar in a recently held State legislative council elections on eight seats

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: What is common between Rafter, Badal, Braood and Vande Bharat? They are all names of horses of all breeds from different districts and neighbouring States of Bihar who have come to participate in the royal marriage ceremony of the expelled ruling JD-U MLA from the Mokama constituency, Anant Singh’ second daughter, Shivangi Singh, which is scheduled to be solemnised on November 25 at his ancestral village, Nadwan of Patna district. A horse race is scheduled to be organised on the wedding day, and the winner will win an SUV (Thar jeep), while the second prize is a motorbike and a scooty will be given to the third-prize-winning horse owner. His daughter is to be married to Rishikesh Kumar, an MBA graduate from an American university and settled there for the last 10 years. He is the son of Ranvijay Kumar of Bihta, near Patna. Mr. Singh is said to have movable and immovable property worth ₹ 100 crore and his elder daughter was married earlier. “Preparation for the royal, grand wedding is well progressing and it will be a wedding ceremony which might not have happened earlier, nor would happen in the state in future”, said Anant Singh’s aide Chhotu Singh alias Arvind Kumar Singh. Two grounds measuring about 8-9 acres of land are being prepared---one, at the entrance of the village and the other near the MLA’s residence inside the village- for the proposed horse race. “Horses from other districts of Bihar like Lakhisarai and Gaya and neighbouring State Uttar Pradesh’s Varanasi district have already come here to participate in the race…nearly 150 horses would come for the proposed event.”, said Chikku Kumar, owner of the horse named Rafter at the venue. Those horses who have come to participate in the event are said to have regular foot massage, fodder and practice at the given site “to remain fit and fine”, he added. The expelled JD-U MLA who had represented Mokama several times in the State Assembly, too, is said to be a horse lover. “He is basically an animal lover…having horses, elephants, snakes and other animals at his residence”, corrected Chhotu Singh. Along with his wife Neelam Devi, the MLA was, recently, expelled from the ruling ally coalition party in Bihar JD-U for his “anti-party activities” as he declined to support the official party candidate Neeraj Kumar in a recently held State legislative council elections on eight seats. In the election, though, the official JD-U candidate Neeraj Kumar retained the seat for a fourth consecutive term from the Patna Graduate seat, defeating the Mokama MLA-supported candidate Anuj Kumar Singh. Later, after expelling him from the party, it also wrote to the Assembly Speaker, Prem Kumar, to disqualify him from membership of the assembly. Against the MLA who is also known as Chote Sarkar (mini government) for his bahubal (strong arm) image, over two dozen cases have been registered, later reached to the Speaker to invite him for the marriage ceremony and reportedly told him that after the ceremony would get over, he would submit his response. Later, the Supreme Court directed Mr. Singh to surrender by December 1 in a murder case of another bahubali (strongman) of Mokama Tal (riverine) area, Dularchand Yadav, who was killed on October 30, 2025, during the last Assembly elections while he was campaigning Mr. Singh’s Opposite candidate from Jan Suraaj Party Priyadarshi Piyush.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Over six helipads are also said to be constructed near the wedding venue for the arrival of VIP guests and lakhs of guests from different districts of the State and from Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Punjab, and Haryana. Mr. Singh’s guest list includes politicians and eminent persons from across political parties and walks of life. “I’ve invited everyone for the wedding”, quipped Mr Singh earlier while speaking to media persons. Over 150 cuisines for the wedding ceremony, from local to national to international, are being prepared to be served at the marriage ceremony. The wedding venue is spread over nearly 10 bighas (over 6 acres) of land and is being decorated by artistes from Mau of Uttar Pradesh, who could be seen working day and night to construct replicas of historical Taj Mahal for the main pavilion and Red Fort for another.
