hinglishTracks.en: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — तथ्वमसि स्टूडियोज द्वारा निर्मित सूरी: द सेवेंथ नोट दुष्ट संगीत द्वारा नियंत्रित ब्रह्मांड पर आधारित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The game was launched in October
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यह गेम अक्टूबर में लॉन्च किया गया था।

hinglishTracks.en: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सूरी: द सेवेंथ नोट, बेंगलुरु स्थित तथ्वमासी स्टूडियो का 2डी वीडियो गेम, की कहानी संगीत के बुरे संस्करण से दूषित दुनिया पर आधारित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इस ब्रह्मांड में हर चीज़ उस नापाक ध्वनि उपस्थिति के अनुरूप चलती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नायक, अजीरा को अपनी माँ को निश्चित मृत्यु से बचाने के लिए द्वीप के केंद्र में स्थित एक फल ढूंढना होगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जल्द ही, उसे एहसास होता है कि उसके कार्य ही द्वीप का भाग्य निर्धारित करेंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सूरी: द सेवेंथ नोट कोच्चि के तथ्वमासी स्टूडियो के संस्थापक ग्लेन मार्टिन के दिमाग की उपज है, जो वीडियो के गेम डायरेक्टर भी हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उनके साथ चित्रक श्रीवास्तव, सह-संस्थापक और गेम के कला निर्देशक भी शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — गेम को अक्टूबर में प्लेस्टेशन स्टोर और स्टीम पर लॉन्च किया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Playstation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Playstation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ग्लेन, जो पहले एक डेटा वैज्ञानिक थे, ने महामारी के दौरान खुद को गेम-मेकिंग में डूबा हुआ पाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने छोटे-छोटे गेम बनाकर शुरुआत की, जिसमें विभिन्न स्थानों से उनके दोस्त मदद के लिए डिस्कॉर्ड सर्वर पर शामिल हुए।।

hinglishTracks.en: “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “जब हमने गेम बनाना शुरू किया, तो इसका मतलब कोई प्रोजेक्ट नहीं था।।

hinglishTracks.en: But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन एक बार जब हमें इसकी क्षमता का एहसास हुआ, तो हमने सोचना शुरू कर दिया कि इस खेल में क्या अनोखा हो सकता है, ”ग्लेन कहते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ग्लेन मार्टिन और चित्रक श्रीवास्तव | फोटो साभार: विशेष व्यवस्था। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Arrangement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Arrangement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “उस समय, मैं सेकिरो नामक एक पैरी-केंद्रित युद्ध खेल खेल रहा था।।

hinglishTracks.en: It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह बहुत कठिन खेल है और मैं इसमें अच्छा नहीं हूं।।

hinglishTracks.en: But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन फिर मैंने बहुत सारे स्ट्रीमर्स को एक भी हिट लिए बिना, कुशलता से गेम खेलते देखा, और मुझे एहसास हुआ कि जब गेम उस स्तर पर खेला जाता है, तो इसमें एक निश्चित लयबद्ध गुणवत्ता होती है, ”उन्होंने आगे कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — "तलवार की झंकार की आवाज़, छलांग और चाल, सब कुछ कोरियोग्राफ़ महसूस हुआ।"।

hinglishTracks.en: This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसने अंततः उन्हें सूरी... को एक लय प्लेटफ़ॉर्मर गेम में बदलने के लिए प्रेरित किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — दो अलग-अलग खेलों का मिश्रण है: रिदम और प्लेटफ़ॉर्मर।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — रिदम गेम संगीत-थीम वाले एक्शन गेम हैं जो खिलाड़ी की टाइमिंग और मीटर की समझ का आकलन करते हैं, जबकि प्लेटफ़ॉर्मर एक उप-शैली हैं जहां एक मुख्य पात्र असमान इलाके और निलंबित प्लेटफार्मों के माध्यम से चलता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “ऐसे बहुत कम खेल हैं जिन्होंने पहले ऐसा किया है, इसलिए हमारा संदर्भ सीमित था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सूरी... में, दुनिया लय में चलती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — वे सभी चीज़ें जिनके साथ आप आम तौर पर एक नियमित प्लेटफ़ॉर्मर में बातचीत करते हैं, जैसे जाल, बाधाएं इत्यादि, वे सभी हमारे गेम में लय से जुड़ी हुई हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Interactive' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Interactive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ग्लेन बताते हैं, ''कोई चीज़ कब ऊपर-नीचे होगी या कोई पत्ता कब खुलेगा या बंद होगा इत्यादि को समझने के लिए आपको संगीत सुनना होगा।''।

hinglishTracks.en: “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — "जब अच्छा खेला जाता है, तो ऐसा लगता है जैसे स्तरों के माध्यम से नृत्य किया जा रहा है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — 2024 में, सोनी इंटरएक्टिव एंटरटेनमेंट के इनक्यूबेटर प्रोग्राम, प्लेस्टेशन के इंडिया हीरो प्रोजेक्ट के उद्घाटन संस्करण में सूरी पांच खेलों में से एक था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Entertainment' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Entertainment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसने अंततः ग्लेन को अपनी नौकरी छोड़ने और अधिक लोगों को काम पर रखने की अनुमति दी।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सूरी से एक दृश्य: सातवां नोट | फोटो साभार: विशेष व्यवस्था। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Arrangement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Arrangement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 This 2D rhythm platformer video game is an ode to India’s multiplicities

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 11:36:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Suri: The Seventh Note by Tathvamasi Studios is set in a universe controlled by evil music. The game was launched in October
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story of Suri: The Seventh Note, a 2D video game by Bengaluru-based Tathvamasi Studios, is set in a world corrupted by an evil version of music. Everything in this universe moves in tune with that nefarious sonic presence. The protagonist, Ajira, must find a fruit located at the centre of the island to save her mother from certain death. Soon, she realises her actions shall determine the fate of the island itself. Suri: The Seventh Note is the brainchild of Glen Martin from Kochi, founder of Tathvamasi Studios, who is also the game director of the video. He is joined by Chitrak Srivastava, co-founder and the game’s art director. The game was launched on Playstation Store and Steam in October. Glen, formerly a data scientist, found himself immersed in game-making during the pandemic. He began by making smaller games, with friends from different places joining him on a Discord server to help. “When we started to build the game, it was not meant to be a project. But once we realised its potential, we began to think about what could be unique about this game,” says Glen. Glen Martin and Chitrak Srivastava | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT “At that point, I was playing a parry-focused combat game called Sekiro. It’s a very hard game, and I am not good at it. But then I saw a lot of streamers play the game skilfully, without even taking a single hit, and I realised that when the game is played at that level, it has a certain rhythmic quality to it,” he adds. “The sounds of the sword clinking, the jumps and movements, everything felt choreographed.” This ultimately led him to turn Suri… into a rhythm platformer game. Suri... is a mix of two different games: rhythm and platformer. Rhythm games are music-themed action games that assess a player’s sense of timing and metre, while platformers are a sub-genre where a main character moves through uneven terrain and suspended platforms. “There are very few games that have done this before, so our well of references was limited. In Suri..., the world moves to the rhythm. All the things that you would normally interact with in a regular platformer, like traps, obstacles, etc., are all tied to the rhythm in our game. You have to listen to the music to understand when a thing would move up and down or when a leaf would open or close and so on,” explains Glen. “When played well, it feels like dancing through levels.” In 2024, Suri was one of five games at the inaugural edition of PlayStation’s India Hero Project, an incubator programme from Sony Interactive Entertainment. This ultimately allowed Glen to quit his job and hire more people.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A still from Suri: The Seventh Note | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT

articles.title: Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease drug cost by ₹6.5 lakh; seven children to get free treatment
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30; the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine having a medicine that could help manage your child’s rare genetic condition, but being unable to afford it because a year’s treatment costs as much as ₹9 crore. For seven families in India, that situation could soon change. Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30, following an initiative led by Hyderabad-based paediatrician Dr Sivaranjani Santosh and Access to Medicines India. The development is significant not just because the families will receive the medicine without paying for it, but also because its cost has been brought down through pharmaceutical compounding in the Netherlands. While the commercial version of the drug costs approximately ₹4.68 crore to ₹9 crore per child annually, the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year. The medicine has been prepared by Transvaal Pharmacy in The Hague, Netherlands, with support from the Netherlands-based Pharmaceutical Accountability Foundation (PAF). The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions. The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment. As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches. The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr. Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency. The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells. Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency. It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis. Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families. Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany. Dr Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug. Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached. Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed. The situation eventually prompted Dr Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media. On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives. The appeal gained attention, bringing it to the notice of PAF. The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient. Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children. The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore. A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal. According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh. Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands. The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यह दवा नीदरलैंड स्थित फार्मास्युटिकल अकाउंटेबिलिटी फाउंडेशन (पीएएफ) के सहयोग से नीदरलैंड के हेग में ट्रांसवाल फार्मेसी द्वारा तैयार की गई है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पहला बैच आवश्यक दस्तावेज और व्यक्तिगत आयात अनुमतियों के साथ सात बच्चों के माता-पिता को सौंप दिया जाएगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Permissibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट। इसके Synonyms हैं: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance और Antonyms हैं: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality।

hinglishTracks.en: The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — परिवारों ने एक साल के इलाज के लिए मंजूरी हासिल कर ली है।।

hinglishTracks.en: As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — चूंकि मिश्रित दवा की शेल्फ लाइफ छह महीने है, इसलिए इसे दो बैचों में आयात किया जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह पहल डॉ. की देखरेख में रहने वाले बच्चे अराव के बाद शुरू हुई।।

hinglishTracks.en: Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शिवरंजनी को एएचडीएस का पता चला था, जिसे एमसीटी8 की कमी भी कहा जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह स्थिति MCT8 जीन को प्रभावित करने वाले उत्परिवर्तन के कारण होती है, जो मस्तिष्क कोशिकाओं में थायराइड हार्मोन के परिवहन में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — टिराट्रिकोल, जिसे टीआरआईएसी के नाम से भी जाना जाता है, थायराइड हार्मोन रिसेप्टर्स पर कार्य करता है और कमी के कुछ प्रभावों को दूर करने में मदद कर सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह परिधीय थायरोटॉक्सिकोसिस से जुड़ी जटिलताओं को कम करने में भी मदद करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि यह दवा यूरोप में उपलब्ध थी, लेकिन इसकी व्यावसायिक कीमत ने इसे अधिकांश भारतीय परिवारों की पहुँच से बाहर कर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अरव की मां पवित्रा सिरोलकर को जर्मनी से दवा की सिर्फ एक महीने की आपूर्ति के लिए लगभग ₹12 लाख से ₹13 लाख की व्यवस्था करनी पड़ी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Dr Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — डॉ. शिवरंजनी ने दवा खरीदने के तरीके तलाशने के लिए शुरुआत में बाल रोग विशेषज्ञों, एंडोक्रिनोलॉजिस्ट और बाल न्यूरोलॉजिस्ट से संपर्क किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — क्रिश्चियन मेडिकल कॉलेज (सीएमसी), वेल्लोर के डॉक्टरों से भी संपर्क किया गया, जहां समान स्थिति वाले पांच अन्य बच्चों की पहचान की गई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — फार्मास्युटिकल कंपनी एगेटिस थेरेप्यूटिक्स और उसके अनुकंपा-उपयोग कार्यक्रम के माध्यम से दवा प्राप्त करने के प्रयास सफल नहीं हुए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Pharmaceutical' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Pharmaceutical' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The situation eventually prompted Dr Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — स्थिति ने अंततः डॉ. शिवरंजनी को इस मुद्दे को सोशल मीडिया पर ले जाने के लिए प्रेरित किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — 7 सितंबर को, उन्होंने परिवार के लिए मदद की मांग करते हुए एक अपील पोस्ट की और लोगों से प्रधानमंत्री, केंद्रीय स्वास्थ्य मंत्री और अन्य सरकारी प्रतिनिधियों को टैग करने का आग्रह किया।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अपील ने ध्यान आकर्षित किया और इसे पीएएफ के ध्यान में लाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसके बाद फाउंडेशन ने सक्रिय फार्मास्युटिकल घटक का उपयोग करके फार्मास्युटिकल कंपाउंडिंग के माध्यम से दवा तैयार करने की संभावना का पता लगाया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Pharmaceutical' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Pharmaceutical' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ट्रांसवाल फार्मेसी ने परीक्षण बैच आयोजित किए और सात बच्चों के लिए एक फॉर्मूलेशन विकसित किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Pharmaceutical' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Pharmaceutical' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — प्रारंभिक समूह में अरव और सीएमसी वेल्लोर में इलाज करा रहे पांच बच्चे शामिल थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक साल की उम्र के सातवें बच्चे की पहचान तब की गई जब उसके पिता ने डॉ. शिवरंजनी की सोशल मीडिया अपील के बाद उनसे संपर्क किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पीएएफ के अनुसार, सभी सात बच्चों को एक साल के इलाज की कुल लागत €14,200, लगभग ₹15.08 लाख है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसमें से, डॉ. शिवरंजनी ने भारत में लगभग ₹6.09 लाख जुटाए, जबकि पीएएफ ने शेष €8,600, लगभग ₹9.13 लाख, नीदरलैंड में जुटाने का बीड़ा उठाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सभी सात परिवारों को दवा मुफ्त उपलब्ध करायी जायेगी.।

hinglishTracks.en: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जबकि 30 नवंबर का हैंडओवर सात बच्चों की तत्काल उपचार आवश्यकताओं को संबोधित करता है, डॉ. शिवरंजनी का मानना ​​है कि दवा का आयात करना स्थायी समाधान नहीं हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — वह केंद्र सरकार से संपर्क करने और एक्सेस टू मेडिसिन्स इंडिया और अन्य संगठनों के साथ काम करने की योजना बना रही है ताकि भारत में दवा को मिश्रित करने और इसे अधिक बच्चों के लिए सुलभ बनाने की संभावना का पता लगाया जा सके।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease drug cost by ₹6.5 lakh; seven children to get free treatment

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 10:49:06 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30; the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine having a medicine that could help manage your child’s rare genetic condition, but being unable to afford it because a year’s treatment costs as much as ₹9 crore. For seven families in India, that situation could soon change. Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30, following an initiative led by Hyderabad-based paediatrician Dr Sivaranjani Santosh and Access to Medicines India. The development is significant not just because the families will receive the medicine without paying for it, but also because its cost has been brought down through pharmaceutical compounding in the Netherlands. While the commercial version of the drug costs approximately ₹4.68 crore to ₹9 crore per child annually, the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year. The medicine has been prepared by Transvaal Pharmacy in The Hague, Netherlands, with support from the Netherlands-based Pharmaceutical Accountability Foundation (PAF). The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions. The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment. As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches. The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr. Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency. The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells. Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency. It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis. Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families. Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany. Dr Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug. Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached. Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed. The situation eventually prompted Dr Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media. On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives. The appeal gained attention, bringing it to the notice of PAF. The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient. Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children. The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore. A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal. According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh. Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands. The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.

कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।

जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।

Core Context & Background: Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30; the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30; the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine having a medicine that could help manage your child’s rare genetic condition, but being unable to afford it because a year’s treatment costs as much as ₹9 crore. For seven families in India, that situation could soon change. Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30, following an initiative led by Hyderabad-based paediatrician Dr Sivaranjani Santosh and Access to Medicines India. The development is significant not just because the families will receive the medicine without paying for it, but also because its cost has been brought down through pharmaceutical compounding in the Netherlands. While the commercial version of the drug costs approximately ₹4.68 crore to ₹9 crore per child annually, the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year. The medicine has been prepared by Transvaal Pharmacy in The Hague, Netherlands, with support from the Netherlands-based Pharmaceutical Accountability Foundation (PAF). The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions. The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment. As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches. The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr. Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency. The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells. Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency. It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis. Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families. Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany. Dr Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug. Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached. Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed. The situation eventually prompted Dr Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media. On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives. The appeal gained attention, bringing it to the notice of PAF. The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient. Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children. The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore. A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal. According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh. Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands. The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Federation of All India Medical Association had condemned the “unreasonable advisory”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Department of Medicine at Assam Medical College and Hospital in eastern Assam’s Dibrugarh has withdrawn an order advising postgraduate trainees (PGTs) of general medicine to defer “personal milestones such as marriage” until they complete their residency tenure. Prasanta Dihingia, the Head of the Department, withdrew the order hours after issuing it on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). The withdrawal followed a backlash from a doctors’ body. “With reference to the Order No.MED/2026/5700; Dtd. 18.11.2026, regarding the advisory issued to the PGTs of Dept. of Medicine concerning personal milestones during their residency tenure, it is hereby notified that the Office Order is withdrawn with immediate effect,” the order read. “Accordingly, the above-mentioned order is cancelled and treated as withdrawn from the date of issuance of this notice. All concerned are hereby informed to take note of the same,” it further read. Earlier, the Federation of All India Medical Association (FAIMA) condemned the “unreasonable advisory” and demanded its immediate withdrawal. “What’s next? NOC from the HOD for marriage and family planning? By the same logic, HODs should stay in the hospital 24×7 until retirement. After all, commitment to patient care should apply equally to everyone!” FAIMA posted on X, sharing the controversial order. The association advised administrators to regulate duty hours, not the resident doctors’ personal lives.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Residency is a postgraduate course, not a vow of celibacy!” it stated.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Assam medical college department withdraws ‘defer marriage’ order for PGTs

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 10:47:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Federation of All India Medical Association had condemned the “unreasonable advisory”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Department of Medicine at Assam Medical College and Hospital in eastern Assam’s Dibrugarh has withdrawn an order advising postgraduate trainees (PGTs) of general medicine to defer “personal milestones such as marriage” until they complete their residency tenure. Prasanta Dihingia, the Head of the Department, withdrew the order hours after issuing it on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). The withdrawal followed a backlash from a doctors’ body. “With reference to the Order No.MED/2026/5700; Dtd. 18.11.2026, regarding the advisory issued to the PGTs of Dept. of Medicine concerning personal milestones during their residency tenure, it is hereby notified that the Office Order is withdrawn with immediate effect,” the order read. “Accordingly, the above-mentioned order is cancelled and treated as withdrawn from the date of issuance of this notice. All concerned are hereby informed to take note of the same,” it further read. Earlier, the Federation of All India Medical Association (FAIMA) condemned the “unreasonable advisory” and demanded its immediate withdrawal. “What’s next? NOC from the HOD for marriage and family planning? By the same logic, HODs should stay in the hospital 24×7 until retirement. After all, commitment to patient care should apply equally to everyone!” FAIMA posted on X, sharing the controversial order. The association advised administrators to regulate duty hours, not the resident doctors’ personal lives.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Residency is a postgraduate course, not a vow of celibacy!” it stated.

articles.title: Young founders hold key to India’s elusive shift from IT services to products, say industry leaders
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: At Bengaluru Tech Summit, industry leaders called for greater funding for young entrepreneurs and a startup-led approach to product development, with established IT companies acting as industry mentors and potential sources of financial support

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Why is India still an IT services powerhouse, not a product powerhouse? The question has become a fixture at technology conferences, industry summits and policy discussions. Despite building a formidable global outsourcing industry, India has yet to produce product companies with comparable global scale. For more than a decade, the country has tried to move beyond outsourcing and build homegrown technology companies with global reach. Policy efforts have not yet translated into a significant number of globally competitive technology products. At the Bengaluru Tech Summit, industry leaders returned to the question of what it will take to bridge this gap. A common thread across three separate discussions was the need for younger entrepreneurs to lead product development, backed by patient capital and the industry expertise of established technology companies. Clearwater Analytics CEO Sandeep Sahai, who said he had moved from running a services company to a software product business about 12 years ago, said the two business models required fundamentally different approaches. Services companies typically invest after securing contracts and generate cash flows relatively quickly. Product companies, by contrast, have to invest for years before seeing returns. This difference in investment horizons makes it difficult for services companies to turn themselves into product businesses, he said. Mr. Sahai called for a stronger venture capital and private equity ecosystem, noting that 44 of the top 50 product companies in his analysis had required external funding. He also argued that younger entrepreneurs, including college students, should lead the next wave of product development. “We need the younger generation. We need to fund them, not fund ourselves,” he said, calling for greater investment in young founders rather than established industry leaders. Mr. Sahai urged entrepreneurs to build for global markets from the outset, rather than restricting themselves to India. A global customer base and dollar revenues, he argued, would make it easier to attract foreign capital and talent. He also pointed to generative AI’s ability to accelerate the development of new software products, while arguing that proprietary data would be a lasting competitive advantage. Investor Mohandas Pai offered a different perspective on the role of established IT companies. Speaking in a separate session after Sahai’s keynote, Mr. Pai argued that India’s services giants should not be expected to transform themselves into product businesses.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “They’re not going to make products. Don’t beat them up. They can’t make products,” he said.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Young founders hold key to India’s elusive shift from IT services to products, say industry leaders

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 10:39:51 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: At Bengaluru Tech Summit, industry leaders called for greater funding for young entrepreneurs and a startup-led approach to product development, with established IT companies acting as industry mentors and potential sources of financial support

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Why is India still an IT services powerhouse, not a product powerhouse? The question has become a fixture at technology conferences, industry summits and policy discussions. Despite building a formidable global outsourcing industry, India has yet to produce product companies with comparable global scale. For more than a decade, the country has tried to move beyond outsourcing and build homegrown technology companies with global reach. Policy efforts have not yet translated into a significant number of globally competitive technology products. At the Bengaluru Tech Summit, industry leaders returned to the question of what it will take to bridge this gap. A common thread across three separate discussions was the need for younger entrepreneurs to lead product development, backed by patient capital and the industry expertise of established technology companies. Clearwater Analytics CEO Sandeep Sahai, who said he had moved from running a services company to a software product business about 12 years ago, said the two business models required fundamentally different approaches. Services companies typically invest after securing contracts and generate cash flows relatively quickly. Product companies, by contrast, have to invest for years before seeing returns. This difference in investment horizons makes it difficult for services companies to turn themselves into product businesses, he said. Mr. Sahai called for a stronger venture capital and private equity ecosystem, noting that 44 of the top 50 product companies in his analysis had required external funding. He also argued that younger entrepreneurs, including college students, should lead the next wave of product development. “We need the younger generation. We need to fund them, not fund ourselves,” he said, calling for greater investment in young founders rather than established industry leaders. Mr. Sahai urged entrepreneurs to build for global markets from the outset, rather than restricting themselves to India. A global customer base and dollar revenues, he argued, would make it easier to attract foreign capital and talent. He also pointed to generative AI’s ability to accelerate the development of new software products, while arguing that proprietary data would be a lasting competitive advantage. Investor Mohandas Pai offered a different perspective on the role of established IT companies. Speaking in a separate session after Sahai’s keynote, Mr. Pai argued that India’s services giants should not be expected to transform themselves into product businesses.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “They’re not going to make products. Don’t beat them up. They can’t make products,” he said.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Development (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Development' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Competitive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Competitive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Perspective (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Perspective' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Difference (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Difference' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Young founders hold key to India’s elusive shift from IT services to products, say industry leaders", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. At Bengaluru Tech Summit, industry leaders called for greater funding for young entrepreneurs and a startup-led approach to product development, with...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Young founders hold key to India’s elusive shift' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Young founders hold key to India’s elusive sh' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Young founders hold key to India’s elusive sh' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "At Bengaluru Tech Summit, industry leaders called for greater funding for young entrepreneurs and a startup-led approach to product development, with..." (Hinglish Arth: बेंगलुरु टेक समिट में, उद्योग जगत के नेताओं ने युवा उद्यमियों के लिए अधिक से अधिक फंडिंग और उत्पाद विकास के लिए स्टार्टअप के नेतृत्व वाले दृष्टिकोण का आह्वान किया, जिसमें स्थापित आईटी कंपनियां उद्योग सलाहकार के रूप में काम कर रही थीं और संभावित रूप से कमजोर थीं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Young founders hold key to India’s elusive shift from IT services to products, say industry leaders"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “They’re not going to make products.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“They’re not going to make products." (Hinglish Arth: “वे उत्पाद नहीं बनाने जा रहे हैं।)

articles.title: Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls will end it: Rahul Gandhi at University of Chicago
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: “So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,” the Congress leader said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian democracy is "sacred" and the Congress is ready to face electoral defeats until people realise that the system has been completely demolished, Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi said. Interacting with students at the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Gandhi said boycotting elections over alleged flaws in the electoral system would bring an end to Indian democracy, and the Congress party does not intend to do that. "Indian democracy is sacred. For me to even say that there is a problem in Indian democracy is difficult without 100, 200, 300 per cent proof," he said during the interaction moderated by Prof Robert Pape. The Congress leader said asking the opposition to boycott elections would end democracy that very minute. "But what happens to all the opposition workers if we tell them, 'Okay, don't participate in the election?' If we say that we are not going to contest elections, we end Indian democracy that minute. And we don't want to end the structure of Indian democracy,” Mr. Gandhi said. “So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Gandhi was on a two-day visit to the U.S. during which he interacted with the students of Columbia University in New York on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) and the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026).

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls will end it: Rahul Gandhi at University of Chicago

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:28:26 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: “So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,” the Congress leader said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian democracy is "sacred" and the Congress is ready to face electoral defeats until people realise that the system has been completely demolished, Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi said. Interacting with students at the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Gandhi said boycotting elections over alleged flaws in the electoral system would bring an end to Indian democracy, and the Congress party does not intend to do that. "Indian democracy is sacred. For me to even say that there is a problem in Indian democracy is difficult without 100, 200, 300 per cent proof," he said during the interaction moderated by Prof Robert Pape. The Congress leader said asking the opposition to boycott elections would end democracy that very minute. "But what happens to all the opposition workers if we tell them, 'Okay, don't participate in the election?' If we say that we are not going to contest elections, we end Indian democracy that minute. And we don't want to end the structure of Indian democracy,” Mr. Gandhi said. “So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,” he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Gandhi was on a two-day visit to the U.S. during which he interacted with the students of Columbia University in New York on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) and the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026).

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Interaction (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Interaction' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Opposition (Noun)
विरोध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opposition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
University (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'University' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Electoral (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Electoral' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls will end it: Rahul Gandhi at University of Chicago", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. “So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,”...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls will' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls w' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls w' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "“So, our strategy is to expose what is going on and take the beating until the people of India realise that the system has been fully demolished,”..." (Hinglish Arth: कांग्रेस नेता ने कहा, "इसलिए, हमारी रणनीति यह है कि जो कुछ चल रहा है उसे उजागर करें और तब तक पिटाई झेलते रहें जब तक कि भारत के लोगों को यह एहसास न हो जाए कि व्यवस्था पूरी तरह से ध्वस्त हो गई है।")
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Indian democracy 'sacred', boycotting polls will end it: Rahul Gandhi at University of Chicago"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. during which he interacted with the students of Columbia University in New York on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) and the University of Chicago on...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "during which he interacted with the students of Columbia University in New York on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) and the University of Chicago on..." (Hinglish Arth: इस दौरान उन्होंने मंगलवार (17 नवंबर, 2026) को न्यूयॉर्क में कोलंबिया विश्वविद्यालय और बुधवार (18 नवंबर, 2026) को शिकागो विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के साथ बातचीत की।)

articles.title: CID arrests man in ₹7 crore government job fraud case in Guntur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The case is registered against him and several others for allegedly collecting huge sums of money from job aspirants by promising them government employment

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Crime Investigation Department (CID) police have arrested a 50-year-old man in connection with a job fraud case in which unemployed youth were allegedly cheated of about ₹7 crore on the promise of securing government jobs. Additional Superintendent of Police B. Seetharamaiah and Inspectors of Police T. Sanjeevikumar and P. Mohan Krishna said this in a press release on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). The arrested man has been identified as Nimmakayala Peddiraju. The case was registered against him, Bodapati Dharani Krishna and several others for allegedly collecting huge sums of money from job aspirants by promising them government employment. As part of the ongoing investigation, CID officials arrested Peddiraju on Wednesday. The other accused, including Dharani Krishna, are absconding, the CID informed. The CID has constituted two special teams comprising police personnel to trace and apprehend the absconding accused. The teams are conducting searches to establish their whereabouts and secure their arrest.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The CID officials have appealed to the public to share any credible information regarding the whereabouts of the absconding accused. Those possessing relevant information have been requested to contact the Guntur CID police officials to assist the investigation.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 CID arrests man in ₹7 crore government job fraud case in Guntur

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:24:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The case is registered against him and several others for allegedly collecting huge sums of money from job aspirants by promising them government employment

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Crime Investigation Department (CID) police have arrested a 50-year-old man in connection with a job fraud case in which unemployed youth were allegedly cheated of about ₹7 crore on the promise of securing government jobs. Additional Superintendent of Police B. Seetharamaiah and Inspectors of Police T. Sanjeevikumar and P. Mohan Krishna said this in a press release on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). The arrested man has been identified as Nimmakayala Peddiraju. The case was registered against him, Bodapati Dharani Krishna and several others for allegedly collecting huge sums of money from job aspirants by promising them government employment. As part of the ongoing investigation, CID officials arrested Peddiraju on Wednesday. The other accused, including Dharani Krishna, are absconding, the CID informed. The CID has constituted two special teams comprising police personnel to trace and apprehend the absconding accused. The teams are conducting searches to establish their whereabouts and secure their arrest.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The CID officials have appealed to the public to share any credible information regarding the whereabouts of the absconding accused. Those possessing relevant information have been requested to contact the Guntur CID police officials to assist the investigation.

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Employment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: People will be able to book parcel shipments online, make digital payments and access value-added logistics services without visiting railway parcel offices or completing physical paperwork. The date of the commercial launch would be announced after completing test runs.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Hyderabad has been selected by the Ministry of Railways for the rollout of a new digital platform, ‘Rail Parcel App - House to House’, aimed at providing seamless doorstep parcel booking and delivery services. The initiative is part of the Railways’ efforts to modernise parcel operations and expand rail-based logistics services across the country. The service will initially be launched in seven other cities, including Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Pune, with the platform designed to make parcel transportation more convenient for customers by enabling end-to-end digital transactions. Through a mobile application and a dedicated website, customers will be able to book parcel shipments online, make digital payments and access value-added logistics services without visiting railway parcel offices or completing physical paperwork. The date for the commercial launch would be announced after the Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS) completes test runs of the platform. The system will also generate detailed management information reports and integrate with the State Bank of India’s (SBI) application programming interface (API) for automated payment settlement and revenue sharing, informed officials. The platform is being developed in partnership with Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), which will handle first-mile and last-mile connectivity, including doorstep pickup and delivery of consignments. The Railways will continue to provide the middle-mile transportation through its extensive parcel network. The respective zonal railways have been instructed to extend necessary support to logistics partners. Senior Divisional Commercial Managers (Sr. DCMs) have been directed to nominate nodal officers to coordinate and facilitate the rollout of the project in their respective divisions to ensure smooth implementation. The policy also lays down operational and accountability norms. Any claims arising during the first-mile or last-mile delivery process will be settled by the logistics service provider concerned, while statutory compliance related to delivery operations will remain its responsibility.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The guidelines permit the transportation of oversized consignments, fragile goods and perishable items, subject to operational feasibility and prescribed conditions. Penalties have been provided for false declarations, poor delivery standards and damage to consignments caused by logistics partners, added railway officials.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Rail Parcel App to debut in Hyderabad, aims at doorstep services

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:22:09 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: People will be able to book parcel shipments online, make digital payments and access value-added logistics services without visiting railway parcel offices or completing physical paperwork. The date of the commercial launch would be announced after completing test runs.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Hyderabad has been selected by the Ministry of Railways for the rollout of a new digital platform, ‘Rail Parcel App - House to House’, aimed at providing seamless doorstep parcel booking and delivery services. The initiative is part of the Railways’ efforts to modernise parcel operations and expand rail-based logistics services across the country. The service will initially be launched in seven other cities, including Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Pune, with the platform designed to make parcel transportation more convenient for customers by enabling end-to-end digital transactions. Through a mobile application and a dedicated website, customers will be able to book parcel shipments online, make digital payments and access value-added logistics services without visiting railway parcel offices or completing physical paperwork. The date for the commercial launch would be announced after the Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS) completes test runs of the platform. The system will also generate detailed management information reports and integrate with the State Bank of India’s (SBI) application programming interface (API) for automated payment settlement and revenue sharing, informed officials. The platform is being developed in partnership with Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), which will handle first-mile and last-mile connectivity, including doorstep pickup and delivery of consignments. The Railways will continue to provide the middle-mile transportation through its extensive parcel network. The respective zonal railways have been instructed to extend necessary support to logistics partners. Senior Divisional Commercial Managers (Sr. DCMs) have been directed to nominate nodal officers to coordinate and facilitate the rollout of the project in their respective divisions to ensure smooth implementation. The policy also lays down operational and accountability norms. Any claims arising during the first-mile or last-mile delivery process will be settled by the logistics service provider concerned, while statutory compliance related to delivery operations will remain its responsibility.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The guidelines permit the transportation of oversized consignments, fragile goods and perishable items, subject to operational feasibility and prescribed conditions. Penalties have been provided for false declarations, poor delivery standards and damage to consignments caused by logistics partners, added railway officials.

जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Transportation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Transportation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Rail Parcel App to debut in Hyderabad, aims at doorstep services", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. People will be able to book parcel shipments online, make digital payments and access value-added logistics services without visiting railway parcel...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Rail Parcel App to debut in Hyderabad, aims at d' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Rail Parcel App to debut in Hyderabad, aims a' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Rail Parcel App to debut in Hyderabad, aims a' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "People will be able to book parcel shipments online, make digital payments and access value-added logistics services without visiting railway parcel..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Rail Parcel App to debut in Hyderabad, aims at doorstep services"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Penalties have been provided for false declarations, poor delivery standards and damage to consignments caused by logistics partners, added railway...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Penalties have been provided for false declarations, poor delivery standards and damage to consignments caused by logistics partners, added railway..." articles.title: Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red alert remains for Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Parvathipuram
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli, ASR and Kakinada districts of Andhra move from red to orange alert; the storm heads for landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan may not have much impact on Andhra Pradesh , since the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has revised its initial forecast and said isolated extremely heavy rainfall (red alert) is likely only in three districts, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and Parvathipuram Manyam, on Thursday (November 19, 2026). Earlier, Visakhapatnam , Anakapalli, Alluri Sitharama Raju and Kakinada were also put on red alert. They have now been put on orange alert for November 19. There are no red alerts for the State on November 20, when the system is likely to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha . But there is an orange alert for Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam on November 20, since isolated very heavy rainfall is likely. Meanwhile, the system over the west-central Bay of Bengal moved northwards at 15 kmph and was located at 8.30 a.m. over the same region, about 420 km east-southeast of Narsapur, 400 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam, 490 km south of Gopalpur and 550 km south of Puri in Odisha, and 590 km east-northeast of Chennai. It is likely to move north-northwestward and cross the north Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to the east of Gopalpur, by noon on Friday, with a maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph. As of 12 p.m., very light to light showers had begun in Srikakulam district. Ichchapuram recorded 12.5 mm between 8.30 a.m. and noon, the highest in the State, according to the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Andhra Pradesh (DES-AP). In the 24 hours to 8.30 a.m., no station had recorded more than 9 mm. Thunderstorms and gales, with speeds reaching 90 to 100 kmph, gusting to 110 kmph, are likely at isolated places in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Yanam on Thursday. Squally winds of 30-40 kmph may prevail in Rayalaseema. The intensity of the wind may come down on Friday, since the maximum speed may not go beyond 50 kmph along the coast on November 20, according to the IMD. ALSO WATCH Three cyclones hit AP this month: Why is the Bay of Bengal so active? Expert explains The Srikakulam and Vizianagaram district administrations are on high alert ahead of Cyclone Akvan, which is expected to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha on Friday. Srikakulam, which suffered heavily in the two recent cyclones, Arnab and Murasu , is ready to face the new challenge.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Srikakulam Collector Swapnil Dinakar Pundkar and other officials visited Donkuru and other villages of Ichchapuram , on the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha border, to review the preparedness of local officials. Ichchapuram, Sompeta and other areas were badly affected by floods in the Bahuda after the earlier cyclones.
