🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red alert remains for Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Parvathipuram

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:13:53 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli, ASR and Kakinada districts of Andhra move from red to orange alert; the storm heads for landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan may not have much impact on Andhra Pradesh , since the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has revised its initial forecast and said isolated extremely heavy rainfall (red alert) is likely only in three districts, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and Parvathipuram Manyam, on Thursday (November 19, 2026). Earlier, Visakhapatnam , Anakapalli, Alluri Sitharama Raju and Kakinada were also put on red alert. They have now been put on orange alert for November 19. There are no red alerts for the State on November 20, when the system is likely to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha . But there is an orange alert for Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam on November 20, since isolated very heavy rainfall is likely. Meanwhile, the system over the west-central Bay of Bengal moved northwards at 15 kmph and was located at 8.30 a.m. over the same region, about 420 km east-southeast of Narsapur, 400 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam, 490 km south of Gopalpur and 550 km south of Puri in Odisha, and 590 km east-northeast of Chennai. It is likely to move north-northwestward and cross the north Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to the east of Gopalpur, by noon on Friday, with a maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph. As of 12 p.m., very light to light showers had begun in Srikakulam district. Ichchapuram recorded 12.5 mm between 8.30 a.m. and noon, the highest in the State, according to the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Andhra Pradesh (DES-AP). In the 24 hours to 8.30 a.m., no station had recorded more than 9 mm. Thunderstorms and gales, with speeds reaching 90 to 100 kmph, gusting to 110 kmph, are likely at isolated places in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Yanam on Thursday. Squally winds of 30-40 kmph may prevail in Rayalaseema. The intensity of the wind may come down on Friday, since the maximum speed may not go beyond 50 kmph along the coast on November 20, according to the IMD. ALSO WATCH Three cyclones hit AP this month: Why is the Bay of Bengal so active? Expert explains The Srikakulam and Vizianagaram district administrations are on high alert ahead of Cyclone Akvan, which is expected to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha on Friday. Srikakulam, which suffered heavily in the two recent cyclones, Arnab and Murasu , is ready to face the new challenge.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Srikakulam Collector Swapnil Dinakar Pundkar and other officials visited Donkuru and other villages of Ichchapuram , on the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha border, to review the preparedness of local officials. Ichchapuram, Sompeta and other areas were badly affected by floods in the Bahuda after the earlier cyclones.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Department (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Department' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Intensity (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intensity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red alert remains for Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Parvathipuram", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli, ASR and Kakinada districts of Andhra move from red to orange alert; the storm heads for landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red alert' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red al' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red al' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli, ASR and Kakinada districts of Andhra move from red to orange alert; the storm heads for landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha." (Hinglish Arth: आंध्र के विशाखापत्तनम, अनाकापल्ली, एएसआर और काकीनाडा जिले रेड से ऑरेंज अलर्ट में चले गए; तूफान ओडिशा के गोपालपुर के पास भूस्खलन की ओर बढ़ रहा है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Cyclone Akvan to spare most of Andhra; red alert remains for Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Parvathipuram"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Ichchapuram, Sompeta and other areas were badly affected by floods in the Bahuda after the earlier cyclones.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Ichchapuram, Sompeta and other areas were badly affected by floods in the Bahuda after the earlier cyclones." (Hinglish Arth: पिछले चक्रवातों के बाद बाहुदा में आई बाढ़ से इच्छापुरम, सोमपेटा और अन्य क्षेत्र बुरी तरह प्रभावित हुए थे।)

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan may not have much impact on Andhra Pradesh , since the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has revised its initial forecast and said isolated extremely heavy rainfall (red alert) is likely only in three districts, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and Parvathipuram Manyam, on Thursday (November 19, 2026). Earlier, Visakhapatnam , Anakapalli, Alluri Sitharama Raju and Kakinada were also put on red alert. They have now been put on orange alert for November 19. There are no red alerts for the State on November 20, when the system is likely to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha . But there is an orange alert for Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam on November 20, since isolated very heavy rainfall is likely. Meanwhile, the system over the west-central Bay of Bengal moved northwards at 15 kmph and was located at 8.30 a.m. over the same region, about 420 km east-southeast of Narsapur, 400 km south-southeast of Kalingapatnam, 490 km south of Gopalpur and 550 km south of Puri in Odisha, and 590 km east-northeast of Chennai. It is likely to move north-northwestward and cross the north Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri, close to the east of Gopalpur, by noon on Friday, with a maximum sustained wind speed of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph. As of 12 p.m., very light to light showers had begun in Srikakulam district. Ichchapuram recorded 12.5 mm between 8.30 a.m. and noon, the highest in the State, according to the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Andhra Pradesh (DES-AP). In the 24 hours to 8.30 a.m., no station had recorded more than 9 mm. Thunderstorms and gales, with speeds reaching 90 to 100 kmph, gusting to 110 kmph, are likely at isolated places in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Yanam on Thursday. Squally winds of 30-40 kmph may prevail in Rayalaseema. The intensity of the wind may come down on Friday, since the maximum speed may not go beyond 50 kmph along the coast on November 20, according to the IMD. ALSO WATCH Three cyclones hit AP this month: Why is the Bay of Bengal so active? Expert explains The Srikakulam and Vizianagaram district administrations are on high alert ahead of Cyclone Akvan, which is expected to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha on Friday. Srikakulam, which suffered heavily in the two recent cyclones, Arnab and Murasu , is ready to face the new challenge.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Srikakulam Collector Swapnil Dinakar Pundkar and other officials visited Donkuru and other villages of Ichchapuram , on the Andhra Pradesh-Odisha border, to review the preparedness of local officials. Ichchapuram, Sompeta and other areas were badly affected by floods in the Bahuda after the earlier cyclones.

The fishermen were out in the deep sea when worsening weather conditions forced them to take shelter at the fish landing centre in Aryapalli, Assistant Fisheries Officer (Marine) Devidutt Mohanty said. The Ganjam district administration has provided them with necessary facilities at the jetty, he said. As Ganjam is likely to be the worst hit by the impending cyclone, the district administration has shifted 36,398 people to shelters by 6 a.m. on Thursday (November 19, 2026), and evacuation is underway, an official said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Altogether, 308 shelters are operational, with free kitchens serving the evacuated people, he said, adding that 1,098 pregnant women have been shifted safely.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Cyclone 'Akvan' LIVE updates: Over one lakh evacuated in Odisha as landfall likely near Gopalpur; red alert for three A.P. districts

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:13:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The IMD says the corridor for landfall, likely on Nov. 20 noon, stretches from Andhra's Narsapur in Andhra Pradesh to Odisha's Puri

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Severe cyclonic storm Akvan may not have much impact on Andhra Pradesh , since the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has revised its initial forecast and said isolated extremely heavy rainfall (red alert) is likely only in three districts, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and Parvathipuram Manyam, on Thursday (November 19, 2026). Earlier, Visakhapatnam , Anakapalli, Alluri Sitharama Raju and Kakinada were also put on red alert. They have now been put on orange alert for November 19. There are no red alerts for the State on November 20, when the system is likely to cross the coast near Gopalpur in Odisha . But there is an orange alert for Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam on November 20, since isolated very heavy rainfall is likely. Cyclone Akvan: red alert only for Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and Parvathipuram Manyam on November 19 as the storm heads for landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. Around 80 fishermen from Andhra Pradesh’s Kakinada, along with 10 motorised boats, have taken shelter in Odisha’s Ganjam district as rough sea conditions under the influence of severe cyclonic storm Akvan prevented them from returning home, officials said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). The fishermen were out in the deep sea when worsening weather conditions forced them to take shelter at the fish landing centre in Aryapalli, Assistant Fisheries Officer (Marine) Devidutt Mohanty said. The Ganjam district administration has provided them with necessary facilities at the jetty, he said. They have food supplies on their boats and are preparing their own meals, adding that they would return to Andhra Pradesh once sea conditions improve. The Odisha government has evacuated more than 80,000 people to safety, deployed 74 rescue teams and closed educational institutes in several districts as precautionary measures in view of Cyclone ‘Akvan’, officials said. The State government has closed educational institutes in districts marked under ‘red’ (take action), ‘orange’ (be prepared) and ‘yellow’ (be aware) warnings, another official said, adding that 74 rescue teams have been deployed in Malkangiri, Koraput, Rayagada, Kalahandi, Gajapati, Ganjam, Kandhamal, Boudh, Puri, Nayagarh and Khurda districts. As Ganjam is likely to be the worst hit by the impending cyclone, the district administration has shifted 36,398 people to shelters by 6 a.m. on Thursday (November 19, 2026), and evacuation is underway, an official said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Altogether, 308 shelters are operational, with free kitchens serving the evacuated people, he said, adding that 1,098 pregnant women have been shifted safely.

मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).

संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Administration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Educational (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Educational' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

articles.title: Andhra lorry owners seek help as trucks denied fitness certificates over VAHAN glitch
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Seeking the All India Motor Transport Congress’s intervention, lorry owners allege that Automated Testing Station operators are not issuing fitness certificates because Speed Limiting Device data is missing on the VAHAN portal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Andhra Pradesh Lorry Owners’ Association (APLOA) has sought the immediate intervention of the All India Motor Transport Congress (AIMTC) to impress upon the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways the need to resolve the non-issuance of fitness certificates to thousands of trucks across Andhra Pradesh over the past four days, owing to the non-availability of Speed Limiting Device (SLD) data on the VAHAN portal. In a letter to AIMTC national president Harish Sabharwal, APLOA State general secretary Y.V. Eswara Rao said Automated Testing Station (ATS) operators were refusing to issue fitness certificates on the ground that SLD details were not appearing on the portal, leaving thousands of trucks stranded and causing heavy financial losses to vehicle owners. He said the Central government had mandated installation of in-built SLDs in trucks since 2015 and vehicle manufacturers were responsible for uploading the relevant technical details onto the VAHAN portal. “It is unfair to penalise truck owners for data-uploading failures by manufacturers or technical glitches in the system,” he said. Mr. Eswara Rao, who is also the AIMTC’s vice-president South Zone, urged its representatives to take up the matter with senior officials of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and secure immediate instructions to ATS operators not to deny fitness certificates solely because of the non-availability of SLD data. He also sought temporary relaxation of the requirement until the technical issue was resolved, and called for directions to vehicle manufacturers to upload the pending data and establish a permanent solution to prevent recurrence of the problem.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said keeping trucks off the roads over technical issues beyond the control of owners was imposing an avoidable financial burden on the already struggling transport sector.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Andhra lorry owners seek help as trucks denied fitness certificates over VAHAN glitch

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:11:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Seeking the All India Motor Transport Congress’s intervention, lorry owners allege that Automated Testing Station operators are not issuing fitness certificates because Speed Limiting Device data is missing on the VAHAN portal

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Andhra Pradesh Lorry Owners’ Association (APLOA) has sought the immediate intervention of the All India Motor Transport Congress (AIMTC) to impress upon the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways the need to resolve the non-issuance of fitness certificates to thousands of trucks across Andhra Pradesh over the past four days, owing to the non-availability of Speed Limiting Device (SLD) data on the VAHAN portal. In a letter to AIMTC national president Harish Sabharwal, APLOA State general secretary Y.V. Eswara Rao said Automated Testing Station (ATS) operators were refusing to issue fitness certificates on the ground that SLD details were not appearing on the portal, leaving thousands of trucks stranded and causing heavy financial losses to vehicle owners. He said the Central government had mandated installation of in-built SLDs in trucks since 2015 and vehicle manufacturers were responsible for uploading the relevant technical details onto the VAHAN portal. “It is unfair to penalise truck owners for data-uploading failures by manufacturers or technical glitches in the system,” he said. Mr. Eswara Rao, who is also the AIMTC’s vice-president South Zone, urged its representatives to take up the matter with senior officials of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and secure immediate instructions to ATS operators not to deny fitness certificates solely because of the non-availability of SLD data. He also sought temporary relaxation of the requirement until the technical issue was resolved, and called for directions to vehicle manufacturers to upload the pending data and establish a permanent solution to prevent recurrence of the problem.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He said keeping trucks off the roads over technical issues beyond the control of owners was imposing an avoidable financial burden on the already struggling transport sector.

नियमों में ढील या छूट — किसी कड़े प्रतिबंध को थोड़े समय के लिए हल्का करना।

Intervention (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Intervention' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Availability (Noun)
उपलब्धता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Availability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Installation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Installation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

articles.title: Yunus's ancestral home set ablaze as violence grips Bangladesh
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Newspaper reports said rival activists, presumably belonging to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), overnight attacked or set ablaze the residences of two Awami League leaders in Dhaka.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Crude bomb explosions rocked Bangladesh's capital before dawn, while former interim government chief Muhammad Yunus's ancestral home was torched in Chattogram. The unrest followed a Thursday (November 19, 2026) "lockdown" call by the banned Awami League , led by former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Police and witnesses said at least four people were wounded. Witnesses reported explosions of a series of improvised devices, arson attacks and vandalism in Dhaka despite stepped-up security. Unidentified arsonists set fire to Mr. Yunus's paternal home at Chattogram's Panchlaish area after several branches of his Grameen Bank in different parts of Bangladesh were set on fire. Newspaper reports said rival activists, presumably belonging to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman 's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), overnight attacked or set ablaze the residences of two Awami League leaders in Dhaka. Police said they stepped up security overnight, mobilising more personnel at major flyovers across the capital. At the same time, officers were seen checking vehicles at entry and exit points and questioning motorcyclists and drivers of suspicious vehicles. Awami League called the lockdown coinciding with the anniversary of a special tribunal verdict sentencing Ms. Hasina to death last year after trying her in absentia on charges of committing crimes against humanity. Ms. Hasina, 79, has been living in India since fleeing Bangladesh on August 5, 2024, following a student-led protest called the July Uprising that toppled her government. Bangladesh has been seeking her extradition from India. Officials said thousands of paramilitary Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) troops were called out to maintain order in sensitive districts including southwestern Gopalganj district, Ms. Hasina's birthplace. According to BDnews24 , police arrested 565 people in a 24-hour drive in Dhaka alone ahead of the lockdown, with one prominent person being former Education Minister in Ms. Hasina's cabinet Nurul Islam Nahid, who was detained from his Dhaka residence at midnight on Wednesday (November 18, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Prime Minister Tarique on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) night sought "democratic forces" unity to prevent "resurgence" of Awami League, describing it as a "terrorist outfit" and "fallen, defeated, and ousted fascist force" and called for actions for its "decisive defeat".

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Yunus's ancestral home set ablaze as violence grips Bangladesh

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 04:15:30 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Newspaper reports said rival activists, presumably belonging to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), overnight attacked or set ablaze the residences of two Awami League leaders in Dhaka.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Crude bomb explosions rocked Bangladesh's capital before dawn, while former interim government chief Muhammad Yunus's ancestral home was torched in Chattogram. The unrest followed a Thursday (November 19, 2026) "lockdown" call by the banned Awami League , led by former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Police and witnesses said at least four people were wounded. Witnesses reported explosions of a series of improvised devices, arson attacks and vandalism in Dhaka despite stepped-up security. Unidentified arsonists set fire to Mr. Yunus's paternal home at Chattogram's Panchlaish area after several branches of his Grameen Bank in different parts of Bangladesh were set on fire. Newspaper reports said rival activists, presumably belonging to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman 's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), overnight attacked or set ablaze the residences of two Awami League leaders in Dhaka. Police said they stepped up security overnight, mobilising more personnel at major flyovers across the capital. At the same time, officers were seen checking vehicles at entry and exit points and questioning motorcyclists and drivers of suspicious vehicles. Awami League called the lockdown coinciding with the anniversary of a special tribunal verdict sentencing Ms. Hasina to death last year after trying her in absentia on charges of committing crimes against humanity. Ms. Hasina, 79, has been living in India since fleeing Bangladesh on August 5, 2024, following a student-led protest called the July Uprising that toppled her government. Bangladesh has been seeking her extradition from India. Officials said thousands of paramilitary Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) troops were called out to maintain order in sensitive districts including southwestern Gopalganj district, Ms. Hasina's birthplace. According to BDnews24 , police arrested 565 people in a 24-hour drive in Dhaka alone ahead of the lockdown, with one prominent person being former Education Minister in Ms. Hasina's cabinet Nurul Islam Nahid, who was detained from his Dhaka residence at midnight on Wednesday (November 18, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Prime Minister Tarique on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) night sought "democratic forces" unity to prevent "resurgence" of Awami League, describing it as a "terrorist outfit" and "fallen, defeated, and ousted fascist force" and called for actions for its "decisive defeat".

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Newspaper reports said rival activists, presumably belonging to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), overnight attacked or set ablaze the residences of two Awami League leaders in Dhaka.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Crude bomb explosions rocked Bangladesh's capital before dawn, while former interim government chief Muhammad Yunus's ancestral home was torched in Chattogram. The unrest followed a Thursday (November 19, 2026) "lockdown" call by the banned Awami League , led by former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Police and witnesses said at least four people were wounded. Witnesses reported explosions of a series of improvised devices, arson attacks and vandalism in Dhaka despite stepped-up security. Unidentified arsonists set fire to Mr. Yunus's paternal home at Chattogram's Panchlaish area after several branches of his Grameen Bank in different parts of Bangladesh were set on fire. Newspaper reports said rival activists, presumably belonging to Prime Minister Tarique Rahman 's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), overnight attacked or set ablaze the residences of two Awami League leaders in Dhaka. Police said they stepped up security overnight, mobilising more personnel at major flyovers across the capital. At the same time, officers were seen checking vehicles at entry and exit points and questioning motorcyclists and drivers of suspicious vehicles. Awami League called the lockdown coinciding with the anniversary of a special tribunal verdict sentencing Ms. Hasina to death last year after trying her in absentia on charges of committing crimes against humanity. Ms. Hasina, 79, has been living in India since fleeing Bangladesh on August 5, 2024, following a student-led protest called the July Uprising that toppled her government. Bangladesh has been seeking her extradition from India. Officials said thousands of paramilitary Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) troops were called out to maintain order in sensitive districts including southwestern Gopalganj district, Ms. Hasina's birthplace. According to BDnews24 , police arrested 565 people in a 24-hour drive in Dhaka alone ahead of the lockdown, with one prominent person being former Education Minister in Ms. Hasina's cabinet Nurul Islam Nahid, who was detained from his Dhaka residence at midnight on Wednesday (November 18, 2026).
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Prime Minister Tarique on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) night sought "democratic forces" unity to prevent "resurgence" of Awami League, describing it as a "terrorist outfit" and "fallen, defeated, and ousted fascist force" and called for actions for its "decisive defeat".

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The war in ‌Ukraine dominated a meeting between Russian ​President Vladimir Putin ⁠and U.S. President Donald Trump, Kremlin foreign policy aide Yuri ‌Ushakov said on Thursday, November 19

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Some in the West are comparing the three-way meeting to the 1945 Yalta conference, where the wartime leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union divided Germany and Berlin, carved out zones of influence in Europe, and agreed to establish the United Nations. The Kremlin, which long has courted the concept of a “multipolar world” offering an equal say to all nations, plays down the Yalta comparisons, which are also unwelcome to China for similar reasons. Fyodor Lukyanov, a pro-Kremlin foreign policy expert, noted that even as Moscow publicly rejects the Yalta analogy, it seems to believe the leaders could “reach agreements and make decisions that will determine global developments”. Of the three nations, “it seems that only Russia really believes in the possibility of global control”, he told a recent roundtable. Chatham House director Bronwen Maddox said in a commentary that “standing with Xi and Trump, Putin will look like one of the three main leaders of the world”, even though “Russia is no superpower” and its economy, overloaded with military spending, is dwindling. She warned that “the danger for Ukraine is that Trump uses this summit to try to advance his notion of peace, including giving Russia territory it has not managed to seize by force”. The meeting follows US-mediated peace talks between Russia and Ukraine held in Abu Dhabi last week for the first time in nine months. The negotiations produced few visible results as the parties stuck to their sharply divergent demands. -- AP Trilateral Xi-Putin-Trump summit draws Yalta 1945 comparisons, highlighting postwar order shifts amid Ukraine tensions and multipolar world debates. The United States and China want to help end the war in Ukraine, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) as he met his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping in Shenzhen.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We’re looking to both help with respect to the war with Russia and Ukraine. I’d like to see it ended, I think I can speak for both of us, very much,” Mr. Trump said.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral meeting LIVE: Xi says China-U.S. relations 'stable and improved'

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 12:46:27 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The war in ‌Ukraine dominated a meeting between Russian ​President Vladimir Putin ⁠and U.S. President Donald Trump, Kremlin foreign policy aide Yuri ‌Ushakov said on Thursday, November 19

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Some in the West are comparing the three-way meeting to the 1945 Yalta conference, where the wartime leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union divided Germany and Berlin, carved out zones of influence in Europe, and agreed to establish the United Nations. The Kremlin, which long has courted the concept of a “multipolar world” offering an equal say to all nations, plays down the Yalta comparisons, which are also unwelcome to China for similar reasons. Fyodor Lukyanov, a pro-Kremlin foreign policy expert, noted that even as Moscow publicly rejects the Yalta analogy, it seems to believe the leaders could “reach agreements and make decisions that will determine global developments”. Of the three nations, “it seems that only Russia really believes in the possibility of global control”, he told a recent roundtable. Chatham House director Bronwen Maddox said in a commentary that “standing with Xi and Trump, Putin will look like one of the three main leaders of the world”, even though “Russia is no superpower” and its economy, overloaded with military spending, is dwindling. She warned that “the danger for Ukraine is that Trump uses this summit to try to advance his notion of peace, including giving Russia territory it has not managed to seize by force”. The meeting follows US-mediated peace talks between Russia and Ukraine held in Abu Dhabi last week for the first time in nine months. The negotiations produced few visible results as the parties stuck to their sharply divergent demands. -- AP Trilateral Xi-Putin-Trump summit draws Yalta 1945 comparisons, highlighting postwar order shifts amid Ukraine tensions and multipolar world debates. The United States and China want to help end the war in Ukraine, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) as he met his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping in Shenzhen.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We’re looking to both help with respect to the war with Russia and Ukraine. I’d like to see it ended, I think I can speak for both of us, very much,” Mr. Trump said.

articles.title: India, Canada eye defence pact during Modi visit in December
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India’s High Commissioner to Ottawa says both countries cannot afford to let fringe issues derail their extensive mutual interests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India and Canada could be announcing a defence agreement during Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’s official visit in December, according to the country’s High Commissioner to Ottawa, Dinesh K. Patnaik. Both countries are also in the final stages of negotiations of a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. “We are on the cusp of finalising it,” Mr. Patnaik said. Addressing a gathering in the Canadian capital organised by the Centre for Strategic Statecraft and the Canadian International Council, he said that both countries cannot afford to let fringe issues derail their extensive mutual interests. Mr. Patnaik took over as India’s High Commissioner to Ottawa in September 2025. Both countries had earlier expelled each other’s High Commissioners and reduced their diplomatic presence following the murder of Sikh Khalistani activist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in June 2023. Then Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau accused India of orchestrating the murder, throwing bilateral relations into a tailspin. Subsequent reports by Canadian agencies also listed India, alongside China and Russia, as an interferer in domestic politics. The turnaround in ties, which began with the mutual reinstatement of High Commissioners, is set to reach a milestone with Mr. Modi’s visit on December 11 and 12. Mr. Patnaik said India and Canada are no longer talking about a reset of their derailed relations, but rather an overarching boost in ties spanning defence, space, nuclear energy, deep tech, trade, and the mobility of people. The two nations have moved from a complete lack of trust over a year ago to an unprecedented degree of mutual trust, he added. “The fact is that in the core strategic concerns of Canada and India, there is no conflict. Still, all it took for the entire bilateral relationship to be derailed was the fringe diaspora issue,” he said, referring to the murder of Nijjar. “The reason was the lack of trust. India believed that Canada was actively promoting separatism in India, and Canada believed India was organising violence in Canada. We had a series of meetings between senior Ministers, NSAs of both countries, and agencies at all levels as we set about rebuilding trust. Today, we have reached the highest levels of trust, where the most sensitive areas of cooperation, such as deep tech, defence, and space, are subjects of mutual cooperation,” Mr. Patnaik said. Cooperation between Canadian and Indian agencies remains at a high level, the High Commissioner added.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Canada / politics / politics (general) / defence / national politics

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 India, Canada eye defence pact during Modi visit in December

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 12:31:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India’s High Commissioner to Ottawa says both countries cannot afford to let fringe issues derail their extensive mutual interests

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India and Canada could be announcing a defence agreement during Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’s official visit in December, according to the country’s High Commissioner to Ottawa, Dinesh K. Patnaik. Both countries are also in the final stages of negotiations of a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. “We are on the cusp of finalising it,” Mr. Patnaik said. Addressing a gathering in the Canadian capital organised by the Centre for Strategic Statecraft and the Canadian International Council, he said that both countries cannot afford to let fringe issues derail their extensive mutual interests. Mr. Patnaik took over as India’s High Commissioner to Ottawa in September 2025. Both countries had earlier expelled each other’s High Commissioners and reduced their diplomatic presence following the murder of Sikh Khalistani activist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in June 2023. Then Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau accused India of orchestrating the murder, throwing bilateral relations into a tailspin. Subsequent reports by Canadian agencies also listed India, alongside China and Russia, as an interferer in domestic politics. The turnaround in ties, which began with the mutual reinstatement of High Commissioners, is set to reach a milestone with Mr. Modi’s visit on December 11 and 12. Mr. Patnaik said India and Canada are no longer talking about a reset of their derailed relations, but rather an overarching boost in ties spanning defence, space, nuclear energy, deep tech, trade, and the mobility of people. The two nations have moved from a complete lack of trust over a year ago to an unprecedented degree of mutual trust, he added. “The fact is that in the core strategic concerns of Canada and India, there is no conflict. Still, all it took for the entire bilateral relationship to be derailed was the fringe diaspora issue,” he said, referring to the murder of Nijjar. “The reason was the lack of trust. India believed that Canada was actively promoting separatism in India, and Canada believed India was organising violence in Canada. We had a series of meetings between senior Ministers, NSAs of both countries, and agencies at all levels as we set about rebuilding trust. Today, we have reached the highest levels of trust, where the most sensitive areas of cooperation, such as deep tech, defence, and space, are subjects of mutual cooperation,” Mr. Patnaik said. Cooperation between Canadian and Indian agencies remains at a high level, the High Commissioner added.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Canada / politics / politics (general) / defence / national politics

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Reinstatement (Adjective)
बहाली — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Reinstatement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’ ahead of trilateral summit
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday hailed relations with Russia “as a source of stability” in a “turbulent” world, even as he welcomed U.S. President Donald Trump with a rare airport reception a day ahead of a trilateral summit in Shenzhen. On Thursday (November 19, 2026), leaders of the three countries will hold a summit, which Beijing has described as having “groundbreaking significance”. U.S. officials said the three leaders will likely discuss, among other issues, the war in Ukraine, the situation in Iran, global energy stability, and nuclear arms control. Officials have described the rare trilateral leaders’ summit as more of an exploratory and symbolic meeting, playing down the likelihood of substantive outcomes, either with regard to a possible Russia-Ukraine deal or on the West Asian crisis. Whether they can see eye-to-eye on nuclear disarmament also remains to be seen. At the same time, Beijing has highlighted the symbolism of the summit happening on its soil, describing it as a landmark moment for what China calls “major country diplomacy”. In talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Xi described China-Russia relations “as a source of stability and certainty in a turbulent world and as a model of a new type of major-power relationship characterised by equality, mutual respect, trust, and win-win cooperation.” The U.S. President landed in Shenzhen on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), and Mr. Xi welcomed him at the airport with a hug — a rare greeting from the Chinese President, who was reciprocating Mr. Trump similarly receiving him in September at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington. Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomes US President Donald Trump as he arrives at Shenzhen Airport to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders Summit in Shenzhen, China on November 18, 2026. | Photo Credit: Reuters The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains. “The world is facing mounting instability, insufficient momentum for economic growth, and a resurgence of unilateralism and protectionism. At the same time, global trade is still growing despite headwinds and emerging technologies are advancing rapidly, reshaping global development,” he said, adding that “the key questions of the age were whether the world would choose openness or closure, cooperation or division, reform or stagnation.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Xi called for barriers to trade and investment to be reduced and proposed establishing a World Bay Area Economic Cooperation Alliance. Beijing has been developing the Greater Bay Area, including Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macau, as an innovation hub.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday hailed relations with Russia “as a source of stability” in a “turbulent” world, even as he welcomed U.S. President Donald Trump with a rare airport reception a day ahead of a trilateral summit in Shenzhen. On Thursday (November 19, 2026), leaders of the three countries will hold a summit, which Beijing has described as having “groundbreaking significance”. U.S. officials said the three leaders will likely discuss, among other issues, the war in Ukraine, the situation in Iran, global energy stability, and nuclear arms control. Officials have described the rare trilateral leaders’ summit as more of an exploratory and symbolic meeting, playing down the likelihood of substantive outcomes, either with regard to a possible Russia-Ukraine deal or on the West Asian crisis. Whether they can see eye-to-eye on nuclear disarmament also remains to be seen. At the same time, Beijing has highlighted the symbolism of the summit happening on its soil, describing it as a landmark moment for what China calls “major country diplomacy”. In talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Xi described China-Russia relations “as a source of stability and certainty in a turbulent world and as a model of a new type of major-power relationship characterised by equality, mutual respect, trust, and win-win cooperation.” The U.S. President landed in Shenzhen on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), and Mr. Xi welcomed him at the airport with a hug — a rare greeting from the Chinese President, who was reciprocating Mr. Trump similarly receiving him in September at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington. Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomes US President Donald Trump as he arrives at Shenzhen Airport to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders Summit in Shenzhen, China on November 18, 2026. | Photo Credit: Reuters The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains. “The world is facing mounting instability, insufficient momentum for economic growth, and a resurgence of unilateralism and protectionism. At the same time, global trade is still growing despite headwinds and emerging technologies are advancing rapidly, reshaping global development,” he said, adding that “the key questions of the age were whether the world would choose openness or closure, cooperation or division, reform or stagnation.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Xi called for barriers to trade and investment to be reduced and proposed establishing a World Bay Area Economic Cooperation Alliance. Beijing has been developing the Greater Bay Area, including Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macau, as an innovation hub.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’ ahead of trilateral summit

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 12:27:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday hailed relations with Russia “as a source of stability” in a “turbulent” world, even as he welcomed U.S. President Donald Trump with a rare airport reception a day ahead of a trilateral summit in Shenzhen. On Thursday (November 19, 2026), leaders of the three countries will hold a summit, which Beijing has described as having “groundbreaking significance”. U.S. officials said the three leaders will likely discuss, among other issues, the war in Ukraine, the situation in Iran, global energy stability, and nuclear arms control. Officials have described the rare trilateral leaders’ summit as more of an exploratory and symbolic meeting, playing down the likelihood of substantive outcomes, either with regard to a possible Russia-Ukraine deal or on the West Asian crisis. Whether they can see eye-to-eye on nuclear disarmament also remains to be seen. At the same time, Beijing has highlighted the symbolism of the summit happening on its soil, describing it as a landmark moment for what China calls “major country diplomacy”. In talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Xi described China-Russia relations “as a source of stability and certainty in a turbulent world and as a model of a new type of major-power relationship characterised by equality, mutual respect, trust, and win-win cooperation.” The U.S. President landed in Shenzhen on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), and Mr. Xi welcomed him at the airport with a hug — a rare greeting from the Chinese President, who was reciprocating Mr. Trump similarly receiving him in September at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington. Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomes US President Donald Trump as he arrives at Shenzhen Airport to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders Summit in Shenzhen, China on November 18, 2026. | Photo Credit: Reuters The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains. “The world is facing mounting instability, insufficient momentum for economic growth, and a resurgence of unilateralism and protectionism. At the same time, global trade is still growing despite headwinds and emerging technologies are advancing rapidly, reshaping global development,” he said, adding that “the key questions of the age were whether the world would choose openness or closure, cooperation or division, reform or stagnation.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Xi called for barriers to trade and investment to be reduced and proposed establishing a World Bay Area Economic Cooperation Alliance. Beijing has been developing the Greater Bay Area, including Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macau, as an innovation hub.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’ ahead of trilateral summit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’ ah' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Chinese President opened the two-day APEC gathering with an address to a CEO Summit, where he made a pitch for openness and stable supply chains." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Xi hails Russia ties as ‘source of stability’ ahead of trilateral summit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Beijing has been developing the Greater Bay Area, including Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macau, as an innovation hub.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Beijing has been developing the Greater Bay Area, including Shenzhen, Hong Kong and Macau, as an innovation hub." (Hinglish Arth: बीजिंग शेन्ज़ेन, हांगकांग और मकाऊ समेत ग्रेटर बे एरिया को इनोवेशन हब के रूप में विकसित कर रहा है।)

articles.title: West Asia crisis 'largest threat' to energy security ever: IEA
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The report said elsewhere that "increasingly it is falling to consumers — and high prices — to absorb the impact as other buffers are run down"

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The crisis in West Asia sparked in February by the U.S. and Israeli bombing of Iran has created the "largest threat" to energy security in history, the International Energy Agency (IEA) warned on Thursday (November 19, 2026). The agency said in its flagship annual World Energy Outlook that consumers were increasingly footing the bill as the world runs out of ways to absorb the impact of the conflict on energy supplies. The crisis, just like previous energy shocks, would certainly leave "lasting marks", the agency warned. ALSO WATCH Watch: At least 40 energy facilities ‘severely’ affected: IEA Chief Gulf countries have been struggling to export oil since Iran began blockading the Strait of Hormuz and targeting tankers in the area, following U.S. and Israeli strikes that sparked the crisis in February. Despite attempts by the United States to escort vessels through the channel — which pre-crisis carried about one-fifth of global oil shipments — supply lines remain severely disrupted. "The Strait of Hormuz crisis has created the largest threat to energy security in history, one that dwarfs the scale of the oil shocks of the 1970s," IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol wrote in his foreword to the report. He highlighted the efforts countries had taken to protect households, with producing nations bringing more supplies into the market and using alternative routes, and China buying less from international markets. "Governments have intervened to try and provide some shelter for consumers, but they have nonetheless faced higher prices and, in some cases, shortfalls of supply," Mr. Birol wrote.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The report said elsewhere that "increasingly it is falling to consumers — and high prices — to absorb the impact as other buffers are run down".

1. Core Context & Background: The report said elsewhere that "increasingly it is falling to consumers — and high prices — to absorb the impact as other buffers are run down"

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The crisis in West Asia sparked in February by the U.S. and Israeli bombing of Iran has created the "largest threat" to energy security in history, the International Energy Agency (IEA) warned on Thursday (November 19, 2026). The agency said in its flagship annual World Energy Outlook that consumers were increasingly footing the bill as the world runs out of ways to absorb the impact of the conflict on energy supplies. The crisis, just like previous energy shocks, would certainly leave "lasting marks", the agency warned. ALSO WATCH Watch: At least 40 energy facilities ‘severely’ affected: IEA Chief Gulf countries have been struggling to export oil since Iran began blockading the Strait of Hormuz and targeting tankers in the area, following U.S. and Israeli strikes that sparked the crisis in February. Despite attempts by the United States to escort vessels through the channel — which pre-crisis carried about one-fifth of global oil shipments — supply lines remain severely disrupted. "The Strait of Hormuz crisis has created the largest threat to energy security in history, one that dwarfs the scale of the oil shocks of the 1970s," IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol wrote in his foreword to the report. He highlighted the efforts countries had taken to protect households, with producing nations bringing more supplies into the market and using alternative routes, and China buying less from international markets. "Governments have intervened to try and provide some shelter for consumers, but they have nonetheless faced higher prices and, in some cases, shortfalls of supply," Mr. Birol wrote.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The report said elsewhere that "increasingly it is falling to consumers — and high prices — to absorb the impact as other buffers are run down".

articles.title: IIIT-H students develop web plugin to translate text into Indian Sign Language
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The tool is a simple plugin that lets you select text on a web page, producing a 3D avatar that signs in the Indian Sign Language

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Indian Sign Language (ISL) uses gestures to represent complex words and sentences and has its own grammar and word order. People with hearing impairments find it a challenge to read content online. To address this gap, Masthan Sharif Shaik and Mohammed Raza, third-year BTech. students from the Center for Visual Information Technology (CVIT), IIIT-Hyderabad, under the supervision of Prof. C.V. Jawahar and Prof. Vinay Namboodiri (University of Bath, U.K.), developed a cost-effective plugin that can be added to any website. The plugin can run inside a browser in real time, without any real hardware or an AI model running on a server. “Websites today support captions, screen readers, and high-contrast modes, but almost none of them can show content in sign language. Existing signing avatars are either costly motion-capture systems, heavy AI models that need powerful GPUs, or systems built from sign notation – all of which require linguistic experts and also tend to move robotically,” Sharif said. The researchers first took the official Indian Sign Language Research And Training Centre’s sign-language dictionary videos and used computer vision to recover each signer’s 3D body, hand and finger movements. “Automatic reconstruction, however, often gets fingers wrong, and in sign language a wrong finger can change the meaning. So, we built an annotation tool, Gizmo, to correct only the few key poses of each sign instead of every frame,” Sharif said. There is an offline preprocessing that takes place where sentences are converted into ISL word order. For example, a sentence such as “He will come home” in ISL becomes “He home come”. When a sentence like the former is highlighted and the ‘Click To Sign’ button is selected, the stored motion for each sign is , and the signs are blended smoothly, allowing the avatar to sign the whole sentence fluidly. Words without a sign are fingerspelled letter by letter. The movements are more natural in this case because the avatar replays motion captured from real signers rather than motion generated from notation. Additionally, what makes this task unique is that it all happens without a GPU. “The heavy computer-vision work happens once, offline, when the sign dictionary is built. Viewing a sentence only replays and blends stored motion together, which an ordinary laptop handles”, says Sharif. When tested on deaf and hard-of-hearing signers, the ISL signers understood about 89% of sentences signed by the avatar. However, the lack of facial features in the avatar was cited as a drawback because expressions typically include grammar in ISL, as well as signs that change form in context. “We will work to incorporate this in our next iteration,” says Sharif.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Indian Sign language (ISL) seriously lacks resources and technologies”, explains Prof. Jawahar. The group is working in two directions – Sign Language Synthesis as well as Sign Language Understanding. The plugin is related to sign language synthesis from text on low cost commodity hardware.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 IIIT-H students develop web plugin to translate text into Indian Sign Language

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 02:38:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The tool is a simple plugin that lets you select text on a web page, producing a 3D avatar that signs in the Indian Sign Language

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Indian Sign Language (ISL) uses gestures to represent complex words and sentences and has its own grammar and word order. People with hearing impairments find it a challenge to read content online. To address this gap, Masthan Sharif Shaik and Mohammed Raza, third-year BTech. students from the Center for Visual Information Technology (CVIT), IIIT-Hyderabad, under the supervision of Prof. C.V. Jawahar and Prof. Vinay Namboodiri (University of Bath, U.K.), developed a cost-effective plugin that can be added to any website. The plugin can run inside a browser in real time, without any real hardware or an AI model running on a server. “Websites today support captions, screen readers, and high-contrast modes, but almost none of them can show content in sign language. Existing signing avatars are either costly motion-capture systems, heavy AI models that need powerful GPUs, or systems built from sign notation – all of which require linguistic experts and also tend to move robotically,” Sharif said. The researchers first took the official Indian Sign Language Research And Training Centre’s sign-language dictionary videos and used computer vision to recover each signer’s 3D body, hand and finger movements. “Automatic reconstruction, however, often gets fingers wrong, and in sign language a wrong finger can change the meaning. So, we built an annotation tool, Gizmo, to correct only the few key poses of each sign instead of every frame,” Sharif said. There is an offline preprocessing that takes place where sentences are converted into ISL word order. For example, a sentence such as “He will come home” in ISL becomes “He home come”. When a sentence like the former is highlighted and the ‘Click To Sign’ button is selected, the stored motion for each sign is , and the signs are blended smoothly, allowing the avatar to sign the whole sentence fluidly. Words without a sign are fingerspelled letter by letter. The movements are more natural in this case because the avatar replays motion captured from real signers rather than motion generated from notation. Additionally, what makes this task unique is that it all happens without a GPU. “The heavy computer-vision work happens once, offline, when the sign dictionary is built. Viewing a sentence only replays and blends stored motion together, which an ordinary laptop handles”, says Sharif. When tested on deaf and hard-of-hearing signers, the ISL signers understood about 89% of sentences signed by the avatar. However, the lack of facial features in the avatar was cited as a drawback because expressions typically include grammar in ISL, as well as signs that change form in context. “We will work to incorporate this in our next iteration,” says Sharif.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Indian Sign language (ISL) seriously lacks resources and technologies”, explains Prof. Jawahar. The group is working in two directions – Sign Language Synthesis as well as Sign Language Understanding. The plugin is related to sign language synthesis from text on low cost commodity hardware.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The tool is a simple plugin that lets you select text on a web page, producing a 3D avatar that signs in the Indian Sign Language
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Indian Sign Language (ISL) uses gestures to represent complex words and sentences and has its own grammar and word order. People with hearing impairments find it a challenge to read content online. To address this gap, Masthan Sharif Shaik and Mohammed Raza, third-year BTech. students from the Center for Visual Information Technology (CVIT), IIIT-Hyderabad, under the supervision of Prof. C.V. Jawahar and Prof. Vinay Namboodiri (University of Bath, U.K.), developed a cost-effective plugin that can be added to any website. The plugin can run inside a browser in real time, without any real hardware or an AI model running on a server. “Websites today support captions, screen readers, and high-contrast modes, but almost none of them can show content in sign language. Existing signing avatars are either costly motion-capture systems, heavy AI models that need powerful GPUs, or systems built from sign notation – all of which require linguistic experts and also tend to move robotically,” Sharif said. The researchers first took the official Indian Sign Language Research And Training Centre’s sign-language dictionary videos and used computer vision to recover each signer’s 3D body, hand and finger movements. “Automatic reconstruction, however, often gets fingers wrong, and in sign language a wrong finger can change the meaning. So, we built an annotation tool, Gizmo, to correct only the few key poses of each sign instead of every frame,” Sharif said. There is an offline preprocessing that takes place where sentences are converted into ISL word order. For example, a sentence such as “He will come home” in ISL becomes “He home come”. When a sentence like the former is highlighted and the ‘Click To Sign’ button is selected, the stored motion for each sign is , and the signs are blended smoothly, allowing the avatar to sign the whole sentence fluidly. Words without a sign are fingerspelled letter by letter. The movements are more natural in this case because the avatar replays motion captured from real signers rather than motion generated from notation. Additionally, what makes this task unique is that it all happens without a GPU. “The heavy computer-vision work happens once, offline, when the sign dictionary is built. Viewing a sentence only replays and blends stored motion together, which an ordinary laptop handles”, says Sharif. When tested on deaf and hard-of-hearing signers, the ISL signers understood about 89% of sentences signed by the avatar. However, the lack of facial features in the avatar was cited as a drawback because expressions typically include grammar in ISL, as well as signs that change form in context. “We will work to incorporate this in our next iteration,” says Sharif.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Indian Sign language (ISL) seriously lacks resources and technologies”, explains Prof. Jawahar. The group is working in two directions – Sign Language Synthesis as well as Sign Language Understanding. The plugin is related to sign language synthesis from text on low cost commodity hardware.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Game unlocked at midnight on November 19 in each market; Rockstar says story follows criminal couple Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval in Vice City

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The wait is over. ‌After 13 years and an estimated $1 billion or more in production costs, the most anticipated video game release in history is finally ​here. “Grand Theft Auto VI” became available as midnight struck in New Zealand on Thursday (November 19, 2026), with the launch then following the clock around ⁠the world. Millions of players have already downloaded the game to their consoles in anticipation. The release, with events worldwide and many users taking days off work to play, marks the latest instalment in one of entertainment’s most successful franchises. Since its 1997 debut, “Grand Theft Auto” has become one of the best-selling video game series of all time. “I’ve been waiting 13 years to ‌play,” said 20-year-old Jonah Bowen-Brown from Australia’s southern island of Tasmania, who persuaded his mother to give him and his brother a week off work at the family-run fragrance shop, Whiff-it!. “She was really against it at first,” said Bowen-Brown. “I had to say, mum, please, please, I need ‌it.” A gamer plays Grand Theft Auto VI in Miami, Florida | Photo Credit: Reuters The game is made by Take-Two Interactive’s Rockstar Games and available on Sony’s PlayStation 5 and Microsoft’s Xbox Series X and S consoles. The original “Grand Theft ‌Auto” ⁠looks basic by today’s standards, and its missions — stealing cars and carrying out jobs for crime syndicates — angered politicians and parents. But it delighted ⁠gamers. Each successive release delivered more sophisticated graphics and storytelling. “Grand Theft Auto V”, released in 2013 and set in the fictional Los Santos, a stand-in for Los Angeles, became one of the best-selling video games ever.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While retaining the series’ trademark mix of crime, driving and morally dubious missions, it added activities ranging from parachute jumps to cinema visits and radio stations satirising US culture.

📰 GTA VI: Gamers enter Vice City as most-awaited game is rolled out globally

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Game unlocked at midnight on November 19 in each market; Rockstar says story follows criminal couple Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval in Vice City

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The wait is over. ‌After 13 years and an estimated $1 billion or more in production costs, the most anticipated video game release in history is finally ​here. “Grand Theft Auto VI” became available as midnight struck in New Zealand on Thursday (November 19, 2026), with the launch then following the clock around ⁠the world. Millions of players have already downloaded the game to their consoles in anticipation. The release, with events worldwide and many users taking days off work to play, marks the latest instalment in one of entertainment’s most successful franchises. Since its 1997 debut, “Grand Theft Auto” has become one of the best-selling video game series of all time. “I’ve been waiting 13 years to ‌play,” said 20-year-old Jonah Bowen-Brown from Australia’s southern island of Tasmania, who persuaded his mother to give him and his brother a week off work at the family-run fragrance shop, Whiff-it!. “She was really against it at first,” said Bowen-Brown. “I had to say, mum, please, please, I need ‌it.” A gamer plays Grand Theft Auto VI in Miami, Florida | Photo Credit: Reuters The game is made by Take-Two Interactive’s Rockstar Games and available on Sony’s PlayStation 5 and Microsoft’s Xbox Series X and S consoles. The original “Grand Theft ‌Auto” ⁠looks basic by today’s standards, and its missions — stealing cars and carrying out jobs for crime syndicates — angered politicians and parents. But it delighted ⁠gamers. Each successive release delivered more sophisticated graphics and storytelling. “Grand Theft Auto V”, released in 2013 and set in the fictional Los Santos, a stand-in for Los Angeles, became one of the best-selling video games ever.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While retaining the series’ trademark mix of crime, driving and morally dubious missions, it added activities ranging from parachute jumps to cinema visits and radio stations satirising US culture.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Grand Theft Auto VI is a homecoming, and this time a good part of the city was built in Bengaluru

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: This week, Grand Theft Auto VI landed on Blinkit, in a collectible box available in select areas across 11 cities. There is no disc inside, only a download code, because Rockstar is selling the game purely as a download, even in stores. That makes for instant gratification of a new kind: the most anticipated game in years can now reach your doorstep in minutes, about as quickly as a loaf of bread, with the code ready to redeem the moment it arrives. Blinkit co-founder Albinder Dhindsa announced the offering on X on November 18, noting that it had taken 13 years for the game to arrive. It is a very 2026 way to launch a game, and an apt one, given that Grand Theft Auto has always found its way to Indian players through whichever door happened to be open. The game itself costs ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition and ₹7,499 for the Ultimate Edition on both PlayStation and Xbox, which is almost exactly double what Grand Theft Auto V cost here at launch. In dollars, though, Indian buyers pay about US$63 for the Standard Edition versus the $79.99 charged in the United States, and pre-order customers also receive the Vintage Vice City Pack. It is on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only for now, with no PC version announced, which is a shift for a series so many Indians first met on a computer, though Grand Theft Auto V took the same route and reached PC in 2015. GTA 6 is now live on Blinkit! 🎮 It took 13 years for GTA 6 to be released. In the meantime, we built Blinkit so that you can get the game delivered in minutes. We've launched it in select areas of Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata & Ahmedabad (launching in more cities between today and tomorrow). We'll deliver a physical box with a download code inside (the box is a nice collectible for your shelf). Get yours now and start downloading so you're ready to play from 19th November. Expecting a suspicious number of sick leaves over the next few days 😮‍💨 In solidarity, consumer electronics brand boAt offered employees an optional day off on November 19, announcing it with the caption Out of office. Into Vice City. In Chennai, interior design firm Inde by ChairsCarte declared a holiday for its staff, interns and freelancers, calling it “just a day off for a game we’ve waited years for”. For a generation of Indian players, the first port of call was the neighbourhood cyber café. Vice City and San Andreas, which defined the series in the early 2000s, were among the first open worlds many Indians explored, playing on rented computers by the hour, often between rounds of Counter-Strike, long before gaming became a career in India. San Andreas also gave us cheat codes, strings of nonsense such as HESOYAM, which replenished health, armour and cash in one go. For those who grew up typing them, they remain shorthand for nostalgia. Even Indians who have never owned a copy know the series, thanks to its meme culture. The grey-and-red Wasted screen from GTA V, which appears when a character dies, has spent years slapped onto videos of people and animals spectacularly failing at something. Big Smoke’s exasperated yell at CJ for losing a train in San Andreas became so widely shared that Rockstar later named a GTA V trophy Better Than CJ in its honour. But the longest-running joke was about the wait. As the sequel failed to materialise, “We got X before GTA 6” became the Internet’s way of reacting to anything improbable. India took to it enthusiastically, with electronics retailer Croma fuelling another round when the game was delayed to November 19, 2026. Your KRA is updated to completing missions and side quests 🎮 https://t.co/x1xSmUIPqU Grand Theft Auto V arrived in India in September 2013, priced at around ₹3,000 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. But its second life here began after PUBG Mobile was banned in September 2020. Several of India’s biggest streamers, including Dynamo and MortaL, turned to other games, GTA V among them, and roleplay helped make it a mainstay of Indian livestreaming. A roleplay server is a fan-run version of GTA V’s online world where players invent characters with names, jobs and backstories, from cab drivers and paramedics to cops and small-time crooks, and inhabit them for hours. Soulcity, launched by S8UL and Velocity Gaming in early 2023, became one of India’s biggest GTA V roleplay servers and helped create a new breed of gaming star. S8UL co-founder Lokesh Jain, better known as 8Bit Goldy, played a character called Rocket Singh on the server. The scene grew big enough for S8UL to sign creators such as Sunny Jha, aka Pitaji Playz, specifically for its GTA roleplay roster.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated video game's release. | Photo Credit: AFP
