Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Grand Theft Auto VI is a homecoming, and this time a good part of the city was built in Bengaluru." (Hinglish Arth: ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो VI एक घर वापसी है, और इस बार शहर का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बेंगलुरु में बनाया गया था)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "GTA VI is here, and India has taken the day off"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated...
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated...
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated..." (Hinglish Arth: गेमर्स बहुप्रतीक्षित वीडियो गेम के रिलीज के दिन ब्यूनस आयर्स के एक गेमिंग सेंटर में ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो VI (GTA VI) के लॉन्च को दिखाने वाली स्क्रीन देखते हैं।)

hinglishTracks.en: Grand Theft Auto VI is a homecoming, and this time a good part of the city was built in Bengaluru
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो VI एक घर वापसी है, और इस बार शहर का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बेंगलुरु में बनाया गया था।

hinglishTracks.en: This week, Grand Theft Auto VI landed on Blinkit, in a collectible box available in select areas across 11 cities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस सप्ताह, ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो VI 11 शहरों के चुनिंदा क्षेत्रों में उपलब्ध संग्रहणीय बॉक्स में, ब्लिंकिट पर उतरा।।

hinglishTracks.en: There is no disc inside, only a download code, because Rockstar is selling the game purely as a download, even in stores.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अंदर कोई डिस्क नहीं है, केवल एक डाउनलोड कोड है, क्योंकि रॉकस्टार गेम को पूरी तरह से डाउनलोड के रूप में बेच रहा है, यहां तक ​​कि दुकानों में भी।।

hinglishTracks.en: That makes for instant gratification of a new kind: the most anticipated game in years can now reach your doorstep in minutes, about as quickly as a loaf of bread, with the code ready to redeem the moment it arrives.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह एक नए प्रकार की त्वरित संतुष्टि प्रदान करता है: वर्षों में सबसे प्रत्याशित गेम अब मिनटों में आपके दरवाजे तक पहुंच सकता है, लगभग एक रोटी जितनी जल्दी, कोड के साथ आने वाले क्षण को भुनाने के लिए तैयार है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Gratification' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Gratification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Blinkit co-founder Albinder Dhindsa announced the offering on X on November 18, noting that it had taken 13 years for the game to arrive.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — ब्लिंकिट के सह-संस्थापक अल्बिंदर ढींडसा ने 18 नवंबर को एक्स पर पेशकश की घोषणा की, यह देखते हुए कि गेम को आने में 13 साल लग गए।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is a very 2026 way to launch a game, and an apt one, given that Grand Theft Auto has always found its way to Indian players through whichever door happened to be open.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह किसी गेम को लॉन्च करने का एक बहुत अच्छा और उपयुक्त तरीका है, यह देखते हुए कि ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो ने हमेशा भारतीय खिलाड़ियों तक अपना रास्ता ढूंढ लिया है, चाहे कोई भी दरवाजा खुला हो।।

hinglishTracks.en: The game itself costs ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition and ₹7,499 for the Ultimate Edition on both PlayStation and Xbox, which is almost exactly double what Grand Theft Auto V cost here at launch.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — गेम की कीमत PlayStation और Xbox दोनों पर मानक संस्करण के लिए ₹5,999 और अल्टीमेट संस्करण के लिए ₹7,499 है, जो लॉन्च के समय ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो V की कीमत से लगभग दोगुनी है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Playstation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Playstation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: In dollars, though, Indian buyers pay about US$63 for the Standard Edition versus the $79.99 charged in the United States, and pre-order customers also receive the Vintage Vice City Pack.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हालाँकि, डॉलर में, भारतीय खरीदार मानक संस्करण के लिए लगभग US$63 का भुगतान करते हैं, जबकि संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में शुल्क $79.99 है, और प्री-ऑर्डर ग्राहकों को विंटेज वाइस सिटी पैक भी मिलता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only for now, with no PC version announced, which is a shift for a series so many Indians first met on a computer, though Grand Theft Auto V took the same route and reached PC in 2015.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह अभी केवल प्लेस्टेशन 5 और एक्सबॉक्स सीरीज। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Playstation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Playstation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: GTA 6 is now live on Blinkit!
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — GTA 6 अब ब्लिंकिट पर लाइव है!।

hinglishTracks.en: 🎮 It took 13 years for GTA 6 to be released.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — 🎮 GTA 6 को रिलीज़ होने में 13 साल लग गए।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the meantime, we built Blinkit so that you can get the game delivered in minutes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इस बीच, हमने ब्लिंकिट बनाया ताकि आप मिनटों में गेम डिलीवर कर सकें।।

hinglishTracks.en: We've launched it in select areas of Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata & Ahmedabad (launching in more cities between today and tomorrow).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हमने इसे दिल्ली, गुरुग्राम, फ़रीदाबाद, ग़ाज़ियाबाद, नोएडा, बेंगलुरु, हैदराबाद, मुंबई, पुणे, कोलकाता और अहमदाबाद के चुनिंदा क्षेत्रों में लॉन्च किया है (आज और कल के बीच अधिक शहरों में लॉन्च किया जाएगा)।।

hinglishTracks.en: We'll deliver a physical box with a download code inside (the box is a nice collectible for your shelf).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हम अंदर एक डाउनलोड कोड के साथ एक भौतिक बॉक्स वितरित करेंगे (बॉक्स आपके शेल्फ के लिए एक अच्छा संग्रहणीय है)।।

hinglishTracks.en: Get yours now and start downloading so you're ready to play from 19th November.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अभी अपना प्राप्त करें और डाउनलोड करना शुरू करें ताकि आप 19 नवंबर से खेलने के लिए तैयार हों।।

hinglishTracks.en: Expecting a suspicious number of sick leaves over the next few days 😮‍💨
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अगले कुछ दिनों में संदिग्ध संख्या में बीमार पत्तों की उम्मीद है 😮‍💨। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Suspicious' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Suspicious' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: In solidarity, consumer electronics brand boAt offered employees an optional day off on November 19, announcing it with the caption Out of office.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एकजुटता दिखाते हुए, उपभोक्ता इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स ब्रांड boAt ने कर्मचारियों को 19 नवंबर को एक वैकल्पिक दिन की छुट्टी की पेशकश की, इसकी घोषणा कार्यालय से बाहर कैप्शन के साथ की गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Solidarity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Solidarity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Into Vice City.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वाइस सिटी में.।

hinglishTracks.en: In Chennai, interior design firm Inde by ChairsCarte declared a holiday for its staff, interns and freelancers, calling it “just a day off for a game we’ve waited years for”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — चेन्नई में, इंटीरियर डिज़ाइन फर्म इंडे बाय चेयर्सकार्ट ने अपने कर्मचारियों, प्रशिक्षुओं और फ्रीलांसरों के लिए छुट्टी की घोषणा की, इसे "उस खेल के लिए सिर्फ एक दिन की छुट्टी" कहा जिसका हमने वर्षों से इंतजार किया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: For a generation of Indian players, the first port of call was the neighbourhood cyber café.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — भारतीय खिलाड़ियों की एक पीढ़ी के लिए, कॉल का पहला बंदरगाह पड़ोस का साइबर कैफे था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Vice City and San Andreas, which defined the series in the early 2000s, were among the first open worlds many Indians explored, playing on rented computers by the hour, often between rounds of Counter-Strike, long before gaming became a career in India.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वाइस सिटी और सैन एंड्रियास, जिन्होंने 2000 के दशक की शुरुआत में श्रृंखला को परिभाषित किया था, उन पहली खुली दुनियाओं में से थे, जिन्हें कई भारतीयों ने खोजा था, जहां वे घंटों के हिसाब से किराए के कंप्यूटर पर खेलते थे, अक्सर काउंटर-स्ट्राइक के दौर के बीच, भारत में गेमिंग के करियर बनने से बहुत पहले।।

hinglishTracks.en: San Andreas also gave us cheat codes, strings of nonsense such as HESOYAM, which replenished health, armour and cash in one go.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सैन एंड्रियास ने हमें धोखा कोड, HESOYAM जैसे बकवास के तार भी दिए, जो एक ही बार में स्वास्थ्य, कवच और नकदी की भरपाई करते थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: For those who grew up typing them, they remain shorthand for nostalgia.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जो लोग इन्हें टाइप करते हुए बड़े हुए हैं, उनके लिए ये पुरानी यादों का आशुलिपि बनकर रह जाते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Even Indians who have never owned a copy know the series, thanks to its meme culture.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यहां तक ​​कि जिन भारतीयों के पास कभी कोई प्रति नहीं थी, वे भी इस श्रृंखला को जानते हैं, इसकी मीम संस्कृति के कारण।।

hinglishTracks.en: The grey-and-red Wasted screen from GTA V, which appears when a character dies, has spent years slapped onto videos of people and animals spectacularly failing at something.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — GTA V की ग्रे-और-लाल वेस्टेड स्क्रीन, जो तब दिखाई देती है जब एक पात्र मर जाता है, लोगों और जानवरों के किसी चीज़ में शानदार ढंग से विफल होने के वीडियो पर वर्षों तक थप्पड़ मारा गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Big Smoke’s exasperated yell at CJ for losing a train in San Andreas became so widely shared that Rockstar later named a GTA V trophy Better Than CJ in its honour.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — सैन एंड्रियास में ट्रेन छूटने पर बिग स्मोक का सीजे पर चिल्लाना इतना व्यापक रूप से साझा किया गया कि रॉकस्टार ने बाद में इसके सम्मान में जीटीए वी ट्रॉफी को बेटर दैन सीजे का नाम दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: But the longest-running joke was about the wait.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन सबसे लंबे समय तक चलने वाला मजाक इंतजार को लेकर था।।

hinglishTracks.en: As the sequel failed to materialise, “We got X before GTA 6” became the Internet’s way of reacting to anything improbable.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जैसे ही सीक्वल बनने में असफल रहा, "हमें GTA 6 से पहले एक्स मिला" किसी भी असंभव चीज़ पर प्रतिक्रिया करने का इंटरनेट का तरीका बन गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: India took to it enthusiastically, with electronics retailer Croma fuelling another round when the game was delayed to November 19, 2026.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 GTA VI is here, and India has taken the day off

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:56:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Grand Theft Auto VI is a homecoming, and this time a good part of the city was built in Bengaluru

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: This week, Grand Theft Auto VI landed on Blinkit, in a collectible box available in select areas across 11 cities. There is no disc inside, only a download code, because Rockstar is selling the game purely as a download, even in stores. That makes for instant gratification of a new kind: the most anticipated game in years can now reach your doorstep in minutes, about as quickly as a loaf of bread, with the code ready to redeem the moment it arrives. Blinkit co-founder Albinder Dhindsa announced the offering on X on November 18, noting that it had taken 13 years for the game to arrive. It is a very 2026 way to launch a game, and an apt one, given that Grand Theft Auto has always found its way to Indian players through whichever door happened to be open. The game itself costs ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition and ₹7,499 for the Ultimate Edition on both PlayStation and Xbox, which is almost exactly double what Grand Theft Auto V cost here at launch. In dollars, though, Indian buyers pay about US$63 for the Standard Edition versus the $79.99 charged in the United States, and pre-order customers also receive the Vintage Vice City Pack. It is on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only for now, with no PC version announced, which is a shift for a series so many Indians first met on a computer, though Grand Theft Auto V took the same route and reached PC in 2015. GTA 6 is now live on Blinkit! 🎮 It took 13 years for GTA 6 to be released. In the meantime, we built Blinkit so that you can get the game delivered in minutes. We've launched it in select areas of Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata & Ahmedabad (launching in more cities between today and tomorrow). We'll deliver a physical box with a download code inside (the box is a nice collectible for your shelf). Get yours now and start downloading so you're ready to play from 19th November. Expecting a suspicious number of sick leaves over the next few days 😮‍💨 In solidarity, consumer electronics brand boAt offered employees an optional day off on November 19, announcing it with the caption Out of office. Into Vice City. In Chennai, interior design firm Inde by ChairsCarte declared a holiday for its staff, interns and freelancers, calling it “just a day off for a game we’ve waited years for”. For a generation of Indian players, the first port of call was the neighbourhood cyber café. Vice City and San Andreas, which defined the series in the early 2000s, were among the first open worlds many Indians explored, playing on rented computers by the hour, often between rounds of Counter-Strike, long before gaming became a career in India. San Andreas also gave us cheat codes, strings of nonsense such as HESOYAM, which replenished health, armour and cash in one go. For those who grew up typing them, they remain shorthand for nostalgia. Even Indians who have never owned a copy know the series, thanks to its meme culture. The grey-and-red Wasted screen from GTA V, which appears when a character dies, has spent years slapped onto videos of people and animals spectacularly failing at something. Big Smoke’s exasperated yell at CJ for losing a train in San Andreas became so widely shared that Rockstar later named a GTA V trophy Better Than CJ in its honour. But the longest-running joke was about the wait. As the sequel failed to materialise, “We got X before GTA 6” became the Internet’s way of reacting to anything improbable. India took to it enthusiastically, with electronics retailer Croma fuelling another round when the game was delayed to November 19, 2026. Your KRA is updated to completing missions and side quests 🎮 https://t.co/x1xSmUIPqU Grand Theft Auto V arrived in India in September 2013, priced at around ₹3,000 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. But its second life here began after PUBG Mobile was banned in September 2020. Several of India’s biggest streamers, including Dynamo and MortaL, turned to other games, GTA V among them, and roleplay helped make it a mainstay of Indian livestreaming. A roleplay server is a fan-run version of GTA V’s online world where players invent characters with names, jobs and backstories, from cab drivers and paramedics to cops and small-time crooks, and inhabit them for hours. Soulcity, launched by S8UL and Velocity Gaming in early 2023, became one of India’s biggest GTA V roleplay servers and helped create a new breed of gaming star. S8UL co-founder Lokesh Jain, better known as 8Bit Goldy, played a character called Rocket Singh on the server. The scene grew big enough for S8UL to sign creators such as Sunny Jha, aka Pitaji Playz, specifically for its GTA roleplay roster.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated video game's release. | Photo Credit: AFP

A. Grand Theft Auto VI is a homecoming, and this time a good part of the city was built in Bengaluru.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'GTA VI is here, and India has taken the day off' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'GTA VI is here, and India has taken the day o' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Grand Theft Auto VI is a homecoming, and this time a good part of the city was built in Bengaluru." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "GTA VI is here, and India has taken the day off"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Gamers watch a screen showing the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) at a gaming centre in Buenos Aires on the day of the highly anticipated..." (Hinglish Arth: गेमर्स बहुप्रतीक्षित वीडियो गेम के रिलीज के दिन ब्यूनस आयर्स के एक गेमिंग सेंटर में ग्रैंड थेफ्ट ऑटो VI (GTA VI) के लॉन्च को दिखाने वाली स्क्रीन देखते हैं।)

articles.title: Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease drug cost from ₹9 crore to ₹2.5 lakh; seven children to get free treatment
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30; the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine having a medicine that could help manage your child’s rare genetic condition, but being unable to afford it because a year’s treatment costs as much as ₹9 crore. For seven families in India, that situation could soon change. Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30, following an initiative led by Hyderabad-based paediatrician Dr. Sivaranjani Santosh and Access to Medicines India. The development is significant not just because the families will receive the medicine without paying for it, but also because its cost has been brought down through pharmaceutical compounding in the Netherlands. While the commercial version of the drug costs approximately ₹4.68 crore to ₹9 crore per child annually, the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year. The medicine has been prepared by Transvaal Pharmacy in The Hague, Netherlands, with support from the Netherlands-based Pharmaceutical Accountability Foundation (PAF). The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions. The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment. As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches. The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr. Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency. The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells. Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency. It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis. Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families. Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany. Dr. Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug. Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached. Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed. The situation eventually prompted Dr. Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media. On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives. The appeal gained attention, bringing it to the notice of PAF. The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient. Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children. The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore. A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal. According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh. Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands. The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr. Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine having a medicine that could help manage your child’s rare genetic condition, but being unable to afford it because a year’s treatment costs as much as ₹9 crore. For seven families in India, that situation could soon change. Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30, following an initiative led by Hyderabad-based paediatrician Dr. Sivaranjani Santosh and Access to Medicines India. The development is significant not just because the families will receive the medicine without paying for it, but also because its cost has been brought down through pharmaceutical compounding in the Netherlands. While the commercial version of the drug costs approximately ₹4.68 crore to ₹9 crore per child annually, the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year. The medicine has been prepared by Transvaal Pharmacy in The Hague, Netherlands, with support from the Netherlands-based Pharmaceutical Accountability Foundation (PAF). The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions. The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment. As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches. The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr. Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency. The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells. Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency. It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis. Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families. Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany. Dr. Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug. Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached. Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed. The situation eventually prompted Dr. Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media. On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives. The appeal gained attention, bringing it to the notice of PAF. The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient. Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children. The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore. A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal. According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh. Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands. The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr. Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease drug cost from ₹9 crore to ₹2.5 lakh; seven children to get free treatment

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 09:01:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30; the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Imagine having a medicine that could help manage your child’s rare genetic condition, but being unable to afford it because a year’s treatment costs as much as ₹9 crore. For seven families in India, that situation could soon change. Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine tiratricol free of cost on November 30, following an initiative led by Hyderabad-based paediatrician Dr. Sivaranjani Santosh and Access to Medicines India. The development is significant not just because the families will receive the medicine without paying for it, but also because its cost has been brought down through pharmaceutical compounding in the Netherlands. While the commercial version of the drug costs approximately ₹4.68 crore to ₹9 crore per child annually, the compounded formulation is estimated to cost just ₹2.5 lakh per child for a year. The medicine has been prepared by Transvaal Pharmacy in The Hague, Netherlands, with support from the Netherlands-based Pharmaceutical Accountability Foundation (PAF). The first batch will be handed over to the parents of the seven children along with the necessary documentation and individual import permissions. The families have secured approvals for one year of treatment. As the compounded medicine has a shelf life of six months, it will be imported in two batches. The initiative began after Arav, a child under the care of Dr. Sivaranjani, was diagnosed with AHDS, also known as MCT8 deficiency. The condition is caused by mutations affecting the MCT8 gene, which plays an important role in transporting thyroid hormones into brain cells. Tiratricol, also known as TRIAC, acts on thyroid hormone receptors and may help overcome some effects of the deficiency. It also helps minimise complications associated with peripheral thyrotoxicosis. Although the medicine was available in Europe, its commercial price put it beyond the reach of most Indian families. Arav’s mother, Pavitra Sirolkar, had to arrange approximately ₹12 lakh to ₹13 lakh for just one month’s supply of the medicine from Germany. Dr. Sivaranjani initially approached paediatricians, endocrinologists and paediatric neurologists to explore ways of procuring the drug. Doctors at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore, where five other children with the same condition had been identified, were also approached. Attempts to obtain the medicine through pharmaceutical company Egetis Therapeutics and its compassionate-use programme did not succeed. The situation eventually prompted Dr. Sivaranjani to take the issue to social media. On September 7, she posted an appeal seeking help for the family and urged people to tag the Prime Minister, Union Health Minister and other government representatives. The appeal gained attention, bringing it to the notice of PAF. The foundation subsequently explored the possibility of preparing the medicine through pharmaceutical compounding using the active pharmaceutical ingredient. Transvaal Pharmacy conducted test batches and developed a formulation for the seven children. The initial group included Arav and five children receiving treatment at CMC Vellore. A seventh child, aged one year, was identified after his father contacted Dr Sivaranjani following her social media appeal. According to PAF, the total cost of providing one year’s treatment to all seven children is €14,200, approximately ₹15.08 lakh. Of this, Dr Sivaranjani raised approximately ₹6.09 lakh in India, while PAF undertook to raise the remaining €8,600, approximately ₹9.13 lakh, in the Netherlands. The medicine will be provided to all seven families free of cost.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the November 30 handover addresses the immediate treatment requirements of the seven children, Dr. Sivaranjani believes that importing the medicine cannot be a permanent solution. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the medicine compounded in India and making it accessible to more children.

Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Pharmaceutical (Adjective)
दवा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Pharmaceutical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Documentation (Noun)
प्रलेखन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Documentation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease dru' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease dru' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Seven children diagnosed with Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome (AHDS), a rare genetic disorder, are set to receive a year’s supply of the medicine..." (Hinglish Arth: एक दुर्लभ आनुवंशिक विकार, एलन-हेरंडन-डडली सिंड्रोम (एएचडीएस) से पीड़ित सात बच्चों को 30 नवंबर को एक साल के लिए टिराट्रिकोल दवा की मुफ्त आपूर्ति प्राप्त करने के लिए निर्धारित किया गया है; मिश्रित सूत्रीकरण एस्टीमा है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Hyderabad doctor brings down rare disease drug cost from ₹9 crore to ₹2.5 lakh; seven children to get free treatment"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "She plans to approach the Union government and work with Access to Medicines India and other organisations to explore the possibility of getting the..." (Hinglish Arth: वह केंद्र सरकार से संपर्क करने और एक्सेस टू मेडिसिन्स इंडिया और अन्य संगठनों के साथ काम करने की योजना बना रही है ताकि भारत में दवा को मिश्रित करने और इसे अधिक बच्चों के लिए सुलभ बनाने की संभावना का पता लगाया जा सके।)

articles.title: BJP mocks Rahul Gandhi's U.S. remarks, says AI can predict his speeches
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The BJP also said that Congress should consider sending an AI-generated version of its leader abroad because he keeps repeating the same words

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The BJP on Thursday (November 19, 2026) slammed Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for his remarks during his U.S. visit, accusing him of making “Hawai” allegations about India's electoral process and lowering the country's image on foreign soil. The BJP also said that Congress should consider sending an AI-generated version of its leader abroad because he keeps repeating the same words. Interacting with students at the University of Chicago on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), Mr. Gandhi said Indian democracy is “sacred”, and the Congress is ready to face electoral defeats until people realise that the system has been “completely demolished”. Mr. Gandhi also said that boycotting elections over alleged flaws in the system would bring an end to Indian democracy, which the Congress does not intend to do. Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters, BJP spokesperson and Rajya Sabha MP Sudhanshu Trivedi said it is unfortunate that Mr. Gandhi is making remarks against India in Chicago, the city where Swami Vivekananda had once brought glory to the country. “Today, we have a leader of the opposition who is lowering the prestige of Mother India at the same place. This is unfortunate for the Congress and painful for Indians,” Mr. Trivedi said. ALSO WATCH Watch: India facing ‘economic disaster’: Rahul Gandhi at Columbia university He was responding to Mr. Gandhi's remarks questioning the 2024 Lok Sabha elections and concerns over electoral irregularities. Referring to Mr. Gandhi's claim that a Brazilian model voted “23 times” in India, Mr. Trivedi questioned the basis of the charge. “Anyone coming from abroad should have an immigration record, shouldn't they? Just imagine, a leader of the opposition can make such ‘Hawai’ allegations,” he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking a swipe at Mr. Gandhi's frequent foreign visits, Mr. Trivedi said the Congress should stop spending money on sending him abroad.

articles.title: Tolichowki Police Inspector caught taking ₹20,000 bribe to let hotel operate beyond 1 a.m
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Tolichowki Police Inspector in Hyderabad was arrested by the Telangana Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) for allegedly demanding and accepting a bribe of ₹20,000 from a representative of a hotel management to extend official favours.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Inspector L. Ramesh Naik, attached to Tolichowki Police Station under the Golconda Zone of the Hyderabad City Police Commissionerate, was caught red-handed by the ACB officials of City Range-I at around 9.40 p.m. on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) while accepting the bribe amount. The inspector demanded a total bribe of ₹40,000 from the complainant in exchange for not taking coercive action against the hotel management and allowing its cafeteria to operate beyond 1 a.m. by an additional hour on a monthly basis. The arrangement was intended to facilitate the completion of online food orders. The ACB said that the inspector had initially demanded a monthly bribe of ₹50,000 on October 31. He accepted ₹20,000 at the time and agreed to reduce the amount by ₹10,000 for the first month, fixing the bribe at ₹40,000. The ₹20,000 accepted on Wednesday was the remaining balance. The tainted amount of ₹20,000 was recovered from the Inspector’s possession at his instance. During the trap, the ACB officials also found him in possession of unaccounted cash amounting to ₹1.80 lakh, kept in four separate envelopes.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He was arrested and produced before the Additional Special Judge for SPE and ACB Cases at Nampally for judicial remand. The case is under investigation.

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:15:47 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Tolichowki Police Inspector in Hyderabad was arrested by the Telangana Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) for allegedly demanding and accepting a bribe of ₹20,000 from a representative of a hotel management to extend official favours.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Inspector L. Ramesh Naik, attached to Tolichowki Police Station under the Golconda Zone of the Hyderabad City Police Commissionerate, was caught red-handed by the ACB officials of City Range-I at around 9.40 p.m. on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) while accepting the bribe amount. The inspector demanded a total bribe of ₹40,000 from the complainant in exchange for not taking coercive action against the hotel management and allowing its cafeteria to operate beyond 1 a.m. by an additional hour on a monthly basis. The arrangement was intended to facilitate the completion of online food orders. The ACB said that the inspector had initially demanded a monthly bribe of ₹50,000 on October 31. He accepted ₹20,000 at the time and agreed to reduce the amount by ₹10,000 for the first month, fixing the bribe at ₹40,000. The ₹20,000 accepted on Wednesday was the remaining balance. The tainted amount of ₹20,000 was recovered from the Inspector’s possession at his instance. During the trap, the ACB officials also found him in possession of unaccounted cash amounting to ₹1.80 lakh, kept in four separate envelopes.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He was arrested and produced before the Additional Special Judge for SPE and ACB Cases at Nampally for judicial remand. The case is under investigation.

articles.title: ‘Development has meaning only when the poor have food on their plates’, says CM D.K. Shivakumar as he inaugurates 16 Indira Canteens
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Does hunger have a caste or religion? Does it discriminate? Even the richest person, when hungry, does not look at someone’s caste or religion before eating,” Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said on Thursday (November 19, 2026), as he digitally inaugurated 16 new Indira Canteens across urban local bodies in Karnataka on the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. Saying that development had meaning only when there was food on a poor person’s plate, Mr. Shivakumar said the canteens were part of Indira Gandhi’s dream of poverty eradication. Recalling her slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’, he said she had worked towards ensuring that poor people had food and the means to earn their livelihood. “The canteens were being run in her name to carry forward that vision,” he said. “Indira Canteens provide breakfast at ₹5 and meals at ₹10. They are intended to serve daily-wage workers, auto and taxi drivers, small traders and other poor people living in cities. The government plans to increase the number of canteens to over 380,” he said, adding that several outlets were yet to be completed and the pending work should be expedited. People seen in front of Indira canteen near Askok Pillar at Jayanagar, in Bengaluru. File photo. | Photo Credit: MURALI KUMAR K Mr. Shivakumar also spoke about how the idea of Indira Canteens came about. He said that during one of his visits to Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu, he had gone to an Amma Canteen and had breakfast for ₹5. The idli and pongal served there, and the quality of food available at such a low price, had impressed him. He later spoke to Siddaramaiah, who was then the Chief Minister, and other leaders about starting a similar initiative in Karnataka. The legislators supported the idea and suggested that it be named after Indira Gandhi. He said the Congress had always stood for the poor and weaker sections and referred to the Right to Food Act brought in during the UPA government under former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, with Sonia Gandhi as the chairperson. He also recalled the mid-day meal programme introduced during S.M. Krishna’s tenure as Chief Minister and said the Siddaramaiah government had taken this approach forward through schemes such as Anna Bhagya and the five guarantees. “Prices are soaring while incomes are falling. Our aim is not just to remove hunger, but to ensure that everyone has protection. The faces of those who work hard should always have a smile,” he said. Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally. He said the system should help track how many people visited, how much food was prepared and how much was served. An elderly man having a meal at the Indira Canteen in Benson Town, in Bengaluru on February 10, 2026. | Photo Credit: ALLEN EGENUSE J

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said municipal officials should be assigned specific canteens and made to visit them regularly, eat there and check the quality of food and services. Contractors too should be held accountable. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the behest of elected representatives.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 ‘Development has meaning only when the poor have food on their plates’, says CM D.K. Shivakumar as he inaugurates 16 Indira Canteens

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:14:46 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: “Does hunger have a caste or religion? Does it discriminate? Even the richest person, when hungry, does not look at someone’s caste or religion before eating,” Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said on Thursday (November 19, 2026), as he digitally inaugurated 16 new Indira Canteens across urban local bodies in Karnataka on the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. Saying that development had meaning only when there was food on a poor person’s plate, Mr. Shivakumar said the canteens were part of Indira Gandhi’s dream of poverty eradication. Recalling her slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’, he said she had worked towards ensuring that poor people had food and the means to earn their livelihood. “The canteens were being run in her name to carry forward that vision,” he said. “Indira Canteens provide breakfast at ₹5 and meals at ₹10. They are intended to serve daily-wage workers, auto and taxi drivers, small traders and other poor people living in cities. The government plans to increase the number of canteens to over 380,” he said, adding that several outlets were yet to be completed and the pending work should be expedited. People seen in front of Indira canteen near Askok Pillar at Jayanagar, in Bengaluru. File photo. | Photo Credit: MURALI KUMAR K Mr. Shivakumar also spoke about how the idea of Indira Canteens came about. He said that during one of his visits to Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu, he had gone to an Amma Canteen and had breakfast for ₹5. The idli and pongal served there, and the quality of food available at such a low price, had impressed him. He later spoke to Siddaramaiah, who was then the Chief Minister, and other leaders about starting a similar initiative in Karnataka. The legislators supported the idea and suggested that it be named after Indira Gandhi. He said the Congress had always stood for the poor and weaker sections and referred to the Right to Food Act brought in during the UPA government under former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, with Sonia Gandhi as the chairperson. He also recalled the mid-day meal programme introduced during S.M. Krishna’s tenure as Chief Minister and said the Siddaramaiah government had taken this approach forward through schemes such as Anna Bhagya and the five guarantees. “Prices are soaring while incomes are falling. Our aim is not just to remove hunger, but to ensure that everyone has protection. The faces of those who work hard should always have a smile,” he said. Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally. He said the system should help track how many people visited, how much food was prepared and how much was served. An elderly man having a meal at the Indira Canteen in Benson Town, in Bengaluru on February 10, 2026. | Photo Credit: ALLEN EGENUSE J

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said municipal officials should be assigned specific canteens and made to visit them regularly, eat there and check the quality of food and services. Contractors too should be held accountable. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the behest of elected representatives.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Eradication (Noun)
नाश — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Eradication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Initiative (Adjective)
पहल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Initiative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "‘Development has meaning only when the poor have food on their plates’, says CM D.K. Shivakumar as he inaugurates 16 Indira Canteens", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of '‘Development has meaning only when the poor have' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to '‘Development has meaning only when the poor h' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that '‘Development has meaning only when the poor h' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with..." (Hinglish Arth: शिवकुमार ने नगर निकायों से यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कहा कि भोजन की गुणवत्ता बनी रहे और कैंटीनों में सीसीटीवी कैमरे लगाए जाएं, जिनकी फुटेज की निगरानी केंद्रीय रूप से की जाए।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "‘Development has meaning only when the poor have food on their plates’, says CM D.K. Shivakumar as he inaugurates 16 Indira Canteens"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the..." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने चेतावनी दी, ''गुणवत्ता पर कोई समझौता नहीं किया जाएगा।'' उन्होंने कहा कि खामियों के लिए अधिकारियों को जिम्मेदार ठहराया जाएगा, भले ही वे निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधियों के आदेश पर किए गए हों।)

Shivakumar said on Thursday (November 19, 2026), as he digitally inaugurated 16 new Indira Canteens across urban local bodies in Karnataka on the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. Saying that development had meaning only when there was food on a poor person’s plate, Mr. Shivakumar said the canteens were part of Indira Gandhi’s dream of poverty eradication. Recalling her slogan ‘Garibi Hatao’, he said she had worked towards ensuring that poor people had food and the means to earn their livelihood. “The canteens were being run in her name to carry forward that vision,” he said. “Indira Canteens provide breakfast at ₹5 and meals at ₹10. They are intended to serve daily-wage workers, auto and taxi drivers, small traders and other poor people living in cities. The government plans to increase the number of canteens to over 380,” he said, adding that several outlets were yet to be completed and the pending work should be expedited. People seen in front of Indira canteen near Askok Pillar at Jayanagar, in Bengaluru. File photo. | Photo Credit: MURALI KUMAR K Mr. Shivakumar also spoke about how the idea of Indira Canteens came about. He said that during one of his visits to Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu, he had gone to an Amma Canteen and had breakfast for ₹5. The idli and pongal served there, and the quality of food available at such a low price, had impressed him. He later spoke to Siddaramaiah, who was then the Chief Minister, and other leaders about starting a similar initiative in Karnataka. The legislators supported the idea and suggested that it be named after Indira Gandhi. He said the Congress had always stood for the poor and weaker sections and referred to the Right to Food Act brought in during the UPA government under former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, with Sonia Gandhi as the chairperson. He also recalled the mid-day meal programme introduced during S.M. Krishna’s tenure as Chief Minister and said the Siddaramaiah government had taken this approach forward through schemes such as Anna Bhagya and the five guarantees. “Prices are soaring while incomes are falling. Our aim is not just to remove hunger, but to ensure that everyone has protection. The faces of those who work hard should always have a smile,” he said. Mr. Shivakumar asked municipal bodies to ensure that the quality of food was maintained and called for CCTV cameras to be installed at the canteens, with footage monitored centrally. He said the system should help track how many people visited, how much food was prepared and how much was served. An elderly man having a meal at the Indira Canteen in Benson Town, in Bengaluru on February 10, 2026. | Photo Credit: ALLEN EGENUSE J
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: He also said municipal officials should be assigned specific canteens and made to visit them regularly, eat there and check the quality of food and services. Contractors too should be held accountable. “There will be no compromise on quality,” he warned, adding that officials would be held responsible for lapses even if they were committed at the behest of elected representatives.

articles.title: EPFO tells trustees there’s no legal route to recover ₹1,800 crore from Reliance Capital
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees will discuss the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and review the annual performance of its portfolio managers at a meeting on Thursday

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The alleged siphoning of the remaining ₹1,800 crore of salaried workers’ money that Reliance Capital Ltd (RCL) has defaulted on paying to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is part of the agenda of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT) meeting, scheduled to be held here on Thursday (November 19, 2026). According to the agenda note, seen by The Hindu , the EPFO may not be able to claim any more of the principal amount or interest under any legal route. Among the issues to be discussed in the meeting are the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and the annual performance of its portfolio managers. CBT members will also discuss the material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on alleged fraudulent transactions, diversion of funds, irregular lending, and other alleged irregularities by the RCL. The EPFO invested ₹2,500 crore of workers’ money with the RCL in 2013 and 2014, and the latter defaulted on it and is alleged to have impaired the security available to debenture holders, including the EPFO. The EPFO’s admitted claim from the RCL was ₹3,308.67 crore, out of which ₹2,500 crore was the principal amount invested. The investment was scheduled to mature in 2023 and 2024. The custodian of the RCL, Standard Chartered Bank, has reported the receipt of ₹1,492.45 crore, i.e., 59.70% of the principal amount. “Total amount invested but not received as on 19.03.2025 is ₹1,007.55 crore, and the amount of interest admitted in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) but not received is ₹808.67 crore,” the agenda note for Thursday’s meeting said. The agenda note, citing the legal opinion of EPFO’s lawyer, added that no further legal remedy exists for additional recovery in view of binding Supreme Court judgments, the resolution plan approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, and the full-and-final settlement nature of distributions received. “The EPFO may not be able to claim further principal or interest under any legal route,” the agenda note adds. A spokesperson for businessman Anil Ambani had earlier said that Mr. Ambani served as a non-executive director/chairman of the Board of Reliance Capital Limited from 2005 to November 2021, when the Reserve Bank of India superseded the board of directors of the company and appointed an administrator. “Mr. Ambani has denied any wrongdoing whatsoever and reserves all rights available to him in law,” the spokesperson had said. The EPFO has told its trustees that the Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case into the matter. The organisation has written to the ED on the issue and asked the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to refer the matter to the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO). “Considering the nature of the allegations and the financial loss suffered by EPFO, legal consultation was sought on the matter. Based on the legal opinion received, a reference was made to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for registration of FIR, investigation into the alleged fraudulent transactions, and for such appropriate action in accordance with the law,” says the agenda note circulated among members. The meeting will also discuss the status of other defaulters, including the Uttar Pradesh Financial Corporation (outstanding interest of about ₹85 crore), Richardson & Cruddas (a penal interest of about ₹5.36 crore), Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited (a claim of ₹601.54 crore), and the Punjab State Industrial Development Corporation (₹1.10 crore interest in default).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The meeting will also review the performance of portfolio managers such as the UTI Asset Management Company Ltd, SBI Fund Management Ltd, and four asset management companies for Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) investments — UTI Asset Management Company Limited, SBI Funds Management Limited, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited, and Nippon India Life AMC. The evaluation report is prepared by M/s. CRISIL.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The evaluation report is prepared by M/s.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The evaluation report is prepared by M/s." (Hinglish Arth: मूल्यांकन रिपोर्ट मैसर्स द्वारा तैयार की जाती है।)

hinglishTracks.en: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees will discuss the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and review the annual performance of its portfolio managers at a meeting on Thursday
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईपीएफओ का केंद्रीय न्यासी बोर्ड गुरुवार को एक बैठक में सेवानिवृत्ति निधि की होल्डिंग्स पर बकाया डिफ़ॉल्ट की स्थिति पर चर्चा करेगा और अपने पोर्टफोलियो प्रबंधकों के वार्षिक प्रदर्शन की समीक्षा करेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: The alleged siphoning of the remaining ₹1,800 crore of salaried workers’ money that Reliance Capital Ltd (RCL) has defaulted on paying to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is part of the agenda of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT) meeting, scheduled to be held here on Thursday (November 19, 2026).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — वेतनभोगी कर्मचारियों के शेष ₹1,800 करोड़ की कथित हेराफेरी, जिसे रिलायंस कैपिटल लिमिटेड (आरसीएल) ने कर्मचारी भविष्य निधि संगठन (ईपीएफओ) को भुगतान करने में चूक कर दी है, केंद्रीय न्यासी बोर्ड (सीबीटी) की बैठक के एजेंडे का हिस्सा है, जो गुरुवार (19 नवंबर, 2026) को यहां होने वाली है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संगठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the agenda note, seen by The Hindu , the EPFO may not be able to claim any more of the principal amount or interest under any legal route.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — द हिंदू द्वारा देखे गए एजेंडा नोट के अनुसार, ईपीएफओ किसी भी कानूनी मार्ग के तहत मूल राशि या ब्याज का दावा करने में सक्षम नहीं हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Among the issues to be discussed in the meeting are the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and the annual performance of its portfolio managers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — बैठक में जिन मुद्दों पर चर्चा होनी है उनमें सेवानिवृत्ति निधि की होल्डिंग्स पर बकाया डिफॉल्ट की स्थिति और इसके पोर्टफोलियो प्रबंधकों का वार्षिक प्रदर्शन शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: CBT members will also discuss the material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on alleged fraudulent transactions, diversion of funds, irregular lending, and other alleged irregularities by the RCL.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सीबीटी सदस्य प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ईडी) द्वारा कथित धोखाधड़ी वाले लेनदेन, धन की हेराफेरी, अनियमित उधार और आरसीएल द्वारा अन्य कथित अनियमितताओं पर साझा की गई सामग्री पर भी चर्चा करेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPFO invested ₹2,500 crore of workers’ money with the RCL in 2013 and 2014, and the latter defaulted on it and is alleged to have impaired the security available to debenture holders, including the EPFO.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईपीएफओ ने 2013 और 2014 में आरसीएल के साथ श्रमिकों के 2,500 करोड़ रुपये का निवेश किया, और बाद में इसमें चूक हुई और आरोप है कि उसने ईपीएफओ सहित डिबेंचर धारकों को उपलब्ध सुरक्षा को नुकसान पहुंचाया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPFO’s admitted claim from the RCL was ₹3,308.67 crore, out of which ₹2,500 crore was the principal amount invested.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आरसीएल से ईपीएफओ का स्वीकृत दावा ₹3,308.67 करोड़ था, जिसमें से ₹2,500 करोड़ निवेश की गई मूल राशि थी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The investment was scheduled to mature in 2023 and 2024.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — निवेश 2023 और 2024 में परिपक्व होने वाला था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The custodian of the RCL, Standard Chartered Bank, has reported the receipt of ₹1,492.45 crore, i.e., 59.70% of the principal amount.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — आरसीएल के संरक्षक, स्टैंडर्ड चार्टर्ड बैंक ने ₹1,492.45 करोड़, यानी मूल राशि का 59.70% प्राप्त होने की सूचना दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Total amount invested but not received as on 19.03.2025 is ₹1,007.55 crore, and the amount of interest admitted in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) but not received is ₹808.67 crore,” the agenda note for Thursday’s meeting said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — गुरुवार की बैठक के एजेंडा नोट में कहा गया है, "19.03.2025 तक निवेश की गई लेकिन प्राप्त नहीं हुई कुल राशि ₹1,007.55 करोड़ है, और कॉर्पोरेट दिवाला समाधान प्रक्रिया (सीआईआरपी) में स्वीकृत लेकिन प्राप्त नहीं हुई ब्याज की राशि ₹808.67 करोड़ है।"। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The agenda note, citing the legal opinion of EPFO’s lawyer, added that no further legal remedy exists for additional recovery in view of binding Supreme Court judgments, the resolution plan approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, and the full-and-final settlement nature of distributions received.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एजेंडा नोट में ईपीएफओ के वकील की कानूनी राय का हवाला देते हुए कहा गया है कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट के बाध्यकारी फैसलों, राष्ट्रीय कंपनी कानून न्यायाधिकरण द्वारा अनुमोदित समाधान योजना और प्राप्त वितरणों की पूर्ण और अंतिम निपटान प्रकृति के मद्देनजर अतिरिक्त वसूली के लिए कोई और कानूनी उपाय मौजूद नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The EPFO may not be able to claim further principal or interest under any legal route,” the agenda note adds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एजेंडा नोट में कहा गया है, ''ईपीएफओ किसी भी कानूनी रास्ते के तहत आगे मूलधन या ब्याज का दावा करने में सक्षम नहीं हो सकता है।''।

hinglishTracks.en: A spokesperson for businessman Anil Ambani had earlier said that Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बिजनेसमैन अनिल अंबानी के प्रवक्ता ने पहले कहा था कि श्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Ambani served as a non-executive director/chairman of the Board of Reliance Capital Limited from 2005 to November 2021, when the Reserve Bank of India superseded the board of directors of the company and appointed an administrator.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अंबानी ने 2005 से नवंबर 2021 तक रिलायंस कैपिटल लिमिटेड के बोर्ड के गैर-कार्यकारी निदेशक/अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य किया, जब भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक ने कंपनी के निदेशक मंडल को हटा दिया और एक प्रशासक नियुक्त किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Ambani has denied any wrongdoing whatsoever and reserves all rights available to him in law,” the spokesperson had said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अंबानी ने किसी भी तरह के गलत काम से इनकार किया है और कानून में उनके पास उपलब्ध सभी अधिकार सुरक्षित हैं, ”प्रवक्ता ने कहा था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPFO has told its trustees that the Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case into the matter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — ईपीएफओ ने अपने ट्रस्टियों से कहा है कि केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो ने इस मामले में मामला दर्ज कर लिया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The organisation has written to the ED on the issue and asked the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to refer the matter to the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — संगठन ने इस मुद्दे पर ईडी को पत्र लिखा है और कॉर्पोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय से मामले को गंभीर धोखाधड़ी जांच कार्यालय (एसएफआईओ) को सौंपने के लिए कहा है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Investigation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जाँच पड़ताल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investigation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: “Considering the nature of the allegations and the financial loss suffered by EPFO, legal consultation was sought on the matter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “आरोपों की प्रकृति और ईपीएफओ को हुए वित्तीय नुकसान को ध्यान में रखते हुए, मामले पर कानूनी परामर्श मांगा गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Consultation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Based on the legal opinion received, a reference was made to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for registration of FIR, investigation into the alleged fraudulent transactions, and for such appropriate action in accordance with the law,” says the agenda note circulated among members.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 EPFO tells trustees there’s no legal route to recover ₹1,800 crore from Reliance Capital

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:08:37 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: EPFO’s Central Board of Trustees will discuss the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and review the annual performance of its portfolio managers at a meeting on Thursday

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The alleged siphoning of the remaining ₹1,800 crore of salaried workers’ money that Reliance Capital Ltd (RCL) has defaulted on paying to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) is part of the agenda of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT) meeting, scheduled to be held here on Thursday (November 19, 2026). According to the agenda note, seen by The Hindu , the EPFO may not be able to claim any more of the principal amount or interest under any legal route. Among the issues to be discussed in the meeting are the status of the outstanding default on the retirement fund’s holdings and the annual performance of its portfolio managers. CBT members will also discuss the material shared by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) on alleged fraudulent transactions, diversion of funds, irregular lending, and other alleged irregularities by the RCL. The EPFO invested ₹2,500 crore of workers’ money with the RCL in 2013 and 2014, and the latter defaulted on it and is alleged to have impaired the security available to debenture holders, including the EPFO. The EPFO’s admitted claim from the RCL was ₹3,308.67 crore, out of which ₹2,500 crore was the principal amount invested. The investment was scheduled to mature in 2023 and 2024. The custodian of the RCL, Standard Chartered Bank, has reported the receipt of ₹1,492.45 crore, i.e., 59.70% of the principal amount. “Total amount invested but not received as on 19.03.2025 is ₹1,007.55 crore, and the amount of interest admitted in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) but not received is ₹808.67 crore,” the agenda note for Thursday’s meeting said. The agenda note, citing the legal opinion of EPFO’s lawyer, added that no further legal remedy exists for additional recovery in view of binding Supreme Court judgments, the resolution plan approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, and the full-and-final settlement nature of distributions received. “The EPFO may not be able to claim further principal or interest under any legal route,” the agenda note adds. A spokesperson for businessman Anil Ambani had earlier said that Mr. Ambani served as a non-executive director/chairman of the Board of Reliance Capital Limited from 2005 to November 2021, when the Reserve Bank of India superseded the board of directors of the company and appointed an administrator. “Mr. Ambani has denied any wrongdoing whatsoever and reserves all rights available to him in law,” the spokesperson had said. The EPFO has told its trustees that the Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case into the matter. The organisation has written to the ED on the issue and asked the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to refer the matter to the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO). “Considering the nature of the allegations and the financial loss suffered by EPFO, legal consultation was sought on the matter. Based on the legal opinion received, a reference was made to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for registration of FIR, investigation into the alleged fraudulent transactions, and for such appropriate action in accordance with the law,” says the agenda note circulated among members. The meeting will also discuss the status of other defaulters, including the Uttar Pradesh Financial Corporation (outstanding interest of about ₹85 crore), Richardson & Cruddas (a penal interest of about ₹5.36 crore), Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited (a claim of ₹601.54 crore), and the Punjab State Industrial Development Corporation (₹1.10 crore interest in default).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The meeting will also review the performance of portfolio managers such as the UTI Asset Management Company Ltd, SBI Fund Management Ltd, and four asset management companies for Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) investments — UTI Asset Management Company Limited, SBI Funds Management Limited, ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Limited, and Nippon India Life AMC. The evaluation report is prepared by M/s. CRISIL.

✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr. Modi asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) asked India Inc to suggest, without any hesitation or reluctance, more reforms that are necessary for further growth of the country. Addressing industry body FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention, the Prime Minister also asked corporates to focus on making India self-reliant, and urged them to invest heavily in agriculture and allied sectors. Mr. Modi highlighted achievements of his government in the last 12-13 years, and lauded efforts made by all sections of the society. India's growth story is creating new opportunities. Our industries must be ready to seize them. Speaking at FICCI's centenary convention. @ficci_india https://t.co/tJCw2NnpjW He said the pace of progress in India is very fast, and at the same time, the speed at which people are moving out of poverty is also very fast. Citing the latest World Bank report, Mr. Modi said in just 12–13 years, 50 crore people have overcome poverty. Mr. Modi said the basic corporate tax rate has been reduced from 30% in 2014 to 22%, and individual income of up to ₹12 lakh a year is also tax-free. While the government has reduced the corporate tax, he asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages. He also emphasised that a country progresses when it respects its farmers, small entrepreneurs, industries, wealth creators and taxpayers, and not by hurling abuses day-in and day-out.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking a jibe at past regimes, Mr. Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences.
