🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 03:08:31 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr. Modi asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) asked India Inc to suggest, without any hesitation or reluctance, more reforms that are necessary for further growth of the country. Addressing industry body FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention, the Prime Minister also asked corporates to focus on making India self-reliant, and urged them to invest heavily in agriculture and allied sectors. Mr. Modi highlighted achievements of his government in the last 12-13 years, and lauded efforts made by all sections of the society. India's growth story is creating new opportunities. Our industries must be ready to seize them. Speaking at FICCI's centenary convention. @ficci_india https://t.co/tJCw2NnpjW He said the pace of progress in India is very fast, and at the same time, the speed at which people are moving out of poverty is also very fast. Citing the latest World Bank report, Mr. Modi said in just 12–13 years, 50 crore people have overcome poverty. Mr. Modi said the basic corporate tax rate has been reduced from 30% in 2014 to 22%, and individual income of up to ₹12 lakh a year is also tax-free. While the government has reduced the corporate tax, he asked if the industry has increased the strength of employees and raised their wages. He also emphasised that a country progresses when it respects its farmers, small entrepreneurs, industries, wealth creators and taxpayers, and not by hurling abuses day-in and day-out.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Taking a jibe at past regimes, Mr. Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Convention (Noun)
सम्मेलन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Convention' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Individual (Adjective)
व्यक्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Individual' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on further reforms", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on fu' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'PM Modi invites suggestions from India Inc on' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "While the government has reduced the corporate tax, Mr." (Hinglish Arth: वहीं सरकार ने कॉरपोरेट टैक्स कम कर दिया है.)

B. Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Modi said the industry's experience with previous governments has been so bitter that he has to bear the consequences." articles.title: Japanese PM Takaichi calls for continued dialogue with China to ease bilateral tensions
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) called for continued dialogue and communication with China to ease bilateral tensions triggered by her remarks on Taiwan, saying Beijing is an "important neighbour" with which Tokyo has several outstanding issues. Ms. Takaichi is in Shenzhen to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting. "China is an important neighbour, and between the two countries there are outstanding issues, and that is why it is important to continue communicating and having dialogue,” she told the media on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. When asked about her brief interaction with Mr. Xi, the Japanese PM said she thanked him for the invitation and congratulated him on successfully hosting the APEC summit. Relations between Tokyo and Beijing have sharply deteriorated after Takaichi told parliament in November last year that a Chinese attack on Taiwan, a self-governed island claimed by China, could trigger a situation in which Japan's Self-Defence Forces might support US forces. Her remarks infuriated China, prompting it to take a series of political and economic measures against Japan, including export restrictions on rare earths used in a wide range of high-tech products. Asked about the controversy, Ms. Takaichi said Japan's four political documents governing its relations with China remained unchanged and continued to serve as the foundation of bilateral ties. Tokyo will continue to advance a comprehensive strategic relationship of mutual benefit with Beijing while pursuing dialogue to protect their respective national interests and build constructive and stable ties, she said, according to the Hong Kong-based South China Morning Post.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Takaichi refrained from commenting on a hypothetical Taiwan contingency, saying Japan's position on Taiwan, as articulated in the 1972 Japan-China Joint Communique, remained unchanged.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Japanese PM Takaichi calls for continued dialogue with China to ease bilateral tensions

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 02:21:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi on Thursday (November 19, 2026) called for continued dialogue and communication with China to ease bilateral tensions triggered by her remarks on Taiwan, saying Beijing is an "important neighbour" with which Tokyo has several outstanding issues. Ms. Takaichi is in Shenzhen to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting. "China is an important neighbour, and between the two countries there are outstanding issues, and that is why it is important to continue communicating and having dialogue,” she told the media on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Earlier in the day, Ms. Takaichi shook hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping and later held a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. When asked about her brief interaction with Mr. Xi, the Japanese PM said she thanked him for the invitation and congratulated him on successfully hosting the APEC summit. Relations between Tokyo and Beijing have sharply deteriorated after Takaichi told parliament in November last year that a Chinese attack on Taiwan, a self-governed island claimed by China, could trigger a situation in which Japan's Self-Defence Forces might support US forces. Her remarks infuriated China, prompting it to take a series of political and economic measures against Japan, including export restrictions on rare earths used in a wide range of high-tech products. Asked about the controversy, Ms. Takaichi said Japan's four political documents governing its relations with China remained unchanged and continued to serve as the foundation of bilateral ties. Tokyo will continue to advance a comprehensive strategic relationship of mutual benefit with Beijing while pursuing dialogue to protect their respective national interests and build constructive and stable ties, she said, according to the Hong Kong-based South China Morning Post.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Ms. Takaichi refrained from commenting on a hypothetical Taiwan contingency, saying Japan's position on Taiwan, as articulated in the 1972 Japan-China Joint Communique, remained unchanged.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Communication (Noun)
संचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Communication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Comprehensive (Adjective)
विस्तृत — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Comprehensive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Constructive (Adjective)
रचनात्मक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Constructive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Some in the West are comparing the three-way meeting to the 1945 Yalta conference, where the wartime leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union divided Germany and Berlin, carved out zones of influence in Europe, and agreed to establish the United Nations. The Kremlin, which long has courted the concept of a “multipolar world” offering an equal say to all nations, plays down the Yalta comparisons, which are also unwelcome to China for similar reasons. Fyodor Lukyanov, a pro-Kremlin foreign policy expert, noted that even as Moscow publicly rejects the Yalta analogy, it seems to believe the leaders could “reach agreements and make decisions that will determine global developments”. Of the three nations, “it seems that only Russia really believes in the possibility of global control”, he told a recent roundtable. Chatham House director Bronwen Maddox said in a commentary that “standing with Xi and Trump, Putin will look like one of the three main leaders of the world”, even though “Russia is no superpower” and its economy, overloaded with military spending, is dwindling. She warned that “the danger for Ukraine is that Trump uses this summit to try to advance his notion of peace, including giving Russia territory it has not managed to seize by force”. The meeting follows US-mediated peace talks between Russia and Ukraine held in Abu Dhabi last week for the first time in nine months. The negotiations produced few visible results as the parties stuck to their sharply divergent demands. -- AP Trilateral Xi-Putin-Trump summit draws Yalta 1945 comparisons, highlighting postwar order shifts amid Ukraine tensions and multipolar world debates. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: After a 13-year wait, GTA VI is finally here. Built on an estimated $1.5 billion, the game takes players into Leonida’s crime-filled world. Here’s a closer look

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Putting an end to the long waiting period of over 13 years, the Grand Theft Auto (GTA) VI by Rockstar Games went live on Thursday (November 19, 2026) for millions of gamers across the globe, offering a gripping landscape of blazing action sequences and adventure-packed missions. The Rockstar Games’ biggest video game, widely reported to be the most expensive cultural product ever made of around $1.5 billion, has released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. The plot is set in Leonida (a Florida-inspired city), buzzing with traffic, crime and sun-drenched beaches, pairing spectacular visuals with the rise of two small-time criminals through the city’s underworld. The central characters are a criminal couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, whose action-packed adventures punctuated by slow-motion effects and dramatic camera shifts is expected to the highlight of the videogame. Lucia has recently been released from prison, while Jason is a former soldier who became involved with drug runners in the Leonida Keys. When a criminal job goes wrong, the pair become entangled in a wider conspiracy. Based on the latest reports, the videogame is not on the cards for the official release in Russia, China, Lebanon or Qatar. As per the official site, over 4,700 employees cutting across a dozen studios of Rockstar studios, devoted more than eight years to build the latest instalment of GTA. The active production only began after the release of Rockstar’s previous game, Red Dead Redemption II, in 2018. Earlier slated for a late 2025 release , the game’s launch was postponed twice owing to a series of leaks in 2022 and the online release of stolen gameplay videos. Developers immersed themselves in the region while building the game, driving through Miami, the Florida Keys and surrounding communities, flying over the Everglades and researching the area’s history and architecture. In a bid to cater to the immersive gameplay experience, the videogame allows players to tune into more than 20 radio stations at home or in their vehicles, with music ranging from Simple Minds and Daft Punk to Van Halen. A fresh addition in the latest instalment is podcasts. Among the options is a true-crime-style series chronicling Vice City, the game’s main metropolis. The videogame’s plot unfolds by building the relationship between Jason and Lucia, from a chance encounter during a police stop to a robbery gone wrong that lands Lucia in jail. Much of the adventure transpires through lengthy cinematic cut-scenes, allowing players to sit back and watch the story. Only later does the game open up and hand players control of Jason’s day-to-day life, a former soldier working for local gangsters, who is recovering drug packages dropped at sea, stealing cars and shaking down debtors. The videogame’s release has sparked a wave of excitement among gamers for detailed attention to the graphics. In GTA VI, the hair sways in the wind, muscles flex beneath clothing and characters move with a naturalism. The fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar’s take on Florida, enables a larger-than-life experience to the gamers. This is enveloped by bustling city streets, neon-soaked nightlife and pristine beaches all feature in a vast 3D world that players can explore while scuba diving. Further, the game’s map is learnt to be one of the biggest and busiest ever made in the GTA-series history. The latest addition allows the non-player characters go about their own lives, and the world seems to carry on whether the player is involved or not. A simple drive across town might involve a random police traffic stop, witnessing a car accident or stumbling across a robbery by the beach.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Additionally, players are likely to find cars heavier in the latest instalment of the video-game, relatably tough to manoeuvre with a responsibility to keep an eye on their fuel tanks. They also decide what stays in a car trunk and what comes along for the ride, juggle phone calls and messages, and use apps to identify targets or track potential scores.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लूसिया को हाल ही में जेल से रिहा किया गया है, जबकि जेसन एक पूर्व सैनिक है जो लियोनिडा कीज़ में ड्रग तस्करों के साथ शामिल हो गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: When a criminal job goes wrong, the pair become entangled in a wider conspiracy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जब कोई आपराधिक काम गलत हो जाता है, तो यह जोड़ा एक व्यापक साजिश में फंस जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Based on the latest reports, the videogame is not on the cards for the official release in Russia, China, Lebanon or Qatar.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नवीनतम रिपोर्टों के आधार पर, वीडियो गेम रूस, चीन, लेबनान या कतर में आधिकारिक रिलीज की योजना में नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: As per the official site, over 4,700 employees cutting across a dozen studios of Rockstar studios, devoted more than eight years to build the latest instalment of GTA.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — आधिकारिक साइट के अनुसार, रॉकस्टार स्टूडियो के एक दर्जन स्टूडियो में काम करने वाले 4,700 से अधिक कर्मचारियों ने GTA की नवीनतम किस्त के निर्माण के लिए आठ साल से अधिक समय समर्पित किया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Instalment' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: किस्त — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Instalment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The active production only began after the release of Rockstar’s previous game, Red Dead Redemption II, in 2018.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सक्रिय उत्पादन 2018 में रॉकस्टार के पिछले गेम, रेड डेड रिडेम्पशन II की रिलीज़ के बाद ही शुरू हुआ।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Production' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Production' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Earlier slated for a late 2025 release , the game’s launch was postponed twice owing to a series of leaks in 2022 and the online release of stolen gameplay videos.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पहले 2025 के अंत में रिलीज़ होने की योजना थी, 2022 में लीक की एक श्रृंखला और चोरी हुए गेमप्ले वीडियो की ऑनलाइन रिलीज़ के कारण गेम का लॉन्च दो बार स्थगित किया गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: Developers immersed themselves in the region while building the game, driving through Miami, the Florida Keys and surrounding communities, flying over the Everglades and researching the area’s history and architecture.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — डेवलपर्स ने गेम का निर्माण करते हुए, मियामी, फ्लोरिडा कीज़ और आसपास के समुदायों के माध्यम से ड्राइविंग करते हुए, एवरग्लेड्स के ऊपर उड़ान भरते हुए और क्षेत्र के इतिहास और वास्तुकला पर शोध करते हुए खुद को इस क्षेत्र में डुबो दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: In a bid to cater to the immersive gameplay experience, the videogame allows players to tune into more than 20 radio stations at home or in their vehicles, with music ranging from Simple Minds and Daft Punk to Van Halen.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — गहन गेमप्ले अनुभव को पूरा करने के लिए, वीडियो गेम खिलाड़ियों को घर पर या अपने वाहनों में 20 से अधिक रेडियो स्टेशनों को सुनने की अनुमति देता है, जिसमें सिंपल माइंड्स और डफ़्ट पंक से लेकर वैन हेलन तक का संगीत शामिल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A fresh addition in the latest instalment is podcasts.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नवीनतम किस्त में एक नया जुड़ाव पॉडकास्ट है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Instalment' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: किस्त — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Instalment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Among the options is a true-crime-style series chronicling Vice City, the game’s main metropolis.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विकल्पों में से एक सच्ची-अपराध-शैली श्रृंखला है जो गेम के मुख्य महानगर वाइस सिटी का वर्णन करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The videogame’s plot unfolds by building the relationship between Jason and Lucia, from a chance encounter during a police stop to a robbery gone wrong that lands Lucia in jail.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वीडियो गेम की कहानी जेसन और लूसिया के बीच संबंधों के निर्माण से शुरू होती है, जिसमें एक पुलिस स्टॉप के दौरान एक आकस्मिक मुठभेड़ से लेकर एक डकैती की गलत घटना तक लूसिया को जेल जाना पड़ता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Much of the adventure transpires through lengthy cinematic cut-scenes, allowing players to sit back and watch the story.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — अधिकांश साहसिक कार्य लंबे सिनेमाई कट-सीन के माध्यम से घटित होते हैं, जिससे खिलाड़ियों को आराम से बैठकर कहानी देखने का मौका मिलता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Only later does the game open up and hand players control of Jason’s day-to-day life, a former soldier working for local gangsters, who is recovering drug packages dropped at sea, stealing cars and shaking down debtors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — बाद में ही खेल खुलता है और खिलाड़ियों को जेसन के दैनिक जीवन का नियंत्रण सौंप दिया जाता है, जो स्थानीय गैंगस्टरों के लिए काम करने वाला एक पूर्व सैनिक है, जो समुद्र में गिराए गए दवा पैकेजों को पुनर्प्राप्त कर रहा है, कारों की चोरी कर रहा है और देनदारों को परेशान कर रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The videogame’s release has sparked a wave of excitement among gamers for detailed attention to the graphics.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वीडियोगेम की रिलीज़ ने ग्राफिक्स पर विस्तृत ध्यान देने के लिए गेमर्स के बीच उत्साह की लहर पैदा कर दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In GTA VI, the hair sways in the wind, muscles flex beneath clothing and characters move with a naturalism.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — GTA VI में, बाल हवा में लहराते हैं, मांसपेशियाँ कपड़ों के नीचे झुकती हैं और पात्र स्वाभाविकता के साथ चलते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar’s take on Florida, enables a larger-than-life experience to the gamers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लियोनिडा का काल्पनिक राज्य, रॉकस्टार का फ्लोरिडा पर आधारित, गेमर्स को जीवन से भी बड़ा अनुभव प्रदान करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This is enveloped by bustling city streets, neon-soaked nightlife and pristine beaches all feature in a vast 3D world that players can explore while scuba diving.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह शहर की हलचल भरी सड़कों, नीयन-रंजित नाइटलाइफ़ और प्राचीन समुद्र तटों से घिरा हुआ है, ये सभी एक विशाल 3D दुनिया की विशेषता रखते हैं जिसे खिलाड़ी स्कूबा डाइविंग के दौरान देख सकते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Further, the game’s map is learnt to be one of the biggest and busiest ever made in the GTA-series history.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इसके अलावा, गेम का मैप GTA-श्रृंखला के इतिहास में अब तक के सबसे बड़े और व्यस्ततम में से एक माना जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The latest addition allows the non-player characters go about their own lives, and the world seems to carry on whether the player is involved or not.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नवीनतम जोड़ गैर-खिलाड़ी पात्रों को अपने जीवन के बारे में जाने की अनुमति देता है, और दुनिया चलती रहती है चाहे खिलाड़ी इसमें शामिल हो या नहीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: A simple drive across town might involve a random police traffic stop, witnessing a car accident or stumbling across a robbery by the beach.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शहर भर में एक साधारण ड्राइव में अचानक पुलिस यातायात रोकना, कार दुर्घटना का गवाह बनना या समुद्र तट पर डकैती का सामना करना शामिल हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Additionally, players are likely to find cars heavier in the latest instalment of the video-game, relatably tough to manoeuvre with a responsibility to keep an eye on their fuel tanks.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसके अतिरिक्त, खिलाड़ियों को वीडियो-गेम की नवीनतम किस्त में भारी कारें मिलने की संभावना है, जिन्हें उनके ईंधन टैंक पर नज़र रखने की ज़िम्मेदारी के साथ चलाना अपेक्षाकृत कठिन है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: They also decide what stays in a car trunk and what comes along for the ride, juggle phone calls and messages, and use apps to identify targets or track potential scores.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — वे यह भी तय करते हैं कि कार की डिक्की में क्या रहेगा और सवारी के लिए क्या आएगा, फोन कॉल और संदेशों को आपस में जोड़ते हैं, और लक्ष्य की पहचान करने या संभावित स्कोर को ट्रैक करने के लिए ऐप्स का उपयोग करते हैं।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 GTA VI goes live: Inside Rockstar Games’ biggest video game yet

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 02:40:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: After a 13-year wait, GTA VI is finally here. Built on an estimated $1.5 billion, the game takes players into Leonida’s crime-filled world. Here’s a closer look

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Putting an end to the long waiting period of over 13 years, the Grand Theft Auto (GTA) VI by Rockstar Games went live on Thursday (November 19, 2026) for millions of gamers across the globe, offering a gripping landscape of blazing action sequences and adventure-packed missions. The Rockstar Games’ biggest video game, widely reported to be the most expensive cultural product ever made of around $1.5 billion, has released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. The plot is set in Leonida (a Florida-inspired city), buzzing with traffic, crime and sun-drenched beaches, pairing spectacular visuals with the rise of two small-time criminals through the city’s underworld. The central characters are a criminal couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, whose action-packed adventures punctuated by slow-motion effects and dramatic camera shifts is expected to the highlight of the videogame. Lucia has recently been released from prison, while Jason is a former soldier who became involved with drug runners in the Leonida Keys. When a criminal job goes wrong, the pair become entangled in a wider conspiracy. Based on the latest reports, the videogame is not on the cards for the official release in Russia, China, Lebanon or Qatar. As per the official site, over 4,700 employees cutting across a dozen studios of Rockstar studios, devoted more than eight years to build the latest instalment of GTA. The active production only began after the release of Rockstar’s previous game, Red Dead Redemption II, in 2018. Earlier slated for a late 2025 release , the game’s launch was postponed twice owing to a series of leaks in 2022 and the online release of stolen gameplay videos. Developers immersed themselves in the region while building the game, driving through Miami, the Florida Keys and surrounding communities, flying over the Everglades and researching the area’s history and architecture. In a bid to cater to the immersive gameplay experience, the videogame allows players to tune into more than 20 radio stations at home or in their vehicles, with music ranging from Simple Minds and Daft Punk to Van Halen. A fresh addition in the latest instalment is podcasts. Among the options is a true-crime-style series chronicling Vice City, the game’s main metropolis. The videogame’s plot unfolds by building the relationship between Jason and Lucia, from a chance encounter during a police stop to a robbery gone wrong that lands Lucia in jail. Much of the adventure transpires through lengthy cinematic cut-scenes, allowing players to sit back and watch the story. Only later does the game open up and hand players control of Jason’s day-to-day life, a former soldier working for local gangsters, who is recovering drug packages dropped at sea, stealing cars and shaking down debtors. The videogame’s release has sparked a wave of excitement among gamers for detailed attention to the graphics. In GTA VI, the hair sways in the wind, muscles flex beneath clothing and characters move with a naturalism. The fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar’s take on Florida, enables a larger-than-life experience to the gamers. This is enveloped by bustling city streets, neon-soaked nightlife and pristine beaches all feature in a vast 3D world that players can explore while scuba diving. Further, the game’s map is learnt to be one of the biggest and busiest ever made in the GTA-series history. The latest addition allows the non-player characters go about their own lives, and the world seems to carry on whether the player is involved or not. A simple drive across town might involve a random police traffic stop, witnessing a car accident or stumbling across a robbery by the beach.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Additionally, players are likely to find cars heavier in the latest instalment of the video-game, relatably tough to manoeuvre with a responsibility to keep an eye on their fuel tanks. They also decide what stays in a car trunk and what comes along for the ride, juggle phone calls and messages, and use apps to identify targets or track potential scores.

Responsibility (Noun)
ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Playstation (Noun)
प्ले स्टेशन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Playstation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Instalment (Adjective)
किस्त — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Instalment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: After a 13-year wait, GTA VI is finally here. Built on an estimated $1.5 billion, the game takes players into Leonida’s crime-filled world. Here’s a closer look
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Putting an end to the long waiting period of over 13 years, the Grand Theft Auto (GTA) VI by Rockstar Games went live on Thursday (November 19, 2026) for millions of gamers across the globe, offering a gripping landscape of blazing action sequences and adventure-packed missions. The Rockstar Games’ biggest video game, widely reported to be the most expensive cultural product ever made of around $1.5 billion, has released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. The plot is set in Leonida (a Florida-inspired city), buzzing with traffic, crime and sun-drenched beaches, pairing spectacular visuals with the rise of two small-time criminals through the city’s underworld. The central characters are a criminal couple, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, whose action-packed adventures punctuated by slow-motion effects and dramatic camera shifts is expected to the highlight of the videogame. Lucia has recently been released from prison, while Jason is a former soldier who became involved with drug runners in the Leonida Keys. When a criminal job goes wrong, the pair become entangled in a wider conspiracy. Based on the latest reports, the videogame is not on the cards for the official release in Russia, China, Lebanon or Qatar. As per the official site, over 4,700 employees cutting across a dozen studios of Rockstar studios, devoted more than eight years to build the latest instalment of GTA. The active production only began after the release of Rockstar’s previous game, Red Dead Redemption II, in 2018. Earlier slated for a late 2025 release , the game’s launch was postponed twice owing to a series of leaks in 2022 and the online release of stolen gameplay videos. Developers immersed themselves in the region while building the game, driving through Miami, the Florida Keys and surrounding communities, flying over the Everglades and researching the area’s history and architecture. In a bid to cater to the immersive gameplay experience, the videogame allows players to tune into more than 20 radio stations at home or in their vehicles, with music ranging from Simple Minds and Daft Punk to Van Halen. A fresh addition in the latest instalment is podcasts. Among the options is a true-crime-style series chronicling Vice City, the game’s main metropolis. The videogame’s plot unfolds by building the relationship between Jason and Lucia, from a chance encounter during a police stop to a robbery gone wrong that lands Lucia in jail. Much of the adventure transpires through lengthy cinematic cut-scenes, allowing players to sit back and watch the story. Only later does the game open up and hand players control of Jason’s day-to-day life, a former soldier working for local gangsters, who is recovering drug packages dropped at sea, stealing cars and shaking down debtors. The videogame’s release has sparked a wave of excitement among gamers for detailed attention to the graphics. In GTA VI, the hair sways in the wind, muscles flex beneath clothing and characters move with a naturalism. The fictional state of Leonida, Rockstar’s take on Florida, enables a larger-than-life experience to the gamers. This is enveloped by bustling city streets, neon-soaked nightlife and pristine beaches all feature in a vast 3D world that players can explore while scuba diving. Further, the game’s map is learnt to be one of the biggest and busiest ever made in the GTA-series history. The latest addition allows the non-player characters go about their own lives, and the world seems to carry on whether the player is involved or not. A simple drive across town might involve a random police traffic stop, witnessing a car accident or stumbling across a robbery by the beach.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Additionally, players are likely to find cars heavier in the latest instalment of the video-game, relatably tough to manoeuvre with a responsibility to keep an eye on their fuel tanks. They also decide what stays in a car trunk and what comes along for the ride, juggle phone calls and messages, and use apps to identify targets or track potential scores.

articles.title: DRI seizes over 70 kg of heroin worth ₹700 crore in Chennai
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram; DMK president M.K. Stalin says Tamil Nadu has become a ‘vice city’ under TVK rule

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), during a surprise raid in Chennai, seized more than 70 kg of heroin from two persons hailing from the southern districts of Tamil Nadu. The seized heroin has been valued at around ₹700 crore. A senior official from the Avadi Police Commissionerate said the DRI officials had received a tip-off that a huge consignment of heroin was being smuggled in the guise of ice cream packets. Based on specific intelligence inputs, the DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram and inspected a vehicle that was waiting to load the manufactured ice. During a search of the vehicle, the DRI officials recovered packets of heroin stashed inside the vehicle’s refrigeration unit and arrested the two men who were supposedly waiting in the vehicle. The DRI officials identified the accused persons as Abdul Shukoor and Shafiq Ahmed, both natives of the southern districts of the State and residing in the city. According to the police official, the duo had been tasked by unidentified persons to transport the consignment of narcotics to another location. The DRI officials are investigating to determine the origin of the heroin, as well as the network involved in smuggling such huge quantities of the drug. The arrested duo was produced before a Judicial Magistrate’s Court in Alandur and later remanded to judicial custody. DMK president M.K. Stalin, commenting on the seizure, raised questions about why the State police had failed to monitor drug trafficking networks and arrest those involved. In a statement, he said the deterioration in law and order, alleged sexual misconduct by ruling TVK functionaries, robberies and burglaries, and custodial deaths had turned Tamil Nadu into a “vice city”. Mr. Stalin also questioned whether the Director-General of Police, who had cited statistics to divert public attention from incidents of crime, had any response to the seizure of heroin.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He may say that a case has been registered. But he should explain why the State police has been unable to arrest drug traffickers. What happened to the 65 units formed to prevent drug use and trafficking in the State? Chief Minister Vijay holds the Home portfolio. If he is not prepared to offer an explanation now, when will he do so? TVK’s ‘reel’ fans illegally open dams, but no one seems able to make the Chief Minister speak,” he said.

📰 DRI seizes over 70 kg of heroin worth ₹700 crore in Chennai

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 05:23:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram; DMK president M.K. Stalin says Tamil Nadu has become a ‘vice city’ under TVK rule

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), during a surprise raid in Chennai, seized more than 70 kg of heroin from two persons hailing from the southern districts of Tamil Nadu. The seized heroin has been valued at around ₹700 crore. A senior official from the Avadi Police Commissionerate said the DRI officials had received a tip-off that a huge consignment of heroin was being smuggled in the guise of ice cream packets. Based on specific intelligence inputs, the DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram and inspected a vehicle that was waiting to load the manufactured ice. During a search of the vehicle, the DRI officials recovered packets of heroin stashed inside the vehicle’s refrigeration unit and arrested the two men who were supposedly waiting in the vehicle. The DRI officials identified the accused persons as Abdul Shukoor and Shafiq Ahmed, both natives of the southern districts of the State and residing in the city. According to the police official, the duo had been tasked by unidentified persons to transport the consignment of narcotics to another location. The DRI officials are investigating to determine the origin of the heroin, as well as the network involved in smuggling such huge quantities of the drug. The arrested duo was produced before a Judicial Magistrate’s Court in Alandur and later remanded to judicial custody. DMK president M.K. Stalin, commenting on the seizure, raised questions about why the State police had failed to monitor drug trafficking networks and arrest those involved. In a statement, he said the deterioration in law and order, alleged sexual misconduct by ruling TVK functionaries, robberies and burglaries, and custodial deaths had turned Tamil Nadu into a “vice city”. Mr. Stalin also questioned whether the Director-General of Police, who had cited statistics to divert public attention from incidents of crime, had any response to the seizure of heroin.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He may say that a case has been registered. But he should explain why the State police has been unable to arrest drug traffickers. What happened to the 65 units formed to prevent drug use and trafficking in the State? Chief Minister Vijay holds the Home portfolio. If he is not prepared to offer an explanation now, when will he do so? TVK’s ‘reel’ fans illegally open dams, but no one seems able to make the Chief Minister speak,” he said.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram; DMK president M.K. Stalin says Tamil Nadu has become a ‘vice city’ under TVK rule
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram; DMK president M.K. Stalin says Tamil Nadu has become a ‘vice city’ under TVK rule
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), during a surprise raid in Chennai, seized more than 70 kg of heroin from two persons hailing from the southern districts of Tamil Nadu. The seized heroin has been valued at around ₹700 crore. A senior official from the Avadi Police Commissionerate said the DRI officials had received a tip-off that a huge consignment of heroin was being smuggled in the guise of ice cream packets. Based on specific intelligence inputs, the DRI officials raided an ice-manufacturing factory in Madhavaram and inspected a vehicle that was waiting to load the manufactured ice. During a search of the vehicle, the DRI officials recovered packets of heroin stashed inside the vehicle’s refrigeration unit and arrested the two men who were supposedly waiting in the vehicle. The DRI officials identified the accused persons as Abdul Shukoor and Shafiq Ahmed, both natives of the southern districts of the State and residing in the city. According to the police official, the duo had been tasked by unidentified persons to transport the consignment of narcotics to another location. The DRI officials are investigating to determine the origin of the heroin, as well as the network involved in smuggling such huge quantities of the drug. The arrested duo was produced before a Judicial Magistrate’s Court in Alandur and later remanded to judicial custody. DMK president M.K. Stalin, commenting on the seizure, raised questions about why the State police had failed to monitor drug trafficking networks and arrest those involved. In a statement, he said the deterioration in law and order, alleged sexual misconduct by ruling TVK functionaries, robberies and burglaries, and custodial deaths had turned Tamil Nadu into a “vice city”. Mr. Stalin also questioned whether the Director-General of Police, who had cited statistics to divert public attention from incidents of crime, had any response to the seizure of heroin.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “He may say that a case has been registered. But he should explain why the State police has been unable to arrest drug traffickers. What happened to the 65 units formed to prevent drug use and trafficking in the State? Chief Minister Vijay holds the Home portfolio. If he is not prepared to offer an explanation now, when will he do so? TVK’s ‘reel’ fans illegally open dams, but no one seems able to make the Chief Minister speak,” he said.

articles.title: Malaysia to end visa-free entry to Indians from January 1, 2027
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Earlier, Indian nationals travelling to the South East Asian nation were granted a 30-day visa exemption and just had to register for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Malaysia is ending its visa-free access for Indian nationals from January 1, 2027, the Immigration Department of Malaysia has announced. Earlier, Indian nationals travelling to the South East Asian nation were granted a 30-day visa exemption and just had to register for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival. The visa exemption was introduced on December 1, 2023, and later extended to the end of 2026. The Immigration Department of Malaysia (JIM), in a notice on November 17, said the visa exemption facility for Indian nationals will no longer be available with effect from 1 January 2027. Accordingly, Indian nationals entering Malaysia from this date onwards will be required to obtain a valid visa prior to their arrival, it said. Visa applications may be submitted through the MyVISA portal starting 1 December 2026, it added. The JIM further said that visa processing fees would be non-refundable, regardless of the application outcome, change of policy or any subsequent changes to travel plans. The Immigration Department of Malaysia reserves the right to amend these entry requirements at any time in accordance with directives from the Government of Malaysia, the notice said. It also advised visitors to obtain travel medical coverage for the full duration of their intended stay in Malaysia. Medical treatment and related healthcare services are chargeable to non-residents, who are responsible for all expenses incurred, it said. In September, India had advised its nationals in Malaysia not to use the country's 30-day visa-free entry facility to seek employment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In an advisory posted on X , the High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur said it has noticed a “noticeable increase” in Indian nationals arriving in Malaysia who are "misled by unscrupulous agents with false job promises." The High Commission said the 30-day visa-free facility is meant for tourism and social visits and does not permit employment.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Malaysia to end visa-free entry to Indians from January 1, 2027

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 07:06:29 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Earlier, Indian nationals travelling to the South East Asian nation were granted a 30-day visa exemption and just had to register for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Malaysia is ending its visa-free access for Indian nationals from January 1, 2027, the Immigration Department of Malaysia has announced. Earlier, Indian nationals travelling to the South East Asian nation were granted a 30-day visa exemption and just had to register for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival. The visa exemption was introduced on December 1, 2023, and later extended to the end of 2026. The Immigration Department of Malaysia (JIM), in a notice on November 17, said the visa exemption facility for Indian nationals will no longer be available with effect from 1 January 2027. Accordingly, Indian nationals entering Malaysia from this date onwards will be required to obtain a valid visa prior to their arrival, it said. Visa applications may be submitted through the MyVISA portal starting 1 December 2026, it added. The JIM further said that visa processing fees would be non-refundable, regardless of the application outcome, change of policy or any subsequent changes to travel plans. The Immigration Department of Malaysia reserves the right to amend these entry requirements at any time in accordance with directives from the Government of Malaysia, the notice said. It also advised visitors to obtain travel medical coverage for the full duration of their intended stay in Malaysia. Medical treatment and related healthcare services are chargeable to non-residents, who are responsible for all expenses incurred, it said. In September, India had advised its nationals in Malaysia not to use the country's 30-day visa-free entry facility to seek employment.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In an advisory posted on X , the High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur said it has noticed a “noticeable increase” in Indian nationals arriving in Malaysia who are "misled by unscrupulous agents with false job promises." The High Commission said the 30-day visa-free facility is meant for tourism and social visits and does not permit employment.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Earlier, Indian nationals travelling to the South East Asian nation were granted a 30-day visa exemption and just had to register for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Malaysia is ending its visa-free access for Indian nationals from January 1, 2027, the Immigration Department of Malaysia has announced. Earlier, Indian nationals travelling to the South East Asian nation were granted a 30-day visa exemption and just had to register for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card within three days before arrival. The visa exemption was introduced on December 1, 2023, and later extended to the end of 2026. The Immigration Department of Malaysia (JIM), in a notice on November 17, said the visa exemption facility for Indian nationals will no longer be available with effect from 1 January 2027. Accordingly, Indian nationals entering Malaysia from this date onwards will be required to obtain a valid visa prior to their arrival, it said. Visa applications may be submitted through the MyVISA portal starting 1 December 2026, it added. The JIM further said that visa processing fees would be non-refundable, regardless of the application outcome, change of policy or any subsequent changes to travel plans. The Immigration Department of Malaysia reserves the right to amend these entry requirements at any time in accordance with directives from the Government of Malaysia, the notice said. It also advised visitors to obtain travel medical coverage for the full duration of their intended stay in Malaysia. Medical treatment and related healthcare services are chargeable to non-residents, who are responsible for all expenses incurred, it said. In September, India had advised its nationals in Malaysia not to use the country's 30-day visa-free entry facility to seek employment.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In an advisory posted on X , the High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur said it has noticed a “noticeable increase” in Indian nationals arriving in Malaysia who are "misled by unscrupulous agents with false job promises." The High Commission said the 30-day visa-free facility is meant for tourism and social visits and does not permit employment.

articles.title: Yadgir ZP CEO directs officials to ensure effective implementation of schemes
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Newly appointed Chief Executive Officer Jubin Mohapatra chairs his maiden meeting with district-level officers of various departments

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chairing a maiden meeting with the district level officers of various government departments, the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer of the Yadgir Zilla Panchayat Jubin Mohapatra has directed them to take concrete steps for the effective implementation of departmental schemes and ensure that funds are utilised within the stipulated timeframe without allowing them to lapse. Mr. Mohapatra, who assumed charge as the CEO on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), chaired a review meeting in Zilla Panchayat’s VC Hall on Wednesday (November 18). He stressed the need for timely and target-oriented expenditure of grants released under various Zilla Panchayat heads and other State government programmes. Emphasising the effective rollout of the State government’s five guarantee schemes apart from the sixth ‘Bhoo Guarantee’ initiative, the CEO instructed officials to ensure that the benefits of every beneficiary-oriented scheme reach eligible people without delay. He cautioned officers against any irregularities and directed them to discharge their duties responsibly in strict adherence to government guidelines and directives. Calling for close inter-departmental coordination, Mr. Mohapatra asked officials to keep updated progress reports of all schemes ready at all times and bring any operational issues to his immediate notice. Announcing a citizen-centric measure, the CEO said a dedicated public grievance redressal cell would soon be opened at the Zilla Panchayat office to address public issues promptly. He urged officials to focus on resolving grievances in a fair and lawful manner.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In-charge Deputy Secretary of the Zilla Panchayat Sharanabasav and various district-level officers attended the meeting.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ICJ had for seven years weighed the accusations made by Gambia against Myanmar’s treatment of its minority Rohingya community.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the International Court of Justice said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) in an historic verdict, the first time it has ruled a state committed the crime. “The Republic of the Union of Myanmar has committed genocide against the Rohingya group in northern Rakhine State, in violation of its obligations under the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide,” said ICJ President Yuji Iwasawa. Judges at the top UN court (also called the World Court) had for seven years been weighing accusations made by Gambia about whether Myanmar’s treatment of the Rohingya people breached the 1948 UN Genocide Convention. The international community closely watched the verdict as an archetype for the case filed by South Africa against Israel over its campaign in Gaza. The Rohingya are a minority ethnic group, largely comprising Muslims, in the predominantly Buddhist Myanmar, formerly referred to as Burma. Most of the Rohingya come from the Rakhine State, also known as Arakan State, in northwest Myanmar. The State borders Bangladesh. They speak a dialect of Bengali, as opposed to the commonly spoken Burmese language. While the Rohingya people have been living in Myanmar for generations, they are not recognised by the country, rendering them effectively stateless. Their movement are also restricted within the Rakhine State. When Burma won Independence from the UK in 1948, the Bengali-speaking Muslim population near the border exceeded that of the Buddhists, leading to secessionist tensions, according to Reuters . In 1962, a coup led to nearly five decades of military rule by the ethnic Burman majority. In 1978, thousands of people fled to Bangladesh to escape a military census of the Rohingya called “Operation Dragon.” In 1991, another wave of refugees fled to Bangladesh where the UN says 300,000 Rohingya now live a stateless existence.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: From 2025: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh mark anniversary of Myanmar exodus as conference opens

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Top UN court begins ruling on Rohingya ‘genocide’ case: Refugee crisis, timeline of the case, and more

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 05:18:50 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ICJ had for seven years weighed the accusations made by Gambia against Myanmar’s treatment of its minority Rohingya community.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the International Court of Justice said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) in an historic verdict, the first time it has ruled a state committed the crime. “The Republic of the Union of Myanmar has committed genocide against the Rohingya group in northern Rakhine State, in violation of its obligations under the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide,” said ICJ President Yuji Iwasawa. Judges at the top UN court (also called the World Court) had for seven years been weighing accusations made by Gambia about whether Myanmar’s treatment of the Rohingya people breached the 1948 UN Genocide Convention. The international community closely watched the verdict as an archetype for the case filed by South Africa against Israel over its campaign in Gaza. The Rohingya are a minority ethnic group, largely comprising Muslims, in the predominantly Buddhist Myanmar, formerly referred to as Burma. Most of the Rohingya come from the Rakhine State, also known as Arakan State, in northwest Myanmar. The State borders Bangladesh. They speak a dialect of Bengali, as opposed to the commonly spoken Burmese language. While the Rohingya people have been living in Myanmar for generations, they are not recognised by the country, rendering them effectively stateless. Their movement are also restricted within the Rakhine State. When Burma won Independence from the UK in 1948, the Bengali-speaking Muslim population near the border exceeded that of the Buddhists, leading to secessionist tensions, according to Reuters . In 1962, a coup led to nearly five decades of military rule by the ethnic Burman majority. In 1978, thousands of people fled to Bangladesh to escape a military census of the Rohingya called “Operation Dragon.” In 1991, another wave of refugees fled to Bangladesh where the UN says 300,000 Rohingya now live a stateless existence.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: From 2025: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh mark anniversary of Myanmar exodus as conference opens

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Convention' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Prevention' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

A. The ICJ had for seven years weighed the accusations made by Gambia against Myanmar’s treatment of its minority Rohingya community.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Top UN court begins ruling on Rohingya ‘genocide' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Top UN court begins ruling on Rohingya ‘genoc' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Top UN court begins ruling on Rohingya ‘genoc' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The ICJ had for seven years weighed the accusations made by Gambia against Myanmar’s treatment of its minority Rohingya community." A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Myanmar’s soldiers killed and raped Rohingya, committed violence against children, and destroyed Rohingya villages and settlements, the top UN court said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) in a historic verdict, the first time it has ruled a state committed the crime. “The Republic of the Union of Myanmar has committed genocide against the Rohingya group in northern Rakhine State, in violation of its obligations under the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide,” said ICJ President Yuji Iwasawa. Myanmar’s ​security forces killed ‌thousands of members ​of ⁠the Rohingya minority Muslim population and committed ‌widespread sexual violence, judges ‌at the World ‌Court ⁠ruled on ⁠Thursday (November 19, 2026). The death toll announcement came early in a three-hour sitting to read out the International Court of Justice’s decision on whether Myanmar committed genocide in a brutal offensive against the Rohingya nearly a decade ago. Judges ruled ‌that actions ‌by ‌Myanmar ⁠against ⁠the Rohingya in 2017 had ​the “intention ‌to destroy” a substantial ‌part of ​the Muslim minority population, ⁠meeting the ‌legal threshold for genocide. Myanmar’s soldiers killed and raped Rohingya, committed violence against children, and destroyed Rohingya villages and settlements, the top UN court said. They “killed thousands of Rohingya civilians, perpetrated widespread acts of sexual violence as well as acts of extreme violence against children, and attacked fleeing Rohingya as they sought to flee in large numbers to Bangladesh,” said Mr. Iwasawa. The ICJ has not yet ruled whether Myanmar has committed the crime of genocide, in a landmark ruling that is expected to take around three hours to read out. “The court has also determined that the estimate of 10,000 Rohingya violently killed during (2017) clearance operations is supported by the evidence,” said Mr. Iwasawa.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 World Court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya population

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 06:45:03 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Myanmar’s soldiers killed and raped Rohingya, committed violence against children, and destroyed Rohingya villages and settlements, the top UN court said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) in a historic verdict, the first time it has ruled a state committed the crime. “The Republic of the Union of Myanmar has committed genocide against the Rohingya group in northern Rakhine State, in violation of its obligations under the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide,” said ICJ President Yuji Iwasawa. Myanmar’s ​security forces killed ‌thousands of members ​of ⁠the Rohingya minority Muslim population and committed ‌widespread sexual violence, judges ‌at the World ‌Court ⁠ruled on ⁠Thursday (November 19, 2026). The death toll announcement came early in a three-hour sitting to read out the International Court of Justice’s decision on whether Myanmar committed genocide in a brutal offensive against the Rohingya nearly a decade ago. Judges ruled ‌that actions ‌by ‌Myanmar ⁠against ⁠the Rohingya in 2017 had ​the “intention ‌to destroy” a substantial ‌part of ​the Muslim minority population, ⁠meeting the ‌legal threshold for genocide. Myanmar’s soldiers killed and raped Rohingya, committed violence against children, and destroyed Rohingya villages and settlements, the top UN court said. They “killed thousands of Rohingya civilians, perpetrated widespread acts of sexual violence as well as acts of extreme violence against children, and attacked fleeing Rohingya as they sought to flee in large numbers to Bangladesh,” said Mr. Iwasawa. The ICJ has not yet ruled whether Myanmar has committed the crime of genocide, in a landmark ruling that is expected to take around three hours to read out. “The court has also determined that the estimate of 10,000 Rohingya violently killed during (2017) clearance operations is supported by the evidence,” said Mr. Iwasawa.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ICJ verdict in Myanmar Rohingya genocide case https://t.co/jYJygPy2MA

articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: China-U.S. relations 'stable and improved', Xi says; Ukraine strikes Crimean bridge again as Trump says U.S., China want to help end war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Some in the West are comparing the three-way meeting to the 1945 Yalta conference, where the wartime leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union divided Germany and Berlin, carved out zones of influence in Europe, and agreed to establish the United Nations. The Kremlin, which long has courted the concept of a “multipolar world” offering an equal say to all nations, plays down the Yalta comparisons, which are also unwelcome to China for similar reasons. Fyodor Lukyanov, a pro-Kremlin foreign policy expert, noted that even as Moscow publicly rejects the Yalta analogy, it seems to believe the leaders could “reach agreements and make decisions that will determine global developments”. Of the three nations, “it seems that only Russia really believes in the possibility of global control”, he told a recent roundtable. Chatham House director Bronwen Maddox said in a commentary that “standing with Xi and Trump, Putin will look like one of the three main leaders of the world”, even though “Russia is no superpower” and its economy, overloaded with military spending, is dwindling. She warned that “the danger for Ukraine is that Trump uses this summit to try to advance his notion of peace, including giving Russia territory it has not managed to seize by force”. The meeting follows US-mediated peace talks between Russia and Ukraine held in Abu Dhabi last week for the first time in nine months. The negotiations produced few visible results as the parties stuck to their sharply divergent demands. -- AP Trilateral Xi-Putin-Trump summit draws Yalta 1945 comparisons, highlighting postwar order shifts amid Ukraine tensions and multipolar world debates. Nuclear weapons should be comprehensively ‌prohibited and completely destroyed, ⁠with the ultimate goal of building a ‌world free of nuclear ‌weapons, Chinese ‌President ⁠Xi Jinping ⁠said in a meeting with U.S. President Donald ‌Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday (November 19, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A ‌nuclear war cannot be won and ⁠must never be fought, Mr. Xi said ‌according to China’s official Xinhua news agency. Mr. Xi added that ‌every effort must be made to prevent nuclear ⁠war.- Reuters

hinglishTracks.en: The Kremlin, which long has courted the concept of a “multipolar world” offering an equal say to all nations, plays down the Yalta comparisons, which are also unwelcome to China for similar reasons.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — क्रेमलिन, जिसने लंबे समय से सभी देशों को समान अधिकार देने वाली "बहुध्रुवीय दुनिया" की अवधारणा को आगे बढ़ाया है, याल्टा तुलनाओं को महत्व नहीं देता है, जो समान कारणों से चीन के लिए भी अवांछित हैं।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — क्रेमलिन समर्थक विदेश नीति विशेषज्ञ फ्योडोर लुक्यानोव ने कहा कि भले ही मॉस्को सार्वजनिक रूप से याल्टा सादृश्य को खारिज कर देता है, लेकिन ऐसा लगता है कि नेता "समझौते पर पहुंच सकते हैं और निर्णय ले सकते हैं जो वैश्विक विकास को निर्धारित करेंगे"।।

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral meeting LIVE: Xi-Trump-Putin summit in China ends; major powers must not touch each other's bottom lines on sensitive issues, says Xi

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 05:04:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: China-U.S. relations 'stable and improved', Xi says; Ukraine strikes Crimean bridge again as Trump says U.S., China want to help end war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Some in the West are comparing the three-way meeting to the 1945 Yalta conference, where the wartime leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union divided Germany and Berlin, carved out zones of influence in Europe, and agreed to establish the United Nations. The Kremlin, which long has courted the concept of a “multipolar world” offering an equal say to all nations, plays down the Yalta comparisons, which are also unwelcome to China for similar reasons. Fyodor Lukyanov, a pro-Kremlin foreign policy expert, noted that even as Moscow publicly rejects the Yalta analogy, it seems to believe the leaders could “reach agreements and make decisions that will determine global developments”. Of the three nations, “it seems that only Russia really believes in the possibility of global control”, he told a recent roundtable. Chatham House director Bronwen Maddox said in a commentary that “standing with Xi and Trump, Putin will look like one of the three main leaders of the world”, even though “Russia is no superpower” and its economy, overloaded with military spending, is dwindling. She warned that “the danger for Ukraine is that Trump uses this summit to try to advance his notion of peace, including giving Russia territory it has not managed to seize by force”. The meeting follows US-mediated peace talks between Russia and Ukraine held in Abu Dhabi last week for the first time in nine months. The negotiations produced few visible results as the parties stuck to their sharply divergent demands. -- AP Trilateral Xi-Putin-Trump summit draws Yalta 1945 comparisons, highlighting postwar order shifts amid Ukraine tensions and multipolar world debates. Nuclear weapons should be comprehensively ‌prohibited and completely destroyed, ⁠with the ultimate goal of building a ‌world free of nuclear ‌weapons, Chinese ‌President ⁠Xi Jinping ⁠said in a meeting with U.S. President Donald ‌Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday (November 19, 2026).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A ‌nuclear war cannot be won and ⁠must never be fought, Mr. Xi said ‌according to China’s official Xinhua news agency. Mr. Xi added that ‌every effort must be made to prevent nuclear ⁠war.- Reuters

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Influence (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Influence' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Xi added that ‌every effort must be made to prevent nuclear ⁠war.- Reuters.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Xi added that ‌every effort must be made to prevent nuclear ⁠war.- Reuters." (Hinglish Arth: शी ने कहा कि परमाणु युद्ध को रोकने के लिए हर संभव प्रयास किया जाना चाहिए।- रॉयटर्स)

articles.title: Trump says U.S. opposes 'globalist regulation' of AI
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The United States opposes "globalist regulation" of artificial intelligence in any form, President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) ahead of talks with China's Xi Jinping, expected to broach the topic.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mr. Trump has repeatedly rejected calls for wide-reaching international governance of AI, warning it could hold his country back in its race with China. "It's super intelligence, but we have to watch it," he told leaders at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting in Shenzhen, using his administration's preferred term for AI. "We have to be careful. We have to cherish it. It's almost completely good, but it's got some bad elements, and we have to be very careful in managing those bad elements," Mr. Trump said. "So we oppose any form of globalist regulation or anything to control and stifle SI, and we won't allow that to happen, frankly." Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi are due to hold talks later on Thursday, with the issues they are set to discuss including how to address the rapid changes brought by AI. articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The United States opposes "globalist regulation" of artificial intelligence in any form, President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 19, 2026) ahead of talks with China's Xi Jinping, expected to broach the topic.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mr. Trump has repeatedly rejected calls for wide-reaching international governance of AI, warning it could hold his country back in its race with China. "It's super intelligence, but we have to watch it," he told leaders at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting in Shenzhen, using his administration's preferred term for AI. "We have to be careful. We have to cherish it. It's almost completely good, but it's got some bad elements, and we have to be very careful in managing those bad elements," Mr. Trump said. "So we oppose any form of globalist regulation or anything to control and stifle SI, and we won't allow that to happen, frankly." Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi are due to hold talks later on Thursday, with the issues they are set to discuss including how to address the rapid changes brought by AI. Despite the countries' fierce tech rivalry, AI safety risks of shared concern range from infrastructure hacking to people using the technology to help build bioweapons. Another problem in the spotlight is out-of-control AI agents, tools that complete real-life tasks online, after ChatGPT maker OpenAI's bots hacked into websites including an Australian government portal, incidents followed by similar reports by other labs. Military use and mass surveillance are also potential flashpoints for the world's two leading AI powers.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Looming over the talks, however, is Jensen Huang's resignation as boss of US chip titan Nvidia after revelations of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

articles.title: Replace Russian junk with American weapons system: U.S. lawmaker to India
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Michael Baumgartner made the remarks on Capitol Hill in the presence of Namgya Khampa, the Deputy Chief of Mission at the Indian Embassy in Washington

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India should replace its "legacy ineffective Russian junk” with American weapons systems and also opt for Boeing aircraft over those manufactured by European Airbus Industries, a U.S. Congressman has suggested. Michael Baumgartner, a Republican from Washington state, made the remarks at Deepavali celebrations on Capitol Hill on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) in the presence of Namgya Khampa, the Deputy Chief of Mission at the Indian Embassy in Washington. The Deepavali celebrations were hosted by BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha, Asian American Hotel Owners Association, Hindu American Foundations, Srimad Rajchandra Mission Dharampur, Sikhs of America, Art of Living, Foundations of Jain Associations in North America and the U.S. Indian Community Foundation. As a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, Mr. Baumgartner said he regularly engages with diplomats from the Indian Embassy as the two countries seek to strengthen relations across economic and security issues. “I was pleased to again express my thoughts that the more U.S. exports to India — from weapons systems to replace their legacy ineffective Russian junk to Boeing airplanes that are superior to Airbus to the world’s best lentils from the Palouse — the better it is for our two great countries,” Mr. Baumgartner said in a post on X. Mr. Baumgartner also raised the issue of disruptions during Deepavali celebrations in his home state of Washington. “A couple weeks back some attention-seeking racist morons disrupted a Diwali celebration in my home state of Washington. This evening, I was pleased to attend the Diwali celebration at the US Capitol,” he said. The Deepavali celebrations were also attended by the U.S. Congresswoman-elect Pia Dandiya, Congresspersons Grace Meng, Suhas Subramanyam, Shri Thanedar, Nick LaLota, Jonathan Jackson, Raja Krishnamoorthi, Norma Torres, Pete Sessions, Deborah Ross, Buddy Carter, Michael Guest, among others. Scott Colom, who scripted history by becoming the first black Senator from Mississippi in 146 years, also lit the traditional lamp at the Deepavali celebrations.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: politics / national politics / USA / defence / defence equipment

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Replace Russian junk with American weapons system: U.S. lawmaker to India

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 04:47:44 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Michael Baumgartner made the remarks on Capitol Hill in the presence of Namgya Khampa, the Deputy Chief of Mission at the Indian Embassy in Washington

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India should replace its "legacy ineffective Russian junk” with American weapons systems and also opt for Boeing aircraft over those manufactured by European Airbus Industries, a U.S. Congressman has suggested. Michael Baumgartner, a Republican from Washington state, made the remarks at Deepavali celebrations on Capitol Hill on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) in the presence of Namgya Khampa, the Deputy Chief of Mission at the Indian Embassy in Washington. The Deepavali celebrations were hosted by BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha, Asian American Hotel Owners Association, Hindu American Foundations, Srimad Rajchandra Mission Dharampur, Sikhs of America, Art of Living, Foundations of Jain Associations in North America and the U.S. Indian Community Foundation. As a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, Mr. Baumgartner said he regularly engages with diplomats from the Indian Embassy as the two countries seek to strengthen relations across economic and security issues. “I was pleased to again express my thoughts that the more U.S. exports to India — from weapons systems to replace their legacy ineffective Russian junk to Boeing airplanes that are superior to Airbus to the world’s best lentils from the Palouse — the better it is for our two great countries,” Mr. Baumgartner said in a post on X. Mr. Baumgartner also raised the issue of disruptions during Deepavali celebrations in his home state of Washington. “A couple weeks back some attention-seeking racist morons disrupted a Diwali celebration in my home state of Washington. This evening, I was pleased to attend the Diwali celebration at the US Capitol,” he said. The Deepavali celebrations were also attended by the U.S. Congresswoman-elect Pia Dandiya, Congresspersons Grace Meng, Suhas Subramanyam, Shri Thanedar, Nick LaLota, Jonathan Jackson, Raja Krishnamoorthi, Norma Torres, Pete Sessions, Deborah Ross, Buddy Carter, Michael Guest, among others. Scott Colom, who scripted history by becoming the first black Senator from Mississippi in 146 years, also lit the traditional lamp at the Deepavali celebrations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: politics / national politics / USA / defence / defence equipment

A. Michael Baumgartner made the remarks on Capitol Hill in the presence of Namgya Khampa, the Deputy Chief of Mission at the Indian Embassy in Washington.
